from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from app.database import Database
from app.repositories import BatchRepository, InvalidTransitionError


class BatchRepositoryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.temporary_directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.root = Path(self.temporary_directory.name)
        self.database = Database(self.root / "workflow.db")
        self.database.initialize()
        self.repository = BatchRepository(self.database)

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.temporary_directory.cleanup()

    def test_database_enables_wal_and_foreign_keys(self) -> None:
        with self.database.connect() as connection:
            journal_mode = connection.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode").fetchone()[0]
            foreign_keys = connection.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys").fetchone()[0]

        self.assertEqual(journal_mode.lower(), "wal")
        self.assertEqual(foreign_keys, 1)

    def test_batch_and_items_survive_repository_restart(self) -> None:
        created = self.repository.create_batch(
            name="鍏湀鍟嗗搧",
            pids=["1736250849091618684", "1731846642408588819"],
            category_mode="auto",
            worker_count=3,
            profile_ids=["profile-a", "profile-b"],
        )

        reloaded = BatchRepository(Database(self.root / "workflow.db"))
        detail = reloaded.get_batch_detail(created["id"])

        self.assertEqual(detail["batch"]["status"], "draft")
        self.assertEqual([item["pid"] for item in detail["items"]], [
            "1736250849091618684",
            "1731846642408588819",
        ])
        self.assertEqual(detail["stats"]["total"], 2)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(detail["events"]), 1)

    def test_status_machine_accepts_controls_and_rejects_invalid_transition(self) -> None:
        batch = self.repository.create_batch(
            name="鐘舵€佹満",
            pids=["1736250849091618684"],
            category_mode="clothing",
            worker_count=1,
            profile_ids=[],
        )

        self.assertEqual(self.repository.transition(batch["id"], "start")["status"], "running")
        self.assertEqual(self.repository.transition(batch["id"], "pause")["status"], "paused")
        self.assertEqual(self.repository.transition(batch["id"], "resume")["status"], "running")
        self.assertEqual(self.repository.transition(batch["id"], "cancel")["status"], "cancelled")
        with self.assertRaises(InvalidTransitionError):
            self.repository.transition(batch["id"], "resume")

    def test_retry_failed_only_resets_failed_items(self) -> None:
        batch = self.repository.create_batch(
            name="閲嶈瘯",
            pids=["1736250849091618684", "1731846642408588819"],
            category_mode="non_clothing",
            worker_count=2,
            profile_ids=[],
        )
        self.repository.transition(batch["id"], "start")
        items = self.repository.list_items(batch["id"])
        self.repository.update_item(items[0]["id"], status="failed", stage="scrape", error_code="timeout")
        self.repository.update_item(items[1]["id"], status="succeeded", stage="complete")
        self.repository.finish_batch(batch["id"])

        retried = self.repository.transition(batch["id"], "retry-failed")
        current_items = self.repository.list_items(batch["id"])

        self.assertEqual(retried["status"], "running")
        self.assertEqual(current_items[0]["status"], "pending")
        self.assertEqual(current_items[0]["attempt"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(current_items[1]["status"], "succeeded")

    def test_sql_values_are_parameterized(self) -> None:
        batch = self.repository.create_batch(
            name="x'); DROP TABLE batches; --",
            pids=["1736250849091618684"],
            category_mode="auto",
            worker_count=1,
            profile_ids=[],
        )

        with self.database.connect() as connection:
            table = connection.execute(
                "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = ? AND name = ?",
                ("table", "batches"),
            ).fetchone()

        self.assertIsNotNone(table)
        self.assertEqual(self.repository.get_batch(batch["id"])["name"], "x'); DROP TABLE batches; --")

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sqlite3
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from app.config import AppConfig
from app.services.bitbrowser import BitBrowserDiscovery
from app.services.paths import ManagedPathError, ManagedPaths
from app.services.secrets import InMemorySecretStore


class SecurityAndIntegrationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.temporary_directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.root = Path(self.temporary_directory.name)

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.temporary_directory.cleanup()

    def test_managed_paths_reject_traversal_and_sibling_prefix(self) -> None:
        paths = ManagedPaths(self.root / "data")
        allowed = paths.resolve("exports/example.txt")

        self.assertTrue(allowed.is_relative_to((self.root / "data").resolve()))
        with self.assertRaises(ManagedPathError):
            paths.resolve("../secret.txt")
        with self.assertRaises(ManagedPathError):
            paths.ensure_allowed((self.root / "database-escape" / "file.txt").resolve())

    def test_offline_bitbrowser_discovery_reads_ids_only(self) -> None:
        db_path = self.root / "db.sqlite"
        connection = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
        connection.execute(
            "CREATE TABLE browser_persistent_data (browser_id TEXT, value TEXT, type TEXT)"
        )
        connection.executemany(
            "INSERT INTO browser_persistent_data VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            [
                ("profile-a", json.dumps({"password": "must-not-leak"}), "profile"),
                ("profile-b", "secret-cookie", "profile"),
                ("profile-a", "duplicate", "profile"),
            ],
        )
        connection.commit()
        connection.close()
        discovery = BitBrowserDiscovery(
            base_url="http://127.0.0.1:1",
            local_db_path=db_path,
            executable_path=self.root / "missing.exe",
            timeout_seconds=0.05,
        )

        result = discovery.discover()
        serialized = json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False)

        self.assertFalse(result["online"])
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in result["items"]], ["profile-a", "profile-b"])
        self.assertNotIn("must-not-leak", serialized)
        self.assertNotIn("secret-cookie", serialized)

    def test_secret_store_returns_only_status(self) -> None:
        store = InMemorySecretStore()
        store.set("FORWARDAPI_API_KEY", "super-secret")

        self.assertEqual(store.status(["FORWARDAPI_API_KEY", "JFBYM_TOKEN"]), {
            "FORWARDAPI_API_KEY": True,
            "JFBYM_TOKEN": False,
        })
        self.assertNotIn("super-secret", json.dumps(store.status(["FORWARDAPI_API_KEY"])))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

    execution_mode: str = "real"
    api_prefix: str = "/api/v1"
    allowed_hosts: tuple[str, ...] = field(
        default=("127.0.0.1", "localhost", "testserver")
    )

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        normalized_root = Path(self.data_root).expanduser().resolve()
        object.__setattr__(self, "data_root", normalized_root)
        database_path = self.database_path or normalized_root / "workflow.db"
        object.__setattr__(self, "database_path", Path(database_path).expanduser().resolve())
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "master_summary_path",
            Path(self.master_summary_path).expanduser().resolve(),
        )
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "bitbrowser_executable",
            Path(self.bitbrowser_executable).expanduser().resolve(),
        )
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "bitbrowser_db_path",
            Path(self.bitbrowser_db_path).expanduser().resolve(),
        )

    @classmethod
    def from_environment(cls) -> AppConfig:
        data_root = Path(os.environ.get("TK_WORKFLOW_DATA_ROOT", str(DEFAULT_DATA_ROOT)))
        return cls(
            data_root=data_root,
            database_path=Path(os.environ["TK_WORKFLOW_DATABASE_PATH"])
            if os.environ.get("TK_WORKFLOW_DATABASE_PATH")
            else None,
            master_summary_path=Path(
                os.environ.get("TK_WORKFLOW_MASTER_SUMMARY", str(DEFAULT_MASTER_SUMMARY))
            ),
            bitbrowser_executable=Path(
                os.environ.get(
                    "TK_WORKFLOW_BITBROWSER_EXECUTABLE",
                    str(DEFAULT_BITBROWSER_EXECUTABLE),
                )
            ),
            bitbrowser_db_path=Path(
                os.environ.get("TK_WORKFLOW_BITBROWSER_DB", str(DEFAULT_BITBROWSER_DB))
            ),
            bitbrowser_base_url=os.environ.get(
                "TK_WORKFLOW_BITBROWSER_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:54345"
            ),
        )

    def default_settings(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {
            "data_root": str(self.data_root),
            "master_summary_path": str(self.master_summary_path),
            "provider": self.provider,
            "model": self.model,
            "wire_api": self.wire_api,
            "auto_category_threshold": self.auto_category_threshold,
            "worker_count": self.worker_count,
            "execution_mode": self.execution_mode,
        }

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import uuid
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import Any, Mapping, Protocol

from openpyxl import Workbook
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

from app.validation import PID_MAX_LENGTH, PID_MIN_LENGTH, PID_PATTERN

from app.services.exports import SUMMARY_HEADERS

from . import gpt55_clothing_select_and_collage as clothing
from . import gpt55_non_clothing_select_and_collage as non_clothing
from . import split_waiting_pid_folders_by_first_image as classifier

try:
    from app.services.workflow import WorkflowCancelled as _WorkflowCancelledBase
    from app.services.workflow import WorkflowExecutionError as _WorkflowExecutionErrorBase
except ImportError:  # Allow isolated use of the migrated scripts.
    _WorkflowCancelledBase = RuntimeError
    _WorkflowExecutionErrorBase = RuntimeError


_PID_PATTERN = PID_PATTERN
_SAFE_COMPONENT_PATTERN = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}")
_SECRET_ENV_NAMES = (
    "JFBYM_TOKEN",
    "FORWARDAPI_API_KEY",
    "FORWARDAPI_FALLBACK_API_KEY",
    "FORWARDAPI_BACKUP_API_KEY",
    "OPENAI_API_KEY",
)


class WorkflowContext(Protocol):
    batch: Mapping[str, Any]
    item: Mapping[str, Any]
    settings: Mapping[str, Any]
    secrets: Mapping[str, str]
    data_root: Path
    profile_id: str | None

    def report(
        self,
        stage: str,
        message: str,
        data: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None: ...

    def should_cancel(self) -> bool: ...

    def wait_if_paused(self) -> bool: ...


class WorkflowExecutionError(_WorkflowExecutionErrorBase):
    def __init__(self, code: str, user_message: str, detail: str | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(code, user_message)
        self.code = code
        self.user_message = user_message
        self.detail = detail


class WorkflowCancelled(_WorkflowCancelledBase):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__("The workflow item was cancelled.")
        self.code = "cancelled"
        self.user_message = "The workflow item was cancelled."


def _mapping_text(mapping: Mapping[str, Any], key: str, default: str = "") -> str:
    value = mapping.get(key, default)
    return str(value if value is not None else default).strip()


def _validate_identifiers(context: WorkflowContext) -> tuple[str, str]:
    batch_id = _mapping_text(context.batch, "id")
    pid = _mapping_text(context.item, "pid")
    if not _SAFE_COMPONENT_PATTERN.fullmatch(batch_id):
        raise WorkflowExecutionError("invalid_batch_id", "The batch identifier is invalid.")
    if not _PID_PATTERN.fullmatch(pid):
        raise WorkflowExecutionError(
            "invalid_pid",
            f"The product PID must contain {PID_MIN_LENGTH} to {PID_MAX_LENGTH} digits.",
        )
    return batch_id, pid


def _check_control(context: WorkflowContext) -> None:
    if context.should_cancel():
        raise WorkflowCancelled()
    if context.wait_if_paused() is False or context.should_cancel():
        raise WorkflowCancelled()


def _secret(context: WorkflowContext, name: str) -> str:
    return str(context.secrets.get(name) or "").strip()


def _redact(context: WorkflowContext, value: object) -> str:
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(value)).strip()
    for secret_value in context.secrets.values():
        if secret_value:
            text = text.replace(str(secret_value), "[redacted]")
    return text[:1000]


def _build_process_environment(context: WorkflowContext) -> dict[str, str]:
    environment = dict(os.environ)
    for name in _SECRET_ENV_NAMES:
        environment.pop(name, None)

    configured_values = {
        "JFBYM_TOKEN": _secret(context, "JFBYM_TOKEN"),
        "FORWARDAPI_API_KEY": _secret(context, "FORWARDAPI_API_KEY"),
        "FORWARDAPI_FALLBACK_API_KEY": _secret(context, "FORWARDAPI_FALLBACK_API_KEY"),
        "FORWARDAPI_BACKUP_API_KEY": _secret(context, "FORWARDAPI_BACKUP_API_KEY"),
        "OPENAI_API_KEY": _secret(context, "OPENAI_API_KEY"),
    }
    for name, value in configured_values.items():
        if value:
            environment[name] = value

    environment["FORWARDAPI_BASE_URL"] = _mapping_text(
        context.settings,
        "provider",
        "https://2999api.com/v1",
    )
    environment["FORWARDAPI_MODEL"] = _mapping_text(context.settings, "model", "gpt-5.5")
    environment["FORWARDAPI_WIRE_API"] = _mapping_text(context.settings, "wire_api", "responses")
    return environment


def _build_scraper_process(
    context: WorkflowContext,
    pid: str,
    output_root: Path,
    log_root: Path,
) -> tuple[list[str], dict[str, str]]:
    profile_id = str(context.profile_id or "").strip()
    if not profile_id:
        raise WorkflowExecutionError(
            "bitbrowser_profile_required",
            "Select an available BitBrowser profile before starting a real batch.",
        )

    scraper_path = Path(__file__).with_name(
        "bitbrowser_tiktok_image_scraper_local_jfbym_comments.py"
    ).resolve()
    command = [
        sys.executable,
        str(scraper_path),
        "--profile-id",
        profile_id,
        "--pid",
        pid,
        "--output-dir",
        str(output_root),
        "--results-csv",
        str(log_root / "scrape_results.csv"),
        "--log-file",
        str(log_root / "scrape.log"),
        "--summary-excel",
        str(output_root.parent / "product_summary.xlsx"),
    ]
    environment = _build_process_environment(context)
    for name in (
        "FORWARDAPI_API_KEY",
        "FORWARDAPI_FALLBACK_API_KEY",
        "FORWARDAPI_BACKUP_API_KEY",
        "OPENAI_API_KEY",
    ):
        environment.pop(name, None)
    return command, environment


def _run_process(
    context: WorkflowContext,
    command: list[str],
    environment: Mapping[str, str],
    log_path: Path,
) -> None:
    log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    creation_flags = subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW if os.name == "nt" else 0
    with log_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as log_handle:
        process = subprocess.Popen(
            command,
            shell=False,
            env=dict(environment),
            stdout=log_handle,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            creationflags=creation_flags,
        )
        while True:
            try:
                return_code = process.wait(timeout=0.25)
                break
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                try:
                    _check_control(context)
                except WorkflowCancelled:
                    process.terminate()
                    try:
                        process.wait(timeout=5)
                    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                        process.kill()
                        process.wait(timeout=5)
                    raise
    if return_code != 0:
        raise WorkflowExecutionError(
            "scrape_failed",
            "TikTok image collection failed. Review the item log and retry.",
            detail=f"scraper exited with code {return_code}",
        )


def _run_scraper(context: WorkflowContext, pid: str, output_root: Path, log_root: Path) -> Path:
    command, environment = _build_scraper_process(context, pid, output_root, log_root)
    _run_process(context, command, environment, log_root / "scrape_process.log")
    product_dir = output_root / pid
    if not product_dir.is_dir():
        raise WorkflowExecutionError(
            "scrape_output_missing",
            "Image collection completed without a product output folder.",
        )
    return product_dir


def close_batch_profiles(
    batch: Mapping[str, Any],
    settings: Mapping[str, Any],
) -> None:
    """Close only the BitBrowser profiles assigned to a finished batch."""
    profile_ids = list(
        dict.fromkeys(
            str(value).strip()
            for value in batch.get("profile_ids", [])
            if value
        )
    )
    if not profile_ids:
        return
    base_url = _mapping_text(settings, "bitbrowser_base_url", "http://127.0.0.1:54345")
    from . import bitbrowser_tiktok_image_scraper_local_jfbym as scraper

    for profile_id in profile_ids:
        scraper.close_bitbrowser_profile(base_url, profile_id)


def _api_channels(context: WorkflowContext) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    channels: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    channel_specs = (
        ("primary", "provider", "FORWARDAPI_API_KEY"),
        ("fallback", "fallback_provider", "FORWARDAPI_FALLBACK_API_KEY"),
        ("backup", "backup_provider", "FORWARDAPI_BACKUP_API_KEY"),
    )
    default_provider = "https://2999api.com/v1"
    model = _mapping_text(context.settings, "model", "gpt-5.5")
    wire_api = _mapping_text(context.settings, "wire_api", "responses")
    for label, provider_key, secret_key in channel_specs:
        base_url = _mapping_text(
            context.settings,
            provider_key,
            default_provider if label == "primary" else "",
        )
        api_key = _secret(context, secret_key)
        if base_url and api_key:
            channels.append(
                {
                    "label": label,
                    "base_url": base_url,
                    "api_key": api_key,
                    "model": model,
                    "wire_api": wire_api,
                }
            )
    if not channels:
        raise WorkflowExecutionError(
            "model_api_key_required",
            "Configure the model API key before starting a real batch.",
        )
    return channels


def _classify_real(
    context: WorkflowContext,
    pid: str,
    product_dir: Path,
) -> tuple[str, float, str]:
    item_category = _mapping_text(context.item, "category")
    if item_category in {"clothing", "non_clothing"}:
        return item_category, 1.0, "Category confirmed for this item."

    category_mode = _mapping_text(context.batch, "category_mode", "auto")
    if category_mode in {"clothing", "non_clothing"}:
        return category_mode, 1.0, "Category fixed by batch settings."

    candidate_images = classifier.list_candidate_images(product_dir)
    if not candidate_images:
        raise WorkflowExecutionError("no_candidate_images", "No usable product images were collected.")
    parsed = classifier.request_classification(
        pid=pid,
        first_image=candidate_images[0],
        channels=_api_channels(context),
        max_output_tokens=140,
        timeout=int(context.settings.get("model_timeout_seconds") or 180),
        image_max_side=768,
    )
    raw_category = str(parsed.get("product_type") or "").strip().lower()
    category = classifier.normalize_product_type(raw_category)
    confidence = classifier.normalize_confidence(parsed.get("confidence"))
    threshold = classifier.normalize_confidence(context.settings.get("auto_category_threshold", 0.8))
    if raw_category not in {"clothing", "non_clothing"} or confidence < threshold:
        raise WorkflowExecutionError(
            "category_review_required",
            "Automatic category confidence is too low. Confirm the category and retry.",
            detail=f"category={raw_category or 'unknown'}; confidence={confidence:.3f}",
        )
    return category, confidence, str(parsed.get("reason") or "").strip()


def _selection_args(context: WorkflowContext) -> SimpleNamespace:
    channels = _api_channels(context)
    primary = channels[0]
    fallback = channels[1] if len(channels) > 1 else None
    backup = channels[2] if len(channels) > 2 else None
    return SimpleNamespace(
        base_url=primary["base_url"],
        api_key=primary["api_key"],
        model=primary["model"],
        wire_api=primary["wire_api"],
        fallback_base_url=fallback["base_url"] if fallback else "",
        fallback_api_key=fallback["api_key"] if fallback else "",
        fallback_model=fallback["model"] if fallback else "",
        fallback_wire_api=fallback["wire_api"] if fallback else None,
        backup_base_url=backup["base_url"] if backup else "",
        backup_api_key=backup["api_key"] if backup else "",
        backup_model=backup["model"] if backup else "",
        backup_wire_api=backup["wire_api"] if backup else None,
        timeout=int(context.settings.get("model_timeout_seconds") or 180),
        image_max_side=512,
    )


def _generate_mock_images(product_dir: Path, pid: str) -> list[Path]:
    product_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    colors = ((35, 91, 120), (191, 72, 52), (58, 128, 92), (214, 164, 55), (95, 79, 141))
    generated: list[Path] = []
    for index, color in enumerate(colors, start=1):
        path = product_dir / f"{index:02d}_{'main' if index == 1 else 'detail'}.jpg"
        image = Image.new("RGB", (900, 1200), color)
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image)
        draw.rectangle((70, 80, 830, 1120), outline=(245, 245, 245), width=8)
        draw.text((100, 100), f"PID {pid} / image {index}", fill=(255, 255, 255))
        image.save(path, format="JPEG", quality=90)
        generated.append(path)
    (product_dir / "product.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"pid": pid, "title": "Mock product", "description": "Mock run"}, indent=2),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (product_dir / "description.txt").write_text("Mock product description\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (product_dir / "comments.txt").write_text("Mock customer comment\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (product_dir / "comments.json").write_text(
        json.dumps([{"text": "Mock customer comment"}], indent=2),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    return generated


def _create_mock_summary(path: Path, pid: str) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    workbook = Workbook()
    worksheet = workbook.active
    worksheet.title = "products"
    worksheet.append(SUMMARY_HEADERS)
    worksheet.append((pid, "Mock product", "Mock product description", "Mock customer comment"))
    workbook.save(path)
    workbook.close()


def _select_and_render(
    context: WorkflowContext,
    product_dir: Path,
    pid: str,
    category: str,
    mock: bool,
) -> tuple[Any, list[Path], Path, Path, Path, Path]:
    module = clothing if category == "clothing" else non_clothing
    candidates = module.list_candidate_images(product_dir)
    if not candidates:
        raise WorkflowExecutionError("no_candidate_images", "No usable candidate images are available.")
    selection = (
        module.choose_local_fallback(pid, candidates)
        if mock
        else module.request_selection_with_fallback(pid, candidates, _selection_args(context))
    )
    if not selection.selected_images:
        raise WorkflowExecutionError("selection_empty", "The model did not select any usable images.")

    selected_dir = module.copy_selected_images(product_dir, f"_selected_{category}", selection.selected_images)
    manifest_path = module.write_manifest(
        product_dir,
        pid,
        selection,
        [path.name for path in candidates],
    )
    preview_path = module.create_selected_preview(product_dir, selection.selected_images, 1920)
    final_path = module.create_final_collage(product_dir, pid, selection.selected_images, 1920)
    return selection, candidates, selected_dir, manifest_path, preview_path, final_path


def _archive_existing(path: Path, item_root: Path) -> None:
    if not path.exists():
        return
    archive_root = item_root / "archive" / str(time.time_ns())
    archive_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    path.replace(archive_root / path.name)


def _publish_directory(
    source_files: list[Path],
    destination: Path,
    item_root: Path,
    source_root: Path | None = None,
) -> None:
    temporary = item_root / f".publish-{destination.name}-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
    temporary.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    try:
        for source in source_files:
            relative_path = source.relative_to(source_root) if source_root is not None else Path(source.name)
            target = temporary / relative_path
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(source, target)
        _archive_existing(destination, item_root)
        temporary.replace(destination)
    except Exception:
        if temporary.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(temporary)
        raise


def _publish_file(source: Path, destination: Path, item_root: Path) -> None:
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = destination.with_name(f".{destination.name}.{uuid.uuid4().hex}.tmp")
    shutil.copy2(source, temporary)
    try:
        _archive_existing(destination, item_root)
        temporary.replace(destination)
    except Exception:
        temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        raise


def execute_item(context: WorkflowContext) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Execute one PID through scrape, classify, select, collage, and publish."""
    _check_control(context)
    batch_id, pid = _validate_identifiers(context)
    data_root = Path(context.data_root).resolve()
    item_root = data_root / "batches" / batch_id / "items" / pid
    attempt = max(0, int(context.item.get("attempt") or 0)) + 1
    run_root = item_root / "runs" / f"attempt-{attempt}-{time.time_ns()}"
    source_root = run_root / "source"
    log_root = run_root / "logs"

  Batch,
  BatchAction,
  BatchDetail,
  BrowserProfile,
  ExportInfo,
  ImportPreview,
  Preflight,
  ProfilesResponse,
  Settings,
  WorkflowEvent,
  WorkflowItem,
} from './types'

const API_BASE = '/api/v1'

export class ApiError extends Error {
  status: number

  constructor(message: string, status: number) {
    super(message)
    this.name = 'ApiError'
    this.status = status
  }
}

function unwrap<T>(payload: unknown): T {
  if (payload && typeof payload === 'object') {
    const record = payload as Record<string, unknown>
    if ('success' in record && 'data' in record) return record.data as T
    if (Object.keys(record).length === 1 && 'data' in record) return record.data as T
  }
  return payload as T
}

export function listFrom<T>(payload: unknown): T[] {
  const value = unwrap<unknown>(payload)
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value as T[]
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return []
  const record = value as Record<string, unknown>
  if (Array.isArray(record.items)) return record.items as T[]
  if (Array.isArray(record.data)) return record.data as T[]
  if (record.data && typeof record.data === 'object' && Array.isArray((record.data as Record<string, unknown>).items)) {
    return (record.data as { items: T[] }).items
  }
  return []
}

async function request<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const headers = new Headers(init?.headers)
  if (init?.body && !(init.body instanceof FormData)) headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json')
  headers.set('Accept', 'application/json')

  let response: Response
  try {
    response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, { ...init, headers })
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError('鏃犳硶杩炴帴鏈湴鏈嶅姟锛岃纭鏈嶅姟宸茬粡鍚姩銆?, 0)
  }

  const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || ''
  const payload = contentType.includes('json') ? await response.json() : await response.text()
  if (!response.ok) {
    const record = payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload as Record<string, unknown> : null
    const nestedError = record?.error && typeof record.error === 'object' ? record.error as Record<string, unknown> : null
    const message = record?.detail ?? record?.message ?? nestedError?.message ?? record?.error ?? payload
    throw new ApiError(typeof message === 'string' && message ? message : `璇锋眰澶辫触 (${response.status})`, response.status)
  }
  return unwrap<T>(payload)
}

function normalizeBatch(value: Batch | (Partial<Batch> & { id: string; name: string; status: string })): Batch {
  const record = value as Batch & { succeeded?: number }
  return {
    ...record,
    category: record.category ?? record.category_mode ?? 'auto',
    total: Number(record.total ?? 0),
    completed: Number(record.completed ?? record.succeeded ?? 0),
    failed: Number(record.failed ?? 0),
  }
}

function normalizeSettings(value: Settings): Settings {
  let storedProfiles: string[] = []
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('tk-workflow-profile-ids')
    storedProfiles = saved ? JSON.parse(saved) as string[] : []
  } catch {
    storedProfiles = []
  }
  return {
    ...value,
    provider_base_url: value.provider_base_url ?? value.provider,
    confidence_threshold: value.confidence_threshold ?? value.auto_category_threshold,
    product_summary_path: value.product_summary_path ?? value.summary_path ?? value.master_summary_path,
    profile_ids: value.profile_ids ?? storedProfiles,
  }
}

function normalizeItem(value: WorkflowItem): WorkflowItem {
  const artifactUrl = value.artifact_path
    ? `/api/v1/artifacts?path=${encodeURIComponent(value.artifact_path)}`
    : undefined
  return {
    ...value,
    error: value.error ?? value.error_message,
    collage_url: value.collage_url ?? artifactUrl,
  }
}

function normalizeDetail(payload: BatchDetail | Batch): BatchDetail {
  if ('batch' in payload) {
    const stats = payload.stats ?? {}
    return {
      ...payload,
      batch: normalizeBatch({
        ...payload.batch,
        total: payload.batch.total ?? stats.total ?? 0,
        completed: payload.batch.completed ?? stats.succeeded ?? stats.completed ?? 0,
        failed: payload.batch.failed ?? stats.failed ?? 0,
      }),
      items: (Array.isArray(payload.items) ? payload.items : listFrom<WorkflowItem>((payload as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).items)).map(normalizeItem),
      export: payload.export ? { ...payload.export, path: payload.export.path ?? payload.export.manifest_path, count: payload.export.count ?? payload.export.pid_count } : undefined,
    }
  }
  return { batch: normalizeBatch(payload), items: [] }
}

export const api = {
  async preflight(): Promise<Preflight> {
    const value = await request<Preflight>('/system/preflight')
    return { ...value, checks: (value.checks ?? []).map((check) => ({ ...check, key: check.key ?? check.id ?? check.label })) }
  },

  async listBatches(): Promise<Batch[]> {
    return listFrom<Batch>(await request<unknown>('/batches')).map(normalizeBatch)
  },

  async getBatch(id: string): Promise<BatchDetail> {
    const detail = normalizeDetail(await request<BatchDetail | Batch>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`))
    const [items, events] = await Promise.allSettled([
      request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/items`),
      request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/events`),
    ])
    return {
      ...detail,
      items: items.status === 'fulfilled' ? listFrom<WorkflowItem>(items.value).map(normalizeItem) : detail.items,
      events: events.status === 'fulfilled' ? listFrom<WorkflowEvent>(events.value) : detail.events ?? [],
    }
  },

  previewImport(input: { text?: string; file?: File }): Promise<ImportPreview> {
    if (input.file) {
      const body = new FormData()
      body.append('file', input.file)
      return request('/imports/preview-file', { method: 'POST', body })
    }
    return request('/imports/preview', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ text: input.text ?? '' }) })
  },

  async createBatch(input: { name: string; category: string; pids: string[]; worker_count?: number; profile_ids?: string[] }): Promise<Batch> {
    const value = await request<Batch>('/batches', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        name: input.name,
        category_mode: input.category,
        pids: input.pids,
        worker_count: input.worker_count ?? 3,
        profile_ids: input.profile_ids ?? [],
      }),
    })
    return normalizeBatch(value)
  },

  controlBatch(id: string, action: BatchAction): Promise<Batch | BatchDetail> {
    return request(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/${action}`, { method: 'POST' })
  },

  startBatch(id: string) {
    return this.controlBatch(id, 'start')
  },

  retryFailed(id: string): Promise<Batch | BatchDetail> {
    return request(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/retry-failed`, { method: 'POST' })
  },

  async getSettings(): Promise<Settings> {
    return normalizeSettings(await request<Settings>('/settings'))
  },
  async updateSettings(settings: Settings): Promise<Settings> {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('tk-workflow-profile-ids', JSON.stringify(settings.profile_ids ?? []))
    } catch {
      // The server settings still save when browser storage is unavailable.
    }
    const value = await request<Settings>('/settings', {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        execution_mode: settings.execution_mode,
        provider: settings.provider_base_url ?? settings.provider,
        model: settings.model,
        wire_api: settings.wire_api,
        auto_category_threshold: settings.confidence_threshold ?? settings.auto_category_threshold,
        worker_count: settings.worker_count,
        master_summary_path: settings.product_summary_path ?? settings.summary_path ?? settings.master_summary_path,
        master_summary_mirror_path: settings.master_summary_mirror_path,
      }),
    })
    return normalizeSettings({ ...value, profile_ids: settings.profile_ids })
  },
  setSecret: (name: string, value: string) => request<{ configured: boolean }>(`/secrets/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    body: JSON.stringify({ value }),
  }),

  async getProfiles(): Promise<ProfilesResponse> {
    const value = await request<ProfilesResponse | BrowserProfile[]>('/integrations/bitbrowser/profiles')
    return Array.isArray(value) ? { online: true, items: value } : { ...value, items: listFrom<BrowserProfile>(value) }
  },

  async exportBatch(id: string): Promise<ExportInfo> {
    const value = await request<ExportInfo>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/export`, { method: 'POST' })
    return {
      path: value.path ?? value.manifest_path ?? '',
      count: value.count ?? value.pid_count ?? 0,
    }
  },
  confirmIntegration: (id: string, kind: string, confirmed: boolean) => request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/confirmations`, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({ kind, confirmed }),
  }),
  updateItemCategory: (itemId: string, category: 'clothing' | 'non_clothing') => request<WorkflowItem>(`/items/${encodeURIComponent(itemId)}/category`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    body: JSON.stringify({ category }),
  }),
}

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, SecretStr, field_validator

from app.validation import PID_PATTERN, PID_REQUIREMENT


class StrictModel(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", str_strip_whitespace=True)


class PreviewTextRequest(StrictModel):
    text: str = Field(max_length=1_048_576)


class CreateBatchRequest(StrictModel):
    name: str = Field(default="鏈懡鍚嶆壒娆?, min_length=1, max_length=100)
    pids: list[str] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=10_000)
    category_mode: Literal["auto", "clothing", "non_clothing"] = "auto"
    worker_count: int = Field(default=3, ge=1, le=3)
    profile_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=3)

    @field_validator("pids")
    @classmethod
    def validate_pids(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        normalized = [value.strip() for value in values]
        invalid = [value for value in normalized if not PID_PATTERN.fullmatch(value)]
        if invalid:
            raise ValueError(PID_REQUIREMENT)
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))

    @field_validator("profile_ids")
    @classmethod
    def validate_profiles(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        normalized = [value.strip() for value in values]
        if any(not value or len(value) > 255 for value in normalized):
            raise ValueError("BitBrowser 閰嶇疆 ID 鏃犳晥")
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))


class SettingsUpdateRequest(StrictModel):
    data_root: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    master_summary_path: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    master_summary_mirror_path: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    provider: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    model: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=100)
    wire_api: Literal["responses"] | None = None
    auto_category_threshold: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=1)
    worker_count: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1, le=3)
    execution_mode: Literal["real", "mock"] | None = None

    @field_validator("data_root", "master_summary_path", "master_summary_mirror_path")
    @classmethod
    def validate_absolute_path(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is not None and not Path(value).expanduser().is_absolute():
            raise ValueError("蹇呴』浣跨敤缁濆璺緞")
        return value

    @field_validator("master_summary_path", "master_summary_mirror_path")
    @classmethod
    def validate_summary_workbook(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is not None and Path(value).suffix.casefold() != ".xlsx":
            raise ValueError("鍟嗗搧姹囨€荤洰鏍囧繀椤绘槸 .xlsx 鏂囦欢")
        return value

    @field_validator("provider")
    @classmethod
    def validate_provider(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is None:
            return value
        parsed = urlsplit(value)
        if parsed.scheme != "https" or not parsed.hostname or parsed.username or parsed.password:
            raise ValueError("妯″瀷鏈嶅姟鍦板潃蹇呴』鏄?HTTPS URL")
        return value.rstrip("/")


class SecretUpdateRequest(StrictModel):

export type BatchAction = 'start' | 'pause' | 'resume' | 'cancel'
import type {
  Batch,
  BatchAction,
  BatchDetail,
  BrowserProfile,
  ExportInfo,
  ImportPreview,
  Preflight,
  ProfilesResponse,
  Settings,
  WorkflowEvent,
  WorkflowItem,
} from './types'

const API_BASE = '/api/v1'

export class ApiError extends Error {
  status: number

  constructor(message: string, status: number) {
    super(message)
    this.name = 'ApiError'
    this.status = status
  }
}

function unwrap<T>(payload: unknown): T {
  if (payload && typeof payload === 'object') {
    const record = payload as Record<string, unknown>
    if ('success' in record && 'data' in record) return record.data as T
    if (Object.keys(record).length === 1 && 'data' in record) return record.data as T
  }
  return payload as T
}

export function listFrom<T>(payload: unknown): T[] {
  const value = unwrap<unknown>(payload)
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value as T[]
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return []
  const record = value as Record<string, unknown>
  if (Array.isArray(record.items)) return record.items as T[]
  if (Array.isArray(record.data)) return record.data as T[]
  if (record.data && typeof record.data === 'object' && Array.isArray((record.data as Record<string, unknown>).items)) {
    return (record.data as { items: T[] }).items
  }
  return []
}

async function request<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const headers = new Headers(init?.headers)
  if (init?.body && !(init.body instanceof FormData)) headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json')
  headers.set('Accept', 'application/json')

  let response: Response
  try {
    response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, { ...init, headers })
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError('鏃犳硶杩炴帴鏈湴鏈嶅姟锛岃纭鏈嶅姟宸茬粡鍚姩銆?, 0)
  }

  const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || ''
  const payload = contentType.includes('json') ? await response.json() : await response.text()
  if (!response.ok) {
    const record = payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload as Record<string, unknown> : null
    const nestedError = record?.error && typeof record.error === 'object' ? record.error as Record<string, unknown> : null
    const message = record?.detail ?? record?.message ?? nestedError?.message ?? record?.error ?? payload
    throw new ApiError(typeof message === 'string' && message ? message : `璇锋眰澶辫触 (${response.status})`, response.status)
  }
  return unwrap<T>(payload)
}

function normalizeBatch(value: Batch | (Partial<Batch> & { id: string; name: string; status: string })): Batch {
  const record = value as Batch & { succeeded?: number }
  return {
    ...record,
    category: record.category ?? record.category_mode ?? 'auto',
    total: Number(record.total ?? 0),
    completed: Number(record.completed ?? record.succeeded ?? 0),
    failed: Number(record.failed ?? 0),
  }
}

function normalizeSettings(value: Settings): Settings {
  let storedProfiles: string[] = []
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('tk-workflow-profile-ids')
    storedProfiles = saved ? JSON.parse(saved) as string[] : []
  } catch {
    storedProfiles = []
  }
  return {
    ...value,
    provider_base_url: value.provider_base_url ?? value.provider,
    confidence_threshold: value.confidence_threshold ?? value.auto_category_threshold,
    product_summary_path: value.product_summary_path ?? value.summary_path ?? value.master_summary_path,
    profile_ids: value.profile_ids ?? storedProfiles,
  }
}

function normalizeItem(value: WorkflowItem): WorkflowItem {
  const artifactUrl = value.artifact_path
    ? `/api/v1/artifacts?path=${encodeURIComponent(value.artifact_path)}`
    : undefined
  return {
    ...value,
    error: value.error ?? value.error_message,
    collage_url: value.collage_url ?? artifactUrl,
  }
}

function normalizeDetail(payload: BatchDetail | Batch): BatchDetail {
  if ('batch' in payload) {
    const stats = payload.stats ?? {}
    return {
      ...payload,
      batch: normalizeBatch({
        ...payload.batch,
        total: payload.batch.total ?? stats.total ?? 0,
        completed: payload.batch.completed ?? stats.succeeded ?? stats.completed ?? 0,
        failed: payload.batch.failed ?? stats.failed ?? 0,
      }),
      items: (Array.isArray(payload.items) ? payload.items : listFrom<WorkflowItem>((payload as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).items)).map(normalizeItem),
      export: payload.export ? { ...payload.export, path: payload.export.path ?? payload.export.manifest_path, count: payload.export.count ?? payload.export.pid_count } : undefined,
    }
  }
  return { batch: normalizeBatch(payload), items: [] }
}

export const api = {
  async preflight(): Promise<Preflight> {
    const value = await request<Preflight>('/system/preflight')
    return { ...value, checks: (value.checks ?? []).map((check) => ({ ...check, key: check.key ?? check.id ?? check.label })) }
  },

  async listBatches(): Promise<Batch[]> {
    return listFrom<Batch>(await request<unknown>('/batches')).map(normalizeBatch)
  },

  async getBatch(id: string): Promise<BatchDetail> {
    const payload = await request<BatchDetail | Batch>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`)
    const detail = normalizeDetail(payload)
    const record = payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload as unknown as Record<string, unknown> : {}
    const hasEmbeddedItems = Array.isArray(record.items)
      && (record.items.length > 0 || 'events' in record)
    const hasEmbeddedEvents = Array.isArray(record.events)
    const itemsRequest = hasEmbeddedItems
      ? null
      : request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/items`)
    const eventsRequest = hasEmbeddedEvents
      ? null
      : request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/events`)
    const [items, events] = await Promise.allSettled([
      itemsRequest ?? Promise.resolve(null),
      eventsRequest ?? Promise.resolve(null),
    ])
    return {
      ...detail,
      items: itemsRequest && items.status === 'fulfilled'
        ? listFrom<WorkflowItem>(items.value).map(normalizeItem)
        : detail.items,
      events: eventsRequest && events.status === 'fulfilled'
        ? listFrom<WorkflowEvent>(events.value)
        : detail.events ?? [],
    }
  },

  previewImport(input: { text?: string; file?: File }): Promise<ImportPreview> {
    if (input.file) {
      const body = new FormData()
      body.append('file', input.file)
      return request('/imports/preview-file', { method: 'POST', body })
    }
    return request('/imports/preview', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ text: input.text ?? '' }) })
  },

  async createBatch(input: { name: string; category: string; pids: string[]; worker_count?: number; profile_ids?: string[] }): Promise<Batch> {
    const value = await request<Batch>('/batches', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        name: input.name,
        category_mode: input.category,
        pids: input.pids,
        worker_count: input.worker_count ?? 3,
        profile_ids: input.profile_ids ?? [],
      }),
    })
    return normalizeBatch(value)
  },

  controlBatch(id: string, action: BatchAction): Promise<Batch | BatchDetail> {
    return request(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/${action}`, { method: 'POST' })
  },

  startBatch(id: string) {
    return this.controlBatch(id, 'start')
  },

  retryFailed(id: string): Promise<Batch | BatchDetail> {
    return request(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/retry-failed`, { method: 'POST' })
  },

  async getSettings(): Promise<Settings> {
    return normalizeSettings(await request<Settings>('/settings'))
  },
  async updateSettings(settings: Settings): Promise<Settings> {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('tk-workflow-profile-ids', JSON.stringify(settings.profile_ids ?? []))
    } catch {
      // The server settings still save when browser storage is unavailable.
    }
    const value = await request<Settings>('/settings', {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        execution_mode: settings.execution_mode,
        provider: settings.provider_base_url ?? settings.provider,
        model: settings.model,
        wire_api: settings.wire_api,
        auto_category_threshold: settings.confidence_threshold ?? settings.auto_category_threshold,
        worker_count: settings.worker_count,
        master_summary_path: settings.product_summary_path ?? settings.summary_path ?? settings.master_summary_path,
        master_summary_mirror_path: settings.master_summary_mirror_path,
      }),
    })
    return normalizeSettings({ ...value, profile_ids: settings.profile_ids })
  },
  setSecret: (name: string, value: string) => request<{ configured: boolean }>(`/secrets/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    body: JSON.stringify({ value }),
  }),

  async getProfiles(): Promise<ProfilesResponse> {
    const value = await request<ProfilesResponse | BrowserProfile[]>('/integrations/bitbrowser/profiles')
    return Array.isArray(value) ? { online: true, items: value } : { ...value, items: listFrom<BrowserProfile>(value) }
  },

  async exportBatch(id: string): Promise<ExportInfo> {
    const value = await request<ExportInfo>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/export`, { method: 'POST' })
    return {
      path: value.path ?? value.manifest_path ?? '',
      count: value.count ?? value.pid_count ?? 0,
    }
  },
  confirmIntegration: (id: string, kind: string, confirmed: boolean) => request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/confirmations`, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({ kind, confirmed }),
  }),
  updateItemCategory: (itemId: string, category: 'clothing' | 'non_clothing') => request<WorkflowItem>(`/items/${encodeURIComponent(itemId)}/category`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    body: JSON.stringify({ category }),
  }),
}

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, SecretStr, field_validator

from app.validation import PID_PATTERN, PID_REQUIREMENT


class StrictModel(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", str_strip_whitespace=True)


class PreviewTextRequest(StrictModel):
    text: str = Field(max_length=1_048_576)


class CreateBatchRequest(StrictModel):
    name: str = Field(default="鏈懡鍚嶆壒娆?, min_length=1, max_length=100)
    pids: list[str] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=10_000)
    category_mode: Literal["auto", "clothing", "non_clothing"] = "auto"
    worker_count: int = Field(default=3, ge=1, le=3)
    profile_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=3)

    @field_validator("pids")
    @classmethod
    def validate_pids(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        normalized = [value.strip() for value in values]
        invalid = [value for value in normalized if not PID_PATTERN.fullmatch(value)]
        if invalid:
            raise ValueError(PID_REQUIREMENT)
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))

    @field_validator("profile_ids")
    @classmethod
    def validate_profiles(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        normalized = [value.strip() for value in values]
        if any(not value or len(value) > 255 for value in normalized):
            raise ValueError("BitBrowser 閰嶇疆 ID 鏃犳晥")
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))


class SettingsUpdateRequest(StrictModel):
    data_root: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    master_summary_path: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    master_summary_mirror_path: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    provider: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    model: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=100)
    wire_api: Literal["responses"] | None = None
    auto_category_threshold: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=1)
    worker_count: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1, le=3)
    execution_mode: Literal["real", "mock"] | None = None

    @field_validator("data_root", "master_summary_path", "master_summary_mirror_path")
    @classmethod
    def validate_absolute_path(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is not None and not Path(value).expanduser().is_absolute():
            raise ValueError("蹇呴』浣跨敤缁濆璺緞")
        return value

    @field_validator("master_summary_path", "master_summary_mirror_path")
    @classmethod
    def validate_summary_workbook(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is not None and Path(value).suffix.casefold() != ".xlsx":
            raise ValueError("鍟嗗搧姹囨€荤洰鏍囧繀椤绘槸 .xlsx 鏂囦欢")
        return value

    @field_validator("provider")
    @classmethod
    def validate_provider(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is None:
            return value
        parsed = urlsplit(value)
        if parsed.scheme != "https" or not parsed.hostname or parsed.username or parsed.password:
            raise ValueError("妯″瀷鏈嶅姟鍦板潃蹇呴』鏄?HTTPS URL")
        return value.rstrip("/")


class SecretUpdateRequest(StrictModel):
    value: SecretStr = Field(min_length=1, max_length=8192)


class ConfirmationRequest(StrictModel):
    kind: Literal[
        "feishu_marked", "jspace_products_uploaded", "jspace_raw_uploaded"
    ]
    confirmed: bool


class CategoryConfirmationRequest(StrictModel):
    category: Literal["clothing", "non_clothing"]

  Batch,
  BatchAction,
  BatchDetail,
  BrowserProfile,
  ExportInfo,
  GalleryPid,
  GalleryResponse,
  GallerySyncResult,
  ImportPreview,
  Preflight,
  ProfilesResponse,
  Settings,
  WorkflowEvent,
  WorkflowItem,
} from './types'

const API_BASE = '/api/v1'

export class ApiError extends Error {
  status: number

  constructor(message: string, status: number) {
    super(message)
    this.name = 'ApiError'
    this.status = status
  }
}

function unwrap<T>(payload: unknown): T {
  if (payload && typeof payload === 'object') {
    const record = payload as Record<string, unknown>
    if ('success' in record && 'data' in record) return record.data as T
    if (Object.keys(record).length === 1 && 'data' in record) return record.data as T
  }
  return payload as T
}

export function listFrom<T>(payload: unknown): T[] {
  const value = unwrap<unknown>(payload)
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value as T[]
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return []
  const record = value as Record<string, unknown>
  if (Array.isArray(record.items)) return record.items as T[]
  if (Array.isArray(record.data)) return record.data as T[]
  if (record.data && typeof record.data === 'object' && Array.isArray((record.data as Record<string, unknown>).items)) {
    return (record.data as { items: T[] }).items
  }
  return []
}

async function request<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const headers = new Headers(init?.headers)
  if (init?.body && !(init.body instanceof FormData)) headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json')
  headers.set('Accept', 'application/json')

  let response: Response
  try {
    response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, { ...init, headers })
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError('鏃犳硶杩炴帴鏈湴鏈嶅姟锛岃纭鏈嶅姟宸茬粡鍚姩銆?, 0)
  }

  const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || ''
  const payload = contentType.includes('json') ? await response.json() : await response.text()
  if (!response.ok) {
    const record = payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload as Record<string, unknown> : null
    const nestedError = record?.error && typeof record.error === 'object' ? record.error as Record<string, unknown> : null
    const message = record?.detail ?? record?.message ?? nestedError?.message ?? record?.error ?? payload
    throw new ApiError(typeof message === 'string' && message ? message : `璇锋眰澶辫触 (${response.status})`, response.status)
  }
  return unwrap<T>(payload)
}

function normalizeBatch(value: Batch | (Partial<Batch> & { id: string; name: string; status: string })): Batch {
  const record = value as Batch & { succeeded?: number }
  return {
    ...record,
    category: record.category ?? record.category_mode ?? 'auto',
    total: Number(record.total ?? 0),
    completed: Number(record.completed ?? record.succeeded ?? 0),
    failed: Number(record.failed ?? 0),
  }
}

function normalizeSettings(value: Settings): Settings {
  let storedProfiles: string[] = []
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('tk-workflow-profile-ids')
    storedProfiles = saved ? JSON.parse(saved) as string[] : []
  } catch {
    storedProfiles = []
  }
  return {
    ...value,
    provider_base_url: value.provider_base_url ?? value.provider,
    confidence_threshold: value.confidence_threshold ?? value.auto_category_threshold,
    product_summary_path: value.product_summary_path ?? value.summary_path ?? value.master_summary_path,
    profile_ids: value.profile_ids ?? storedProfiles,
  }
}

function normalizeItem(value: WorkflowItem): WorkflowItem {
  const artifactUrl = value.artifact_path
    ? `/api/v1/artifacts?path=${encodeURIComponent(value.artifact_path)}`
    : undefined
  return {
    ...value,
    error: value.error ?? value.error_message,
    collage_url: value.collage_url ?? artifactUrl,
  }
}

function normalizeDetail(payload: BatchDetail | Batch): BatchDetail {
  if ('batch' in payload) {
    const stats = payload.stats ?? {}
    return {
      ...payload,
      batch: normalizeBatch({
        ...payload.batch,
        total: payload.batch.total ?? stats.total ?? 0,
        completed: payload.batch.completed ?? stats.succeeded ?? stats.completed ?? 0,
        failed: payload.batch.failed ?? stats.failed ?? 0,
      }),
      items: (Array.isArray(payload.items) ? payload.items : listFrom<WorkflowItem>((payload as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).items)).map(normalizeItem),
      export: payload.export ? { ...payload.export, path: payload.export.path ?? payload.export.manifest_path, count: payload.export.count ?? payload.export.pid_count } : undefined,
    }
  }
  return { batch: normalizeBatch(payload), items: [] }
}

function normalizeGalleryItem(value: GalleryPid): GalleryPid {
  const record = value as GalleryPid & { image_count?: number; count?: number; path?: string; collage_path?: string }
  return {
    ...record,

export const api = {
  async preflight(): Promise<Preflight> {
    const value = await request<Preflight>('/system/preflight')
    return { ...value, checks: (value.checks ?? []).map((check) => ({ ...check, key: check.key ?? check.id ?? check.label })) }
  },

  async listBatches(): Promise<Batch[]> {
    return listFrom<Batch>(await request<unknown>('/batches')).map(normalizeBatch)
  },

  async listGallery(input: { query?: string; category?: string; limit?: number; offset?: number } = {}): Promise<GalleryResponse> {
    const params = new URLSearchParams()
    if (input.query?.trim()) params.set('query', input.query.trim())
    if (input.category && input.category !== 'all') params.set('category', input.category)
    params.set('limit', String(input.limit ?? 100))
    params.set('offset', String(input.offset ?? 0))
    const suffix = params.toString()
    const value = await request<GalleryResponse | GalleryPid[] | { items?: GalleryPid[]; total?: number; limit?: number; offset?: number; stats?: GalleryResponse['stats'] }>(`/gallery${suffix ? `?${suffix}` : ''}`)
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return { items: value.map(normalizeGalleryItem), total: value.length, limit: input.limit ?? 100, offset: input.offset ?? 0 }
    return {
      ...value,
      items: Array.isArray(value.items) ? value.items.map(normalizeGalleryItem) : [],
      total: Number(value.total ?? value.items?.length ?? 0),
      limit: Number(value.limit ?? input.limit ?? 100),
      offset: Number(value.offset ?? input.offset ?? 0),
    }
  },

  syncGallery(): Promise<GallerySyncResult> {
    return request<GallerySyncResult>('/gallery/sync-jspace', { method: 'POST' })

      body: JSON.stringify({ category }),
    }))
  },

  async getBatch(id: string): Promise<BatchDetail> {
    const payload = await request<BatchDetail | Batch>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`)
    const detail = normalizeDetail(payload)
    const record = payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload as unknown as Record<string, unknown> : {}
    const hasEmbeddedItems = Array.isArray(record.items)
      && (record.items.length > 0 || 'events' in record)
    const hasEmbeddedEvents = Array.isArray(record.events)
    const itemsRequest = hasEmbeddedItems
      ? null
      : request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/items`)
    const eventsRequest = hasEmbeddedEvents
      ? null
      : request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/events`)
    const [items, events] = await Promise.allSettled([
      itemsRequest ?? Promise.resolve(null),
      eventsRequest ?? Promise.resolve(null),
    ])
    return {
      ...detail,
      items: itemsRequest && items.status === 'fulfilled'
        ? listFrom<WorkflowItem>(items.value).map(normalizeItem)
        : detail.items,
      events: eventsRequest && events.status === 'fulfilled'
        ? listFrom<WorkflowEvent>(events.value)
        : detail.events ?? [],
    }
  },

  previewImport(input: { text?: string; file?: File }): Promise<ImportPreview> {
    if (input.file) {

      body.append('file', input.file)
      return request('/imports/preview-file', { method: 'POST', body })
    }

+const PREFLIGHT_INTERVAL_MS = 60_000
+const PREFLIGHT_CACHE_KEY = 'tk-workflow-preflight-cache'
+
+function readCachedPreflight(): Preflight | null {
+  try {
+    const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(PREFLIGHT_CACHE_KEY)
+    if (!raw) return null
+    const cached = JSON.parse(raw) as { checkedAt?: number; value?: Preflight }
+    if (!cached.checkedAt || !cached.value || Date.now() - cached.checkedAt >= PREFLIGHT_INTERVAL_MS) return null
+    return cached.value
+  } catch {
+    return null
+  }
+}
+
+function writeCachedPreflight(value: Preflight): void {
+  try {
+    sessionStorage.setItem(PREFLIGHT_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ checkedAt: Date.now(), value }))
+  } catch {
+    // The network check still works when browser storage is unavailable.
+  }
+}

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, SecretStr, field_validator

from app.validation import PID_PATTERN, PID_REQUIREMENT


class StrictModel(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", str_strip_whitespace=True)


class PreviewTextRequest(StrictModel):
    text: str = Field(max_length=1_048_576)


class CreateBatchRequest(StrictModel):
    name: str = Field(default="鏈懡鍚嶆壒娆?, min_length=1, max_length=100)
    pids: list[str] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=10_000)
    category_mode: Literal["auto", "clothing", "non_clothing"] = "auto"
    worker_count: int = Field(default=3, ge=1, le=3)
    profile_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=3)

    @field_validator("pids")
    @classmethod
    def validate_pids(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        normalized = [value.strip() for value in values]
        invalid = [value for value in normalized if not PID_PATTERN.fullmatch(value)]
        if invalid:
            raise ValueError(PID_REQUIREMENT)
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))

    @field_validator("profile_ids")
    @classmethod
    def validate_profiles(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        normalized = [value.strip() for value in values]
        if any(not value or len(value) > 255 for value in normalized):
            raise ValueError("BitBrowser 閰嶇疆 ID 鏃犳晥")
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))


class SettingsUpdateRequest(StrictModel):
    data_root: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    master_summary_path: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    master_summary_mirror_path: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    provider: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    model: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=100)
    wire_api: Literal["responses"] | None = None
    auto_category_threshold: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=1)
    worker_count: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1, le=3)
    execution_mode: Literal["real", "mock"] | None = None

    @field_validator("data_root", "master_summary_path", "master_summary_mirror_path")
    @classmethod
    def validate_absolute_path(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is not None and not Path(value).expanduser().is_absolute():
            raise ValueError("蹇呴』浣跨敤缁濆璺緞")
        return value

    @field_validator("master_summary_path", "master_summary_mirror_path")
    @classmethod
    def validate_summary_workbook(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is not None and Path(value).suffix.casefold() != ".xlsx":
            raise ValueError("鍟嗗搧姹囨€荤洰鏍囧繀椤绘槸 .xlsx 鏂囦欢")
        return value

    @field_validator("provider")
    @classmethod
    def validate_provider(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is None:
            return value
        parsed = urlsplit(value)
        if parsed.scheme != "https" or not parsed.hostname or parsed.username or parsed.password:
            raise ValueError("妯″瀷鏈嶅姟鍦板潃蹇呴』鏄?HTTPS URL")
        return value.rstrip("/")


class SecretUpdateRequest(StrictModel):
    value: SecretStr = Field(min_length=1, max_length=8192)


class ConfirmationRequest(StrictModel):
    kind: Literal[
        "feishu_marked", "jspace_products_uploaded", "jspace_raw_uploaded"
    ]
    confirmed: bool


class CategoryConfirmationRequest(StrictModel):
    category: Literal["clothing", "non_clothing"]


class GalleryImportItem(StrictModel):
    pid: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=64)
    category: Literal["cap", "tap", "unknown"] = "unknown"
    source_path: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=1000)
    artifact_path: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=1000)

    @field_validator("pid")
    @classmethod
    def validate_pid(cls, value: str) -> str:
        normalized = value.strip()
        if not PID_PATTERN.fullmatch(normalized):
            raise ValueError(PID_REQUIREMENT)
        return normalized


class GalleryImportRequest(StrictModel):
    items: list[GalleryImportItem] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100_000)


class GalleryCheckPidsRequest(StrictModel):
    pids: list[str] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100_000)

    @field_validator("pids")
    @classmethod
    def validate_pids(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        normalized = [value.strip() for value in values]
        invalid = [value for value in normalized if not PID_PATTERN.fullmatch(value)]
        if invalid:
            raise ValueError(PID_REQUIREMENT)
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))


class GalleryCategoryUpdateRequest(StrictModel):
    category: Literal["cap", "tap", "unknown"]
