  Batch,
  BatchAction,
  BatchDetail,
  BrowserProfile,
  ExportInfo,
  GalleryPid,
  GalleryResponse,
  GallerySyncResult,
  ImportPreview,
  Preflight,
  ProfilesResponse,
  Settings,
  WorkflowEvent,
  WorkflowItem,
} from './types'

const API_BASE = '/api/v1'

export class ApiError extends Error {
  status: number

  constructor(message: string, status: number) {
    super(message)
    this.name = 'ApiError'
    this.status = status
  }
}

function unwrap<T>(payload: unknown): T {
  if (payload && typeof payload === 'object') {
    const record = payload as Record<string, unknown>
    if ('success' in record && 'data' in record) return record.data as T
    if (Object.keys(record).length === 1 && 'data' in record) return record.data as T
  }
  return payload as T
}

export function listFrom<T>(payload: unknown): T[] {
  const value = unwrap<unknown>(payload)
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value as T[]
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return []
  const record = value as Record<string, unknown>
  if (Array.isArray(record.items)) return record.items as T[]
  if (Array.isArray(record.data)) return record.data as T[]
  if (record.data && typeof record.data === 'object' && Array.isArray((record.data as Record<string, unknown>).items)) {
    return (record.data as { items: T[] }).items
  }
  return []
}

async function request<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const headers = new Headers(init?.headers)
  if (init?.body && !(init.body instanceof FormData)) headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json')
  headers.set('Accept', 'application/json')

  let response: Response
  try {
    response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, { ...init, headers })
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError('鏃犳硶杩炴帴鏈湴鏈嶅姟锛岃纭鏈嶅姟宸茬粡鍚姩銆?, 0)
  }

  const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || ''
  const payload = contentType.includes('json') ? await response.json() : await response.text()
  if (!response.ok) {
    const record = payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload as Record<string, unknown> : null
    const nestedError = record?.error && typeof record.error === 'object' ? record.error as Record<string, unknown> : null
    const message = record?.detail ?? record?.message ?? nestedError?.message ?? record?.error ?? payload
    throw new ApiError(typeof message === 'string' && message ? message : `璇锋眰澶辫触 (${response.status})`, response.status)
  }
  return unwrap<T>(payload)
}

function normalizeBatch(value: Batch | (Partial<Batch> & { id: string; name: string; status: string })): Batch {
  const record = value as Batch & { succeeded?: number }
  return {
    ...record,
    category: record.category ?? record.category_mode ?? 'auto',
    total: Number(record.total ?? 0),
    completed: Number(record.completed ?? record.succeeded ?? 0),
    failed: Number(record.failed ?? 0),
  }
}

function normalizeSettings(value: Settings): Settings {
  let storedProfiles: string[] = []
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('tk-workflow-profile-ids')
    storedProfiles = saved ? JSON.parse(saved) as string[] : []
  } catch {
    storedProfiles = []
  }
  return {
    ...value,
    provider_base_url: value.provider_base_url ?? value.provider,
    confidence_threshold: value.confidence_threshold ?? value.auto_category_threshold,
    product_summary_path: value.product_summary_path ?? value.summary_path ?? value.master_summary_path,
    profile_ids: value.profile_ids ?? storedProfiles,
  }
}

function normalizeItem(value: WorkflowItem): WorkflowItem {
  const artifactUrl = value.artifact_path
    ? `/api/v1/artifacts?path=${encodeURIComponent(value.artifact_path)}`
    : undefined
  return {
    ...value,
    error: value.error ?? value.error_message,
    collage_url: value.collage_url ?? artifactUrl,
  }
}

function normalizeDetail(payload: BatchDetail | Batch): BatchDetail {
  if ('batch' in payload) {
    const stats = payload.stats ?? {}
    return {
      ...payload,
      batch: normalizeBatch({
        ...payload.batch,
        total: payload.batch.total ?? stats.total ?? 0,
        completed: payload.batch.completed ?? stats.succeeded ?? stats.completed ?? 0,
        failed: payload.batch.failed ?? stats.failed ?? 0,
      }),
      items: (Array.isArray(payload.items) ? payload.items : listFrom<WorkflowItem>((payload as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).items)).map(normalizeItem),
      export: payload.export ? { ...payload.export, path: payload.export.path ?? payload.export.manifest_path, count: payload.export.count ?? payload.export.pid_count } : undefined,
    }
  }
  return { batch: normalizeBatch(payload), items: [] }
}

function normalizeGalleryItem(value: GalleryPid): GalleryPid {
  const record = value as GalleryPid & { image_count?: number; count?: number; path?: string; collage_path?: string }
  return {
    ...record,
    pid: String(record.pid ?? ''),
    image_count: Number(record.image_count ?? record.count ?? 0),
    source_path: record.source_path ?? record.path,
    artifact_path: record.artifact_path ?? record.collage_path,
  }
}

export const api = {
  async preflight(): Promise<Preflight> {
    const value = await request<Preflight>('/system/preflight')
    return { ...value, checks: (value.checks ?? []).map((check) => ({ ...check, key: check.key ?? check.id ?? check.label })) }
  },

  async listBatches(): Promise<Batch[]> {
    return listFrom<Batch>(await request<unknown>('/batches')).map(normalizeBatch)
  },

  async listGallery(input: { query?: string; category?: string; limit?: number; offset?: number } = {}): Promise<GalleryResponse> {
    const params = new URLSearchParams()
    if (input.query?.trim()) params.set('query', input.query.trim())
    if (input.category && input.category !== 'all') params.set('category', input.category)
    params.set('limit', String(input.limit ?? 100))
    params.set('offset', String(input.offset ?? 0))
    const suffix = params.toString()
    const value = await request<GalleryResponse | GalleryPid[] | { items?: GalleryPid[]; total?: number; limit?: number; offset?: number; stats?: GalleryResponse['stats'] }>(`/gallery${suffix ? `?${suffix}` : ''}`)
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return { items: value.map(normalizeGalleryItem), total: value.length, limit: input.limit ?? 100, offset: input.offset ?? 0 }
    return {
      ...value,
      items: Array.isArray(value.items) ? value.items.map(normalizeGalleryItem) : [],
      total: Number(value.total ?? value.items?.length ?? 0),
      limit: Number(value.limit ?? input.limit ?? 100),
      offset: Number(value.offset ?? input.offset ?? 0),
    }
  },

  syncGallery(): Promise<GallerySyncResult> {
    return request<GallerySyncResult>('/gallery/sync-jspace', { method: 'POST' })
  },

  async updateGalleryCategory(pid: string, category: string): Promise<GalleryPid> {
    return normalizeGalleryItem(await request<GalleryPid>(`/gallery/${encodeURIComponent(pid)}`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: JSON.stringify({ category }),
    }))
  },

  async getBatch(id: string): Promise<BatchDetail> {
    const payload = await request<BatchDetail | Batch>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`)
    const detail = normalizeDetail(payload)
    const record = payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload as unknown as Record<string, unknown> : {}
    const hasEmbeddedItems = Array.isArray(record.items)
      && (record.items.length > 0 || 'events' in record)
    const hasEmbeddedEvents = Array.isArray(record.events)
    const itemsRequest = hasEmbeddedItems
      ? null
      : request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/items`)
    const eventsRequest = hasEmbeddedEvents
      ? null
      : request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/events`)
    const [items, events] = await Promise.allSettled([
      itemsRequest ?? Promise.resolve(null),
      eventsRequest ?? Promise.resolve(null),
    ])
    return {
      ...detail,
      items: itemsRequest && items.status === 'fulfilled'
        ? listFrom<WorkflowItem>(items.value).map(normalizeItem)
        : detail.items,
      events: eventsRequest && events.status === 'fulfilled'
        ? listFrom<WorkflowEvent>(events.value)
        : detail.events ?? [],
    }
  },

  previewImport(input: { text?: string; file?: File }): Promise<ImportPreview> {
    if (input.file) {
      const body = new FormData()
      body.append('file', input.file)
      return request('/imports/preview-file', { method: 'POST', body })
    }
    return request('/imports/preview', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ text: input.text ?? '' }) })
  },

  async createBatch(input: { name: string; category: string; pids: string[]; worker_count?: number; profile_ids?: string[] }): Promise<Batch> {
    const value = await request<Batch>('/batches', {
      method: 'POST',

  async getSettings(): Promise<Settings> {
    return normalizeSettings(await request<Settings>('/settings'))
  },
  async updateSettings(settings: Settings): Promise<Settings> {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('tk-workflow-profile-ids', JSON.stringify(settings.profile_ids ?? []))
    } catch {
      // The server settings still save when browser storage is unavailable.
    }
    const value = await request<Settings>('/settings', {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        execution_mode: settings.execution_mode,
        provider: settings.provider_base_url ?? settings.provider,
        model: settings.model,
        wire_api: settings.wire_api,
        auto_category_threshold: settings.confidence_threshold ?? settings.auto_category_threshold,
        worker_count: settings.worker_count,
        master_summary_path: settings.product_summary_path ?? settings.summary_path ?? settings.master_summary_path,
        master_summary_mirror_path: settings.master_summary_mirror_path,
      }),
    })
    return normalizeSettings({ ...value, profile_ids: settings.profile_ids })
  },
  setSecret: (name: string, value: string) => request<{ configured: boolean }>(`/secrets/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    body: JSON.stringify({ value }),
  }),

  async getProfiles(): Promise<ProfilesResponse> {
    const value = await request<ProfilesResponse | BrowserProfile[]>('/integrations/bitbrowser/profiles')
    return Array.isArray(value) ? { online: true, items: value } : { ...value, items: listFrom<BrowserProfile>(value) }
  },

  async exportBatch(id: string): Promise<ExportInfo> {
    const value = await request<ExportInfo>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/export`, { method: 'POST' })
    return {
      ...value,
      path: value.path ?? value.manifest_path ?? '',
      count: value.count ?? value.pid_count ?? 0,
    }
  },
  confirmIntegration: (id: string, kind: string, confirmed: boolean) => request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/confirmations`, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({ kind, confirmed }),
  }),
  updateItemCategory: (itemId: string, category: 'clothing' | 'non_clothing') => request<WorkflowItem>(`/items/${encodeURIComponent(itemId)}/category`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    body: JSON.stringify({ category }),
  }),
}

  21: export class ApiError extends Error {

  24:   constructor(message: string, status: number) {

  26:     this.name = 'ApiError'

  31: function unwrap<T>(payload: unknown): T {
  32:   if (payload && typeof payload === 'object') {
  33:     const record = payload as Record<string, unknown>
  34:     if ('success' in record && 'data' in record) return record.data as T
  35:     if (Object.keys(record).length === 1 && 'data' in record) return record.data as T
  36:   }
  37:   return payload as T
  38: }

  40: export function listFrom<T>(payload: unknown): T[] {
  41:   const value = unwrap<unknown>(payload)
  42:   if (Array.isArray(value)) return value as T[]
  43:   if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return []
  44:   const record = value as Record<string, unknown>
  45:   if (Array.isArray(record.items)) return record.items as T[]
  46:   if (Array.isArray(record.data)) return record.data as T[]
  47:   if (record.data && typeof record.data === 'object' && Array.isArray((record.data as Record<string, unknown>).items)) {
  48:     return (record.data as { items: T[] }).items
  49:   }
  50:   return []
  51: }

  53: async function request<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  54:   const headers = new Headers(init?.headers)
  55:   if (init?.body && !(init.body instanceof FormData)) headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json')
  56:   headers.set('Accept', 'application/json')
  57: 
  58:   let response: Response
  59:   try {
  60:     response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, { ...init, headers })
  61:   } catch {
  62:     throw new ApiError('鏃犳硶杩炴帴鏈湴鏈嶅姟锛岃纭鏈嶅姟宸茬粡鍚姩銆?, 0)
  63:   }
  64: 
  65:   const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || ''
  66:   const payload = contentType.includes('json') ? await response.json() : await response.text()
  67:   if (!response.ok) {
  68:     const record = payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload as Record<string, unknown> : null
  69:     const nestedError = record?.error && typeof record.error === 'object' ? record.error as Record<string, unknown> : null
  70:     const message = record?.detail ?? record?.message ?? nestedError?.message ?? record?.error ?? payload
  71:     throw new ApiError(typeof message === 'string' && message ? message : `璇锋眰澶辫触 (${response.status})`, response.status)
  72:   }
  73:   return unwrap<T>(payload)
  74: }

  76: function normalizeBatch(value: Batch | (Partial<Batch> & { id: string; name: string; status: string })): Batch {
  77:   const record = value as Batch & { succeeded?: number }
  78:   return {
  79:     ...record,
  80:     category: record.category ?? record.category_mode ?? 'auto',
  81:     total: Number(record.total ?? 0),
  82:     completed: Number(record.completed ?? record.succeeded ?? 0),
  83:     failed: Number(record.failed ?? 0),
  84:   }
  85: }

  87: function normalizeSettings(value: Settings): Settings {
  88:   let storedProfiles: string[] = []
  89:   try {
  90:     const saved = localStorage.getItem('tk-workflow-profile-ids')
  91:     storedProfiles = saved ? JSON.parse(saved) as string[] : []
  92:   } catch {
  93:     storedProfiles = []
  94:   }
  95:   return {
  96:     ...value,
  97:     provider_base_url: value.provider_base_url ?? value.provider,
  98:     confidence_threshold: value.confidence_threshold ?? value.auto_category_threshold,
  99:     product_summary_path: value.product_summary_path ?? value.summary_path ?? value.master_summary_path,
 100:     profile_ids: value.profile_ids ?? storedProfiles,

 125:       }),
 126:       items: (Array.isArray(payload.items) ? payload.items : listFrom<WorkflowItem>((payload as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).items)).map(normalizeItem),
 127:       export: payload.export ? { ...payload.export, path: payload.export.path ?? payload.export.manifest_path, count: payload.export.count ?? payload.export.pid_count } : undefined,
 128:     }
 129:   }
 130:   return { batch: normalizeBatch(payload), items: [] }
 131: }

 196:     const itemsRequest = hasEmbeddedItems

 199:     const eventsRequest = hasEmbeddedEvents

 202:     const [items, events] = await Promise.allSettled([
 203:       itemsRequest ?? Promise.resolve(null),
 204:       eventsRequest ?? Promise.resolve(null),

   88: def _validate_identifiers(context: WorkflowContext) -> tuple[str, str]:
   89:     batch_id = _mapping_text(context.batch, "id")

   93:     if not _PID_PATTERN.fullmatch(pid):

   97:         )
   98:     return batch_id, pid

  112: def _redact(context: WorkflowContext, value: object) -> str:

  407:                 if str(worksheet.cell(row=row_index, column=1).value or "").strip() == pid

  411:         values = (pid, "Mock product", "Mock product description", "Mock customer comment")

  449: def _archive_existing(path: Path, item_root: Path) -> None:

  452:     archive_root = item_root / "archive" / str(time.time_ns())

  457: def _publish_directory(
  458:     source_files: list[Path],
  459:     destination: Path,
  460:     item_root: Path,
  461:     source_root: Path | None = None,
  462: ) -> None:
  463:     temporary = item_root / f".publish-{destination.name}-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
  464:     temporary.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
  465:     try:
  466:         for source in source_files:
  467:             relative_path = source.relative_to(source_root) if source_root is not None else Path(source.name)
  468:             target = temporary / relative_path
  469:             target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
  470:             shutil.copy2(source, target)
  471:         _archive_existing(destination, item_root)
  472:         temporary.replace(destination)
  473:     except Exception:
  474:         if temporary.exists():
  475:             shutil.rmtree(temporary)
  476:         raise
  477: 
  478: 
  479: def _publish_file(source: Path, destination: Path, item_root: Path) -> None:
  480:     destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
  481:     temporary = destination.with_name(f".{destination.name}.{uuid.uuid4().hex}.tmp")
  482:     shutil.copy2(source, temporary)
  483:     try:
  484:         _archive_existing(destination, item_root)
  485:         temporary.replace(destination)
  486:     except Exception:
  487:         temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
  488:         raise

+def _backup_database_for_gallery_switch(
+    database: Database,
+    *,
+    backup_root: Path,
+    job_id: str,
+) -> Path:
+    normalized_job_id = str(job_id).strip().casefold()
+    if len(normalized_job_id) != 32 or any(
+        character not in "0123456789abcdef" for character in normalized_job_id
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("迁移任务 ID 无效")
+    directory = Path(backup_root).expanduser().resolve()
+    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    timestamp = datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
+    destination = directory / (
+        f"workflow_before_original_switch_{timestamp}_{normalized_job_id[:12]}.db"
+    )
+    target = sqlite3.connect(destination)
+    try:
+        with database.connect() as source:
+            source.backup(target)
+        integrity = target.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()
+        if integrity is None or str(integrity[0]).casefold() != "ok":
+            raise RuntimeError("图库切换前数据库备份校验失败")
+        target.commit()
+    finally:
+        target.close()
+    return destination
+

import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, SecretStr, field_validator

from app.validation import PID_PATTERN, PID_REQUIREMENT

BITBROWSER_PROFILE_ID_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$")
BITBROWSER_PROFILE_ID_REQUIREMENT = (
    "BitBrowser 閰嶇疆 ID 鍙兘鍖呭惈瀛楁瘝銆佹暟瀛椼€佷笅鍒掔嚎鍜岃繛瀛楃"
)


class StrictModel(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", str_strip_whitespace=True)


class PreviewTextRequest(StrictModel):
    text: str = Field(max_length=1_048_576)


class CreateBatchRequest(StrictModel):
    name: str = Field(default="鏈懡鍚嶆壒娆?, min_length=1, max_length=100)
    pids: list[str] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=10_000)
    category_mode: Literal["auto", "clothing", "non_clothing"] = "auto"
    worker_count: int = Field(default=3, ge=1, le=3)
    profile_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=3)

    @field_validator("pids")
    @classmethod
    def validate_pids(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        normalized = [value.strip() for value in values]
        invalid = [value for value in normalized if not PID_PATTERN.fullmatch(value)]
        if invalid:
            raise ValueError(PID_REQUIREMENT)
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))

    @field_validator("profile_ids")
    @classmethod
    def validate_profiles(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        normalized = [value.strip() for value in values]
        if any(
            not BITBROWSER_PROFILE_ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(value) for value in normalized
        ):
            raise ValueError(BITBROWSER_PROFILE_ID_REQUIREMENT)
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))


class SettingsUpdateRequest(StrictModel):
    data_root: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    master_summary_path: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    master_summary_mirror_path: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    provider: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    model: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=100)
    wire_api: Literal["responses"] | None = None
    auto_category_threshold: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=1)
    worker_count: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1, le=3)
    profile_ids: list[str] | None = Field(default=None, max_length=3)
    execution_mode: Literal["real", "mock"] | None = None

    @field_validator("profile_ids")
    @classmethod
    def validate_profile_ids(cls, values: list[str] | None) -> list[str] | None:
        if values is None:
            return None
        normalized = [value.strip() for value in values]
        if any(
            not BITBROWSER_PROFILE_ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(value) for value in normalized
        ):
            raise ValueError(BITBROWSER_PROFILE_ID_REQUIREMENT)
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))

    @field_validator("data_root", "master_summary_path", "master_summary_mirror_path")
    @classmethod
    def validate_absolute_path(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is not None and not Path(value).expanduser().is_absolute():
            raise ValueError("蹇呴』浣跨敤缁濆璺緞")
        return value

    @field_validator("master_summary_path", "master_summary_mirror_path")
    @classmethod
    def validate_summary_workbook(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is not None and Path(value).suffix.casefold() != ".xlsx":
            raise ValueError("鍟嗗搧姹囨€荤洰鏍囧繀椤绘槸 .xlsx 鏂囦欢")
        return value

    @field_validator("provider")
    @classmethod
    def validate_provider(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is None:
            return value
        parsed = urlsplit(value)
        if parsed.scheme != "https" or not parsed.hostname or parsed.username or parsed.password:
            raise ValueError("妯″瀷鏈嶅姟鍦板潃蹇呴』鏄?HTTPS URL")
        return value.rstrip("/")


class SecretUpdateRequest(StrictModel):
    value: SecretStr = Field(min_length=1, max_length=8192)


class ConfirmationRequest(StrictModel):
    kind: Literal[
        "feishu_marked", "jspace_products_uploaded", "jspace_raw_uploaded"
    ]
    confirmed: bool


class CategoryConfirmationRequest(StrictModel):
    category: Literal["clothing", "non_clothing"]


class GalleryImportItem(StrictModel):
    pid: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=64)
    category: Literal["cap", "tap", "unknown"] = "unknown"
    source_path: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=1000)
    artifact_path: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=1000)

    @field_validator("pid")
    @classmethod
    def validate_pid(cls, value: str) -> str:
        normalized = value.strip()
        if not PID_PATTERN.fullmatch(normalized):
            raise ValueError(PID_REQUIREMENT)
        return normalized


class GalleryImportRequest(StrictModel):
    items: list[GalleryImportItem] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100_000)


class GalleryCheckPidsRequest(StrictModel):
    pids: list[str] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100_000)

    @field_validator("pids")
    @classmethod
    def validate_pids(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        normalized = [value.strip() for value in values]
        invalid = [value for value in normalized if not PID_PATTERN.fullmatch(value)]
        if invalid:
            raise ValueError(PID_REQUIREMENT)
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))


class GalleryCategoryUpdateRequest(StrictModel):
    category: Literal["cap", "tap", "unknown"]


class OriginalGalleryDiscoverRequest(StrictModel):
    source_roots: list[str] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)
    target_root: Literal["/sata11/public/鏂板獟浣撻儴/鍘熷浘"] = "/sata11/public/鏂板獟浣撻儴/鍘熷浘"

    @field_validator("source_roots")
    @classmethod
    def validate_source_roots(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        normalized: list[str] = []
        for value in values:
            path = "/" + str(value).strip().replace("\\", "/").strip("/")
            parts = path.split("/")[1:]
            if any(not part or part in {".", ".."} for part in parts):
                raise ValueError("鏋佺┖闂存簮鐩綍蹇呴』鏄鑼冪殑缁濆璺緞")
            if not path.startswith("/sata11/public/鏂板獟浣撻儴/"):
                raise ValueError("鏋佺┖闂存簮鐩綍蹇呴』浣嶄簬鏂板獟浣撻儴鐩綍涓?)
            normalized.append(path)
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))


class OriginalGalleryCopyRequest(StrictModel):
    max_pids: int = Field(default=20, ge=1, le=100)

+                        b"1735555346702436306\n"
+                        b"1735537002372433336\n"

+    def test_gallery_check_file_exports_a_downloadable_two_sheet_workbook(self) -> None:
+        self.client.post(
+            "/api/v1/gallery/import",
+            json={
+                "items": [
+                    {"pid": "1736250849091618684", "category": "cap"},

+                ]
+            },

+        response = self.client.post(
+            "/api/v1/gallery/check-file",
+            files={
+                "file": (
+                    "pids.txt",
+                    b"1736250849091618684\n1731846642408588819\n",
+                    "text/plain",
+                )
+            },
+        )
+
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
+        result = response.json()["data"]
+        self.assertEqual(result["counts"]["exported"], 2)
+        self.assertTrue(result["download_url"].startswith("/api/v1/artifacts?path="))
+
+        downloaded = self.client.get(result["download_url"])

const BACKGROUND_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS = 60_000
const PREFLIGHT_CACHE_TTL_MS = 15 * 60_000
const PREFLIGHT_CACHE_KEY = 'tk-workflow-preflight-cache'

function readCachedPreflight(): Preflight | null {
  try {
    const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(PREFLIGHT_CACHE_KEY)
    if (!raw) return null
    const cached = JSON.parse(raw) as { checkedAt?: number; value?: Preflight }
    if (!cached.checkedAt || !cached.value || Date.now() - cached.checkedAt >= PREFLIGHT_CACHE_TTL_MS) return null
    return cached.value
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

function writeCachedPreflight(value: Preflight): void {
  try {
    sessionStorage.setItem(PREFLIGHT_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ checkedAt: Date.now(), value }))
  } catch {
    // The network check still works when browser storage is unavailable.
  }
}

function withBitBrowserResult(
  current: Preflight | null,
  result: { online: boolean; items: BrowserProfile[] },
): Preflight | null {
  if (!current) return null
  const checks = current.checks.map((check) => {
    const isBitBrowser = check.key === 'bitbrowser_api' || check.id === 'bitbrowser_api'
    return isBitBrowser
      ? { ...check, status: result.online ? 'ok' : 'warning', detail: result.online ? '鍦ㄧ嚎' : '绂荤嚎' }
      : check
  })
  const hasBlockingCheck = checks.some((check) => ['blocked', 'error'].includes(check.status))
  const hasWarning = checks.some((check) => !['ready', 'ok'].includes(check.status))
  return {
    ...current,
    checks,
    profiles: result.items,
    overall: hasBlockingCheck ? 'blocked' : hasWarning ? 'warning' : 'ready',
  }
}

const DEFAULT_SETTINGS: Settings = {
  execution_mode: 'real',
  provider_base_url: 'https://2999api.com/v1',
  model: 'gpt-5.5',
  wire_api: 'responses',
  confidence_threshold: 0.8,
  worker_count: 3,
  profile_ids: [],
  product_summary_path: '',
  secret_status: {},
}

type ViewTab = 'items' | 'logs' | 'delivery'

function errorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : '鎿嶄綔澶辫触锛岃绋嶅悗閲嶈瘯銆?
}

function statusTone(status?: string): string {
  if (['ready', 'ok', 'success', 'succeeded', 'completed'].includes(status ?? '')) return 'success'
  if (['warning', 'paused', 'queued', 'pending', 'draft'].includes(status ?? '')) return 'warning'
  if (['error', 'failed', 'blocked', 'missing', 'offline', 'cancelled'].includes(status ?? '')) return 'danger'
  if (['running', 'processing'].includes(status ?? '')) return 'active'
  return 'neutral'
}

function workflowStageLabel(stage?: string): string {
  const normalized = String(stage ?? '').toLowerCase()
  if (!normalized || normalized === 'pending') return '绛夊緟鎶撳彇'
  if (normalized.includes('scrape') || normalized.includes('download')) return '鎶撳彇鍘熷浘'
  if (normalized.includes('archive')) return '鏁寸悊褰掓。'
  if (normalized.includes('complete')) return '杩滅楠岃瘉瀹屾垚'
  if (normalized.includes('classify') || normalized.includes('select') || normalized.includes('collage')) return '鍘嗗彶娴佺▼璁板綍'
  return statusLabel(stage) === '鏈煡' ? stage ?? '绛夊緟鍒嗛厤' : statusLabel(stage)
}

function batchKindLabel(category?: string): string {
  if (!category || category === 'auto') return '鍘熷浘褰掓。'
  return `鍘嗗彶${categoryLabel(category)}`
}

function StatusBadge({ status, text }: { status?: string; text?: string }) {
  return (
    <span className={`status-badge status-${statusTone(status)}`}>
      <span className="status-dot" aria-hidden="true" />
      {text ?? statusLabel(status)}
    </span>
  )
}

function EmptyState({ title, detail, onAction }: { title: string; detail: string; onAction?: () => void }) {
  return (
    <div className="empty-state">
      <div className="empty-icon"><Images size={24} /></div>
      <strong>{title}</strong>
      <p>{detail}</p>
      {onAction && <button className="button button-primary" onClick={onAction}><Plus size={16} />瀵煎叆 PID</button>}
    </div>
  )
}

function ImportDialog({ onClose, onCreated, settings }: { onClose: () => void; onCreated: (batch: Batch) => void; settings: Settings }) {
  const [name, setName] = useState('')
  const [text, setText] = useState('')
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | undefined>()
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<ImportPreview | null>(null)
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState('')
  const nameRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    nameRef.current?.focus()
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') onClose()
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown)
  }, [onClose])

  const validate = async () => {
    setBusy(true)
    setError('')
    try {
      const local = file ? null : parsePidInput(text)
      if (!file && !local?.validPids.length && !local?.invalid.length) throw new Error('璇峰厛绮樿创 PID 鎴栭€夋嫨 Excel 鏂囦欢銆?)
      setPreview(await api.previewImport(file ? { file } : { text }))
    } catch (reason) {
      setError(errorMessage(reason))
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }

  const create = async () => {
    if (!preview?.valid_pids.length) return
    setBusy(true)
    setError('')
    try {
      const batch = await api.createBatch({
        name: name.trim() || '鏈懡鍚嶆壒娆?,
        category: 'auto',
        pids: preview.valid_pids,
        worker_count: settings.worker_count ?? 3,
        profile_ids: settings.profile_ids ?? [],
      })
      onCreated(batch)
      onClose()
    } catch (reason) {
      setError(errorMessage(reason))
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="overlay" role="presentation" onMouseDown={(event) => event.target === event.currentTarget && onClose()}>
      <section className="dialog import-dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="import-title">
        <header className="dialog-header">
          <div>
            <span className="eyebrow">NEW BATCH</span>
            <h2 id="import-title">瀵煎叆 PID</h2>
          </div>
          <button className="icon-button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="鍏抽棴瀵煎叆绐楀彛" title="鍏抽棴"><X size={18} /></button>
        </header>

        <div className="dialog-body">
          <label className="field">
            <span>鎵规鍚嶇О</span>
            <input ref={nameRef} value={name} onChange={(event) => setName(event.target.value)} placeholder="渚嬪锛? 鏈?21 鏃ヤ笂鏂? />
          </label>

          <label className="field">
            <span>绮樿创 PID</span>
            <textarea value={text} onChange={(event) => { setText(event.target.value); setPreview(null) }} rows={7} placeholder={'姣忚涓€涓?PID锛屼篃鏀寔绌烘牸銆侀€楀彿鍒嗛殧\n1234567890123456789'} />
          </label>

          <div className="import-divider"><span>鎴?/span></div>

          <label className={`file-drop ${file ? 'has-file' : ''}`}>
            <input type="file" accept=".xlsx" onChange={(event) => { setFile(event.target.files?.[0]); setPreview(null) }} />
            <FileSpreadsheet size={22} />
            <span><strong>{file?.name ?? '閫夋嫨 Excel (.xlsx)'}</strong><small>{file ? `${Math.ceil(file.size / 1024)} KB` : '绯荤粺浼氳嚜鍔ㄨ瘑鍒?PID 鍒楀苟鍘婚噸'}</small></span>
            <Upload size={17} />
          </label>

          {preview && (
            <div className="preview-strip" aria-live="polite">
              <span className="preview-good"><CheckCircle2 size={16} />鏈夋晥 {preview.valid_pids.length}</span>
              <span><RotateCcw size={16} />閲嶅 {preview.duplicates.length}</span>
              <span className={preview.invalid.length ? 'preview-bad' : ''}><AlertTriangle size={16} />鏃犳晥 {preview.invalid.length}</span>
              <span className="preview-total">鎬昏 {preview.total}</span>
            </div>
          )}
          {error && <div className="inline-alert danger" role="alert"><XCircle size={16} />{error}</div>}
        </div>

        <footer className="dialog-footer">
          <button className="button button-quiet" onClick={onClose}>鍙栨秷</button>
          {!preview ? (
            <button className="button button-primary" disabled={busy} onClick={validate}>
              {busy ? <LoaderCircle className="spin" size={16} /> : <Check size={16} />}鏍￠獙 PID
            </button>
          ) : (
            <button className="button button-primary" disabled={busy || preview.valid_pids.length === 0} onClick={create}>
              {busy ? <LoaderCircle className="spin" size={16} /> : <Plus size={16} />}鍒涘缓鎵规
            </button>
          )}
        </footer>
      </section>
    </div>
  )
}

function SettingsDrawer({
  initial,
  profiles,
  profilesOnline,
  profilesRefreshing,
  onRefreshProfiles,
  onClose,
  onSaved,
}: {
  initial: Settings
  profiles: BrowserProfile[]
  profilesOnline: boolean
  profilesRefreshing: boolean
  onRefreshProfiles: () => void
  onClose: () => void
  onSaved: (settings: Settings) => void
}) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState<Settings>({ ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, ...initial })
  const [captchaToken, setCaptchaToken] = useState('')
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('')
  const titleRef = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    titleRef.current?.focus()
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => event.key === 'Escape' && onClose()
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown)
  }, [onClose])

  const update = <K extends keyof Settings>(key: K, value: Settings[K]) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: value }))
  const toggleProfile = (id: string) => {
    const current = form.profile_ids ?? []
    if (current.includes(id)) update('profile_ids', current.filter((profileId) => profileId !== id))
    else if (current.length < 3) update('profile_ids', [...current, id])
  }

  const save = async () => {
    setBusy(true)
    setMessage('')
    try {
      const saved = await api.updateSettings(form)
      const secretUpdates: Promise<unknown>[] = []
      if (captchaToken.trim()) secretUpdates.push(api.setSecret('JFBYM_TOKEN', captchaToken.trim()))
      await Promise.all(secretUpdates)
      onSaved({ ...form, ...saved })
      setCaptchaToken('')
      setMessage('璁剧疆宸蹭繚瀛橈紝瀵嗛挜涓嶄細鍦ㄩ〉闈㈠洖鏄俱€?)
    } catch (reason) {
      setMessage(errorMessage(reason))
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }

  const secrets = form.secret_status ?? initial.secret_status ?? {}
  const tokenReady = Boolean(secrets.JFBYM_TOKEN ?? secrets.yunma_token ?? secrets.captcha_token)

  return (
    <div className="drawer-layer" role="presentation" onMouseDown={(event) => event.target === event.currentTarget && onClose()}>
      <aside className="settings-drawer" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="settings-title">
        <header className="dialog-header drawer-header">
          <div>
            <span className="eyebrow">LOCAL CONFIGURATION</span>
            <h2 id="settings-title" ref={titleRef} tabIndex={-1}>绯荤粺璁剧疆</h2>
          </div>
          <button className="icon-button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="鍏抽棴璁剧疆" title="鍏抽棴"><X size={18} /></button>
        </header>

        <div className="drawer-content">
          <ExecutionModeControl value={form.execution_mode ?? 'real'} onChange={(value) => update('execution_mode', value)} />

          <section className="settings-section">
            <div className="section-heading"><KeyRound size={17} /><div><h3>楠岃瘉鐮佹湇鍔?/h3><p>浜戠爜 Token 鍙啓鍏ユ湰鏈哄畨鍏ㄩ厤缃?/p></div></div>
            {form.execution_mode === 'real' && !tokenReady && <div className="inline-alert danger"><ShieldAlert size={16} />鏈厤缃柊浜戠爜 Token锛岀郴缁熷皢闃绘鐪熷疄浠诲姟鍚姩銆?/div>}
            <label className="field secret-field">
              <span>浜戠爜 Token <StatusBadge status={tokenReady ? 'ready' : 'missing'} text={tokenReady ? '宸查厤缃? : '鏈厤缃?} /></span>
              <input type="password" autoComplete="new-password" value={captchaToken} onChange={(e) => setCaptchaToken(e.target.value)} placeholder="杈撳叆杞崲鍚庣殑鏂?Token" />
            </label>
          </section>

          <section className="settings-section">
            <div className="section-heading"><Box size={17} /><div><h3>BitBrowser 涓庡苟鍙?/h3><p>{profilesOnline ? '鏈湴鏈嶅姟鍦ㄧ嚎' : '褰撳墠鏃犳硶杩炴帴 BitBrowser'}</p></div><button type="button" className="button button-quiet profile-refresh-button" onClick={onRefreshProfiles} disabled={profilesRefreshing} aria-label="閲嶆柊妫€鏌?BitBrowser 绐楀彛"><RefreshCw className={profilesRefreshing ? 'spin' : ''} size={15} />閲嶆柊妫€鏌ョ獥鍙?/button></div>
            <fieldset className="profile-list field">
              <legend>娴忚鍣ㄩ厤缃?<span>鏈€澶氶€夋嫨 3 涓?/span></legend>
              {profiles.length ? profiles.map((profile) => {
                const checked = (form.profile_ids ?? []).includes(profile.id)
                const disabled = !checked && (form.profile_ids ?? []).length >= 3
                return (
                  <label key={profile.id} className={disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}>
                    <input type="checkbox" checked={checked} disabled={disabled} onChange={() => toggleProfile(profile.id)} />
                    <span className="custom-check"><Check size={13} /></span>
                    <span><strong>{profile.name || `閰嶇疆 ${profile.id.slice(0, 8)}`}</strong><small className="mono">{profile.id}</small></span>
                  </label>
                )
              }) : <div className="compact-empty">鏈彂鐜板彲鐢ㄦ祻瑙堝櫒閰嶇疆</div>}
            </fieldset>
            <fieldset className="field worker-field">
              <legend>骞跺彂 Worker</legend>
              <div className="segmented workers">
                {[1, 2, 3].map((value) => <button key={value} type="button" className={form.worker_count === value ? 'selected' : ''} onClick={() => update('worker_count', value)}>{value}</button>)}
              </div>
            </fieldset>
          </section>

          <section className="settings-section">
            <div className="section-heading"><HardDrive size={17} /><div><h3>鏈湴鏂囦欢</h3><p>鍘嗗彶鍟嗗搧鎬昏〃灏嗘寜 PID 鍘婚噸鍚堝苟</p></div></div>
            <label className="field"><span>鎬昏〃璺緞</span><input value={form.product_summary_path ?? form.summary_path ?? ''} onChange={(e) => update('product_summary_path', e.target.value)} placeholder="椤圭洰鐩綍\product_summary姹囨€?xlsx" /></label>
          </section>

          {message && <div className="inline-alert" aria-live="polite"><CheckCircle2 size={16} />{message}</div>}
        </div>
        <footer className="drawer-footer">
          <button className="button button-quiet" onClick={onClose}>鍏抽棴</button>
          <button className="button button-primary" disabled={busy} onClick={save}>{busy ? <LoaderCircle className="spin" size={16} /> : <Check size={16} />}淇濆瓨璁剧疆</button>
        </footer>
      </aside>
    </div>
  )
}

function BatchSidebar({ batches, selectedId, query, onQuery, onSelect, onImport, open, onClose }: {
  batches: Batch[]
  selectedId: string | null
  query: string
  onQuery: (value: string) => void
  onSelect: (id: string) => void
  onImport: () => void
  open: boolean
  onClose: () => void
}) {
  const filtered = batches.filter((batch) => `${batch.name} ${batch.id}`.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()))
  return (
    <aside className={`batch-sidebar ${open ? 'mobile-open' : ''}`} aria-label="鎵规鍒楄〃">
      <div className="sidebar-heading">
        <div><span className="sidebar-kicker">宸ヤ綔鎵规</span><strong>{batches.length}</strong></div>
        <button className="icon-button mobile-close" onClick={onClose} aria-label="鍏抽棴鎵规鍒楄〃"><X size={18} /></button>
      </div>
      <label className="search-field">

const BACKGROUND_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS = 60_000
const PREFLIGHT_CACHE_TTL_MS = 15 * 60_000
const PREFLIGHT_CACHE_KEY = 'tk-workflow-preflight-cache'

function readCachedPreflight(): Preflight | null {
  try {
    const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(PREFLIGHT_CACHE_KEY)
    if (!raw) return null
    const cached = JSON.parse(raw) as { checkedAt?: number; value?: Preflight }
    if (!cached.checkedAt || !cached.value || Date.now() - cached.checkedAt >= PREFLIGHT_CACHE_TTL_MS) return null
    return cached.value
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

function writeCachedPreflight(value: Preflight): void {
  try {
    sessionStorage.setItem(PREFLIGHT_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ checkedAt: Date.now(), value }))
  } catch {
    // The network check still works when browser storage is unavailable.
  }
}

function withBitBrowserResult(
  current: Preflight | null,
  result: { online: boolean; items: BrowserProfile[] },
): Preflight | null {
  if (!current) return null
  const checks = current.checks.map((check) => {
    const isBitBrowser = check.key === 'bitbrowser_api' || check.id === 'bitbrowser_api'
    return isBitBrowser
      ? { ...check, status: result.online ? 'ok' : 'warning', detail: result.online ? '鍦ㄧ嚎' : '绂荤嚎' }
      : check
  })
  const hasBlockingCheck = checks.some((check) => ['blocked', 'error'].includes(check.status))
  const hasWarning = checks.some((check) => !['ready', 'ok'].includes(check.status))
  return {
    ...current,
    checks,
    profiles: result.items,
    overall: hasBlockingCheck ? 'blocked' : hasWarning ? 'warning' : 'ready',
  }
}

const DEFAULT_SETTINGS: Settings = {
  execution_mode: 'real',

  model: 'gpt-5.5',

  profile_ids: [],
  product_summary_path: '',
  secret_status: {},
}

type ViewTab = 'items' | 'logs' | 'delivery'

function errorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : '鎿嶄綔澶辫触锛岃绋嶅悗閲嶈瘯銆?
}

function statusTone(status?: string): string {
  if (['ready', 'ok', 'success', 'succeeded', 'completed'].includes(status ?? '')) return 'success'
  if (['warning', 'paused', 'queued', 'pending', 'draft'].includes(status ?? '')) return 'warning'
  if (['error', 'failed', 'blocked', 'missing', 'offline', 'cancelled'].includes(status ?? '')) return 'danger'
  if (['running', 'processing'].includes(status ?? '')) return 'active'
  return 'neutral'
}

function workflowStageLabel(stage?: string): string {
  const normalized = String(stage ?? '').toLowerCase()
  if (!normalized || normalized === 'pending') return '绛夊緟鎶撳彇'
  if (normalized.includes('scrape') || normalized.includes('download')) return '鎶撳彇鍘熷浘'
  if (normalized.includes('archive')) return '鏁寸悊褰掓。'
  if (normalized.includes('complete')) return '杩滅楠岃瘉瀹屾垚'
  if (normalized.includes('classify') || normalized.includes('select') || normalized.includes('collage')) return '鍘嗗彶娴佺▼璁板綍'
  return statusLabel(stage) === '鏈煡' ? stage ?? '绛夊緟鍒嗛厤' : statusLabel(stage)
}

function batchKindLabel(category?: string): string {
  if (!category || category === 'auto') return '鍘熷浘褰掓。'
  return `鍘嗗彶${categoryLabel(category)}`
}

function StatusBadge({ status, text }: { status?: string; text?: string }) {
  return (
    <span className={`status-badge status-${statusTone(status)}`}>
      <span className="status-dot" aria-hidden="true" />
      {text ?? statusLabel(status)}
    </span>
  )
}

    </div>
  )
}

function ImportDialog({ onClose, onCreated, settings }: { onClose: () => void; onCreated: (batch: Batch) => void; settings: Settings }) {
  const [name, setName] = useState('')
  const [text, setText] = useState('')
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | undefined>()
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<ImportPreview | null>(null)
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState('')
  const nameRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    nameRef.current?.focus()
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') onClose()
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown)
  }, [onClose])

  const validate = async () => {
    setBusy(true)
    setError('')
    try {
      const local = file ? null : parsePidInput(text)
      if (!file && !local?.validPids.length && !local?.invalid.length) throw new Error('璇峰厛绮樿创 PID 鎴栭€夋嫨 Excel 鏂囦欢銆?)
      setPreview(await api.previewImport(file ? { file } : { text }))
    } catch (reason) {
      setError(errorMessage(reason))
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }

  const create = async () => {
    if (!preview?.valid_pids.length) return
    setBusy(true)
    setError('')
    try {
      const batch = await api.createBatch({
        name: name.trim() || '鏈懡鍚嶆壒娆?,
        category: 'auto',
        pids: preview.valid_pids,
        worker_count: settings.worker_count ?? 3,
        profile_ids: settings.profile_ids ?? [],
      })
      onCreated(batch)
      onClose()
    } catch (reason) {
      setError(errorMessage(reason))
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="overlay" role="presentation" onMouseDown={(event) => event.target === event.currentTarget && onClose()}>
      <section className="dialog import-dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="import-title">
        <header className="dialog-header">
          <div>
            <span className="eyebrow">NEW BATCH</span>
            <h2 id="import-title">瀵煎叆 PID</h2>
          </div>
          <button className="icon-button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="鍏抽棴瀵煎叆绐楀彛" title="鍏抽棴"><X size={18} /></button>
        </header>

        <div className="dialog-body">
          <label className="field">
            <span>鎵规鍚嶇О</span>
            <input ref={nameRef} value={name} onChange={(event) => setName(event.target.value)} placeholder="渚嬪锛? 鏈?21 鏃ヤ笂鏂? />
          </label>

          <label className="field">
            <span>绮樿创 PID</span>
            <textarea value={text} onChange={(event) => { setText(event.target.value); setPreview(null) }} rows={7} placeholder={'姣忚涓€涓?PID锛屼篃鏀寔绌烘牸銆侀€楀彿鍒嗛殧\n1234567890123456789'} />
          </label>

          <div className="import-divider"><span>鎴?/span></div>

          <label className={`file-drop ${file ? 'has-file' : ''}`}>
            <input type="file" accept=".xlsx" onChange={(event) => { setFile(event.target.files?.[0]); setPreview(null) }} />
            <FileSpreadsheet size={22} />
            <span><strong>{file?.name ?? '閫夋嫨 Excel (.xlsx)'}</strong><small>{file ? `${Math.ceil(file.size / 1024)} KB` : '绯荤粺浼氳嚜鍔ㄨ瘑鍒?PID 鍒楀苟鍘婚噸'}</small></span>
            <Upload size={17} />
          </label>

          {preview && (
            <div className="preview-strip" aria-live="polite">
              <span className="preview-good"><CheckCircle2 size={16} />鏈夋晥 {preview.valid_pids.length}</span>
              <span><RotateCcw size={16} />閲嶅 {preview.duplicates.length}</span>
              <span className={preview.invalid.length ? 'preview-bad' : ''}><AlertTriangle size={16} />鏃犳晥 {preview.invalid.length}</span>
              <span className="preview-total">鎬昏 {preview.total}</span>
            </div>
          )}
          {error && <div className="inline-alert danger" role="alert"><XCircle size={16} />{error}</div>}
        </div>

        <footer className="dialog-footer">
          <button className="button button-quiet" onClick={onClose}>鍙栨秷</button>
          {!preview ? (
            <button className="button button-primary" disabled={busy} onClick={validate}>
              {busy ? <LoaderCircle className="spin" size={16} /> : <Check size={16} />}鏍￠獙 PID
            </button>
          ) : (
            <button className="button button-primary" disabled={busy || preview.valid_pids.length === 0} onClick={create}>
              {busy ? <LoaderCircle className="spin" size={16} /> : <Plus size={16} />}鍒涘缓鎵规
            </button>
          )}
        </footer>
      </section>
    </div>
  )
}

function SettingsDrawer({
  initial,
  profiles,
  profilesOnline,
  profilesRefreshing,
  onRefreshProfiles,
  onClose,
  onSaved,
}: {
  initial: Settings
  profiles: BrowserProfile[]
  profilesOnline: boolean
  profilesRefreshing: boolean
  onRefreshProfiles: () => void
  onClose: () => void
  onSaved: (settings: Settings) => void
}) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState<Settings>({ ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, ...initial })
  const [captchaToken, setCaptchaToken] = useState('')
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('')
  const titleRef = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    titleRef.current?.focus()
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => event.key === 'Escape' && onClose()
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown)
  }, [onClose])

  const update = <K extends keyof Settings>(key: K, value: Settings[K]) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: value }))
  const toggleProfile = (id: string) => {
    const current = form.profile_ids ?? []
    if (current.includes(id)) update('profile_ids', current.filter((profileId) => profileId !== id))
    else if (current.length < 3) update('profile_ids', [...current, id])
  }

  const save = async () => {
    setBusy(true)
    setMessage('')
    try {
      const saved = await api.updateSettings(form)
      const secretUpdates: Promise<unknown>[] = []
      if (captchaToken.trim()) secretUpdates.push(api.setSecret('JFBYM_TOKEN', captchaToken.trim()))
      await Promise.all(secretUpdates)
      onSaved({ ...form, ...saved })
      setCaptchaToken('')
      setMessage('璁剧疆宸蹭繚瀛橈紝瀵嗛挜涓嶄細鍦ㄩ〉闈㈠洖鏄俱€?)
    } catch (reason) {
      setMessage(errorMessage(reason))
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }

  const secrets = form.secret_status ?? initial.secret_status ?? {}
  const tokenReady = Boolean(secrets.JFBYM_TOKEN ?? secrets.yunma_token ?? secrets.captcha_token)

  return (
    <div className="drawer-layer" role="presentation" onMouseDown={(event) => event.target === event.currentTarget && onClose()}>
      <aside className="settings-drawer" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="settings-title">
        <header className="dialog-header drawer-header">
          <div>
            <span className="eyebrow">LOCAL CONFIGURATION</span>
            <h2 id="settings-title" ref={titleRef} tabIndex={-1}>绯荤粺璁剧疆</h2>
          </div>
          <button className="icon-button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="鍏抽棴璁剧疆" title="鍏抽棴"><X size={18} /></button>
        </header>

        <div className="drawer-content">
          <ExecutionModeControl value={form.execution_mode ?? 'real'} onChange={(value) => update('execution_mode', value)} />

          <section className="settings-section">
            <div className="section-heading"><KeyRound size={17} /><div><h3>楠岃瘉鐮佹湇鍔?/h3><p>浜戠爜 Token 鍙啓鍏ユ湰鏈哄畨鍏ㄩ厤缃?/p></div></div>
            {form.execution_mode === 'real' && !tokenReady && <div className="inline-alert danger"><ShieldAlert size={16} />鏈厤缃柊浜戠爜 Token锛岀郴缁熷皢闃绘鐪熷疄浠诲姟鍚姩銆?/div>}
            <label className="field secret-field">
              <span>浜戠爜 Token <StatusBadge status={tokenReady ? 'ready' : 'missing'} text={tokenReady ? '宸查厤缃? : '鏈厤缃?} /></span>
              <input type="password" autoComplete="new-password" value={captchaToken} onChange={(e) => setCaptchaToken(e.target.value)} placeholder="杈撳叆杞崲鍚庣殑鏂?Token" />
            </label>
          </section>

          <section className="settings-section">
            <div className="section-heading"><Box size={17} /><div><h3>BitBrowser 涓庡苟鍙?/h3><p>{profilesOnline ? '鏈湴鏈嶅姟鍦ㄧ嚎' : '褰撳墠鏃犳硶杩炴帴 BitBrowser'}</p></div><button type="button" className="button button-quiet profile-refresh-button" onClick={onRefreshProfiles} disabled={profilesRefreshing} aria-label="閲嶆柊妫€鏌?BitBrowser 绐楀彛"><RefreshCw className={profilesRefreshing ? 'spin' : ''} size={15} />閲嶆柊妫€鏌ョ獥鍙?/button></div>
            <fieldset className="profile-list field">
              <legend>娴忚鍣ㄩ厤缃?<span>鏈€澶氶€夋嫨 3 涓?/span></legend>
              {profiles.length ? profiles.map((profile) => {
                const checked = (form.profile_ids ?? []).includes(profile.id)
                const disabled = !checked && (form.profile_ids ?? []).length >= 3
                return (
                  <label key={profile.id} className={disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}>
                    <input type="checkbox" checked={checked} disabled={disabled} onChange={() => toggleProfile(profile.id)} />
                    <span className="custom-check"><Check size={13} /></span>
                    <span><strong>{profile.name || `閰嶇疆 ${profile.id.slice(0, 8)}`}</strong><small className="mono">{profile.id}</small></span>
                  </label>
                )
              }) : <div className="compact-empty">鏈彂鐜板彲鐢ㄦ祻瑙堝櫒閰嶇疆</div>}
            </fieldset>
            <fieldset className="field worker-field">
              <legend>骞跺彂 Worker</legend>

              </div>
            </fieldset>
          </section>

          <section className="settings-section">
            <div className="section-heading"><HardDrive size={17} /><div><h3>鏈湴鏂囦欢</h3><p>鍘嗗彶鍟嗗搧鎬昏〃灏嗘寜 PID 鍘婚噸鍚堝苟</p></div></div>
            <label className="field"><span>鎬昏〃璺緞</span><input value={form.product_summary_path ?? form.summary_path ?? ''} onChange={(e) => update('product_summary_path', e.target.value)} placeholder="椤圭洰鐩綍\product_summary姹囨€?xlsx" /></label>
          </section>

          {message && <div className="inline-alert" aria-live="polite"><CheckCircle2 size={16} />{message}</div>}
        </div>
        <footer className="drawer-footer">

          <button className="button button-primary" disabled={busy} onClick={save}>{busy ? <LoaderCircle className="spin" size={16} /> : <Check size={16} />}淇濆瓨璁剧疆</button>
        </footer>
      </aside>
    </div>
  )
}

            <button key={batch.id} className={`batch-row ${batch.id === selectedId ? 'selected' : ''}`} onClick={() => { onSelect(batch.id); onClose() }}>
              <span className="batch-row-top"><strong>{batch.name}</strong><StatusBadge status={batch.status} /></span>
              <span className="batch-row-meta"><span>{batchKindLabel(batch.category)}</span><span>{batch.total} 涓?PID</span><span>{formatDate(batch.created_at)}</span></span>
              <span className="batch-progress"><i style={{ width: `${progress}%` }} /><span>{progress}%</span></span>
            </button>
          )
        })}
        {!filtered.length && <div className="sidebar-empty">{query ? '娌℃湁鍖归厤鎵规' : '杩樻病鏈夋壒娆?}</div>}
      </div>
      <div className="sidebar-footer"><button className="button button-primary button-block" onClick={onImport}><Plus size={16} />瀵煎叆 PID</button></div>
    </aside>
  )
}

function Overview({ batches, preflight, onImport, onSelect, onSettings }: {
  batches: Batch[]
  preflight: Preflight | null
  onImport: () => void
  onSelect: (id: string) => void
  onSettings: () => void
}) {
  const totals = batches.reduce((sum, batch) => ({

  }), { pids: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0, running: 0 })

        <div><span>PID 鎬绘暟</span><strong>{compactNumber(totals.pids)}</strong><small>鍏ㄩ儴瀵煎叆璁板綍</small></div>
        <div><span>杩愯涓?/span><strong>{compactNumber(totals.running)}</strong><small>娲诲姩鎵规</small></div>
        <div><span>宸插畬鎴?/span><strong>{compactNumber(totals.completed)}</strong><small>鍘熷浘宸插綊妗?/small></div>
        <div className={totals.failed ? 'metric-danger' : ''}><span>寰呭鐞嗗け璐?/span><strong>{compactNumber(totals.failed)}</strong><small>鏀寔鏁存壒閲嶈瘯</small></div>
      </section>

      <div className="overview-grid">
        <section className="panel recent-panel">
          <header className="panel-header"><div><h2>鏈€杩戞壒娆?/h2><p>鎸夊垱寤烘椂闂存帓鍒?/p></div><LayoutList size={18} /></header>
          {batches.length ? <div className="recent-list">{batches.slice(0, 6).map((batch) => (
            <button key={batch.id} onClick={() => onSelect(batch.id)}>

import { defineConfig } from 'vitest/config'
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react()],
  server: {
    proxy: {
      '/api': 'http://127.0.0.1:8000',
    },

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { categoryLabel, formatDate, parsePidInput, progressForBatch, statusLabel } from './utils'

describe('parsePidInput', () => {
  it('extracts trimmed PIDs, removes duplicates, and identifies invalid rows', () => {
    expect(parsePidInput(' 1234567890123456789\n1234567890123456789\nabc\n9876543210987654321, x')).toEqual({
      validPids: ['1234567890123456789', '9876543210987654321'],
      duplicates: ['1234567890123456789'],
      invalid: ['abc', 'x'],
    })
  })

  it('accepts common TikTok numeric PID lengths', () => {
    expect(parsePidInput('1234567890 123456789012345678901234')).toEqual({
      validPids: ['1234567890', '123456789012345678901234'],
      duplicates: [],
      invalid: [],
    })
  })
})

describe('display helpers', () => {
  it('maps server enum values to Chinese labels', () => {
    expect(statusLabel('running')).toBe('杩愯涓?)
    expect(statusLabel('unknown')).toBe('鏈煡')
    expect(categoryLabel('non_clothing')).toBe('闈炴湇瑁?)
  })

  it('calculates bounded batch progress', () => {
    expect(progressForBatch({ total: 8, completed: 2, failed: 1 })).toBe(38)
    expect(progressForBatch({ total: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0 })).toBe(0)
    expect(progressForBatch({ total: 2, completed: 4, failed: 0 })).toBe(100)
  })

  it('formats empty and valid dates safely', () => {
    expect(formatDate(undefined)).toBe('鈥?)
    expect(formatDate('not-a-date')).toBe('not-a-date')
    expect(formatDate('2026-08-21T06:30:00Z')).toMatch(/2026/)
  })
})

  224:     const [items, events] = await Promise.allSettled([
  225:       itemsRequest ?? Promise.resolve(null),

 158: export const api = {
 159:   async preflight(): Promise<Preflight> {
 160:     const value = await request<Preflight>('/system/preflight')
 161:     return { ...value, checks: (value.checks ?? []).map((check) => ({ ...check, key: check.key ?? check.id ?? check.label })) }
 162:   },
 163: 
 164:   async listBatches(): Promise<Batch[]> {
 165:     return listFrom<Batch>(await request<unknown>('/batches')).map(normalizeBatch)
 166:   },
 167: 
 168:   async listGallery(input: { query?: string; membership?: string; limit?: number; offset?: number } = {}): Promise<GalleryResponse> {
 169:     const params = new URLSearchParams()
 170:     if (input.query?.trim()) params.set('query', input.query.trim())
 171:     if (input.membership && input.membership !== 'all') params.set('membership', input.membership)
 172:     params.set('limit', String(input.limit ?? 100))
 173:     params.set('offset', String(input.offset ?? 0))
 174:     const suffix = params.toString()
 175:     const value = await request<GalleryResponse | GalleryPid[] | { items?: GalleryPid[]; total?: number; limit?: number; offset?: number; stats?: GalleryResponse['stats'] }>(`/gallery${suffix ? `?${suffix}` : ''}`)
 176:     if (Array.isArray(value)) return { items: value.map(normalizeGalleryItem), total: value.length, limit: input.limit ?? 100, offset: input.offset ?? 0 }
 177:     return {
 178:       ...value,
 179:       items: Array.isArray(value.items) ? value.items.map(normalizeGalleryItem) : [],
 180:       total: Number(value.total ?? value.items?.length ?? 0),
 181:       limit: Number(value.limit ?? input.limit ?? 100),
 182:       offset: Number(value.offset ?? input.offset ?? 0),
 183:     }
 184:   },
 185: 
 186:   syncGallery(): Promise<GallerySyncResult> {
 187:     return request<GallerySyncResult>('/gallery/sync-jspace', { method: 'POST' })
 188:   },
 189: 
 190:   getGalleryMembershipStatus(): Promise<GalleryMembershipStatus> {
 191:     return request<GalleryMembershipStatus>('/gallery/membership/status')
 192:   },
 193: 
 194:   backfillGalleryMembership(): Promise<GalleryMembershipStatus> {
 195:     return request<GalleryMembershipStatus>('/gallery/membership/backfill', { method: 'POST' })
 196:   },
 197: 
 198:   checkGalleryFile(file: File): Promise<GalleryCheckResult> {
 199:     const body = new FormData()
 200:     body.append('file', file)
 201:     return request<GalleryCheckResult>('/gallery/check-file', { method: 'POST', body })
 202:   },
 203: 
 204:   async updateGalleryCategory(pid: string, category: string): Promise<GalleryPid> {
 205:     return normalizeGalleryItem(await request<GalleryPid>(`/gallery/${encodeURIComponent(pid)}`, {
 206:       method: 'PUT',
 207:       body: JSON.stringify({ category }),
 208:     }))
 209:   },
 210: 
 211:   async getBatch(id: string): Promise<BatchDetail> {
 212:     const payload = await request<BatchDetail | Batch>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`)
 213:     const detail = normalizeDetail(payload)
 214:     const record = payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload as unknown as Record<string, unknown> : {}
 215:     const hasEmbeddedItems = Array.isArray(record.items)
 216:       && (record.items.length > 0 || 'events' in record)
 217:     const hasEmbeddedEvents = Array.isArray(record.events)
 218:     const itemsRequest = hasEmbeddedItems
 219:       ? null
 220:       : request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/items`)
 221:     const eventsRequest = hasEmbeddedEvents
 222:       ? null
 223:       : request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/events`)
 224:     const [items, events] = await Promise.allSettled([
 225:       itemsRequest ?? Promise.resolve(null),
 226:       eventsRequest ?? Promise.resolve(null),
 227:     ])
 228:     return {
 229:       ...detail,
 230:       items: itemsRequest && items.status === 'fulfilled'
 231:         ? listFrom<WorkflowItem>(items.value).map(normalizeItem)
 232:         : detail.items,
 233:       events: eventsRequest && events.status === 'fulfilled'
 234:         ? listFrom<WorkflowEvent>(events.value)
 235:         : detail.events ?? [],
 236:     }
 237:   },
 238: 
 239:   previewImport(input: { text?: string; file?: File }): Promise<ImportPreview> {
 240:     if (input.file) {
 241:       const body = new FormData()
 242:       body.append('file', input.file)
 243:       return request('/imports/preview-file', { method: 'POST', body })
 244:     }
 245:     return request('/imports/preview', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ text: input.text ?? '' }) })
 246:   },
 247: 
 248:   async createBatch(input: { name: string; category: string; pids: string[]; worker_count?: number; profile_ids?: string[] }): Promise<Batch> {
 249:     const value = await request<Batch>('/batches', {
 250:       method: 'POST',

 252:         name: input.name,
 253:         category_mode: input.category,
 254:         pids: input.pids,
 255:         worker_count: input.worker_count ?? 3,
 256:         profile_ids: input.profile_ids ?? [],
 257:       }),
 258:     })
 259:     return normalizeBatch(value)
 260:   },

 264:   },

 272:   },

 277:   async updateSettings(settings: Settings): Promise<Settings> {

 295:       }),
 296:     })

 298:   },
