  Batch,
  BatchAction,
  BatchDetail,
  BrowserProfile,
  ExportInfo,
  GalleryCheckResult,
  GalleryMembershipStatus,
  GalleryPid,
  GalleryResponse,
  GallerySyncResult,
  ImportPreview,
  Preflight,
  ProfilesResponse,
  Settings,
  WorkflowEvent,
  WorkflowItem,
} from './types'

const API_BASE = '/api/v1'

export class ApiError extends Error {
  status: number

  constructor(message: string, status: number) {
    super(message)
    this.name = 'ApiError'
    this.status = status
  }
}

function unwrap<T>(payload: unknown): T {
  if (payload && typeof payload === 'object') {
    const record = payload as Record<string, unknown>
    if ('success' in record && 'data' in record) return record.data as T
    if (Object.keys(record).length === 1 && 'data' in record) return record.data as T
  }
  return payload as T
}

export function listFrom<T>(payload: unknown): T[] {
  const value = unwrap<unknown>(payload)
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value as T[]
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return []
  const record = value as Record<string, unknown>
  if (Array.isArray(record.items)) return record.items as T[]
  if (Array.isArray(record.data)) return record.data as T[]
  if (record.data && typeof record.data === 'object' && Array.isArray((record.data as Record<string, unknown>).items)) {
    return (record.data as { items: T[] }).items
  }
  return []
}

async function request<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const headers = new Headers(init?.headers)
  if (init?.body && !(init.body instanceof FormData)) headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json')
  headers.set('Accept', 'application/json')

  let response: Response
  try {
    response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, { ...init, headers })
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError('鏃犳硶杩炴帴鏈湴鏈嶅姟锛岃纭鏈嶅姟宸茬粡鍚姩銆?, 0)
  }

  const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || ''
  const payload = contentType.includes('json') ? await response.json() : await response.text()
  if (!response.ok) {
    const record = payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload as Record<string, unknown> : null
    const nestedError = record?.error && typeof record.error === 'object' ? record.error as Record<string, unknown> : null
    const message = record?.detail ?? record?.message ?? nestedError?.message ?? record?.error ?? payload
    throw new ApiError(typeof message === 'string' && message ? message : `璇锋眰澶辫触 (${response.status})`, response.status)
  }
  return unwrap<T>(payload)
}

function normalizeBatch(value: Batch | (Partial<Batch> & { id: string; name: string; status: string })): Batch {
  const record = value as Batch & { succeeded?: number }
  return {
    ...record,
    category: record.category ?? record.category_mode ?? 'auto',
    total: Number(record.total ?? 0),
    completed: Number(record.completed ?? record.succeeded ?? 0),
    failed: Number(record.failed ?? 0),
  }
}

function normalizeSettings(value: Settings): Settings {
  let storedProfiles: string[] = []
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('tk-workflow-profile-ids')
    storedProfiles = saved ? JSON.parse(saved) as string[] : []
  } catch {
    storedProfiles = []
  }
  return {
    ...value,
    provider_base_url: value.provider_base_url ?? value.provider,
    confidence_threshold: value.confidence_threshold ?? value.auto_category_threshold,
    product_summary_path: value.product_summary_path ?? value.summary_path ?? value.master_summary_path,
    profile_ids: value.profile_ids ?? storedProfiles,
  }
}

function normalizeItem(value: WorkflowItem): WorkflowItem {
  const artifactUrl = value.artifact_path
    ? `/api/v1/artifacts?path=${encodeURIComponent(value.artifact_path)}`
    : undefined
  return {
    ...value,
    error: value.error ?? value.error_message,
    original_url: value.original_url ?? value.image_url ?? value.thumbnail_url ?? artifactUrl,
    thumbnail_url: value.thumbnail_url ?? value.original_url ?? value.image_url ?? artifactUrl,
    collage_url: value.collage_url ?? artifactUrl,
  }
}

function normalizeDetail(payload: BatchDetail | Batch): BatchDetail {
  if ('batch' in payload) {
    const stats = payload.stats ?? {}
    return {
      ...payload,
      batch: normalizeBatch({
        ...payload.batch,
        total: payload.batch.total ?? stats.total ?? 0,
        completed: payload.batch.completed ?? stats.succeeded ?? stats.completed ?? 0,
        failed: payload.batch.failed ?? stats.failed ?? 0,
      }),
      items: (Array.isArray(payload.items) ? payload.items : listFrom<WorkflowItem>((payload as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).items)).map(normalizeItem),
      export: payload.export ? { ...payload.export, path: payload.export.path ?? payload.export.manifest_path, count: payload.export.count ?? payload.export.pid_count } : undefined,
    }
  }
  return { batch: normalizeBatch(payload), items: [] }
}

function normalizeGalleryItem(value: GalleryPid): GalleryPid {
  const record = value as GalleryPid & {
    count?: number
    path?: string
    collage_path?: string
  }
  const imageCount = Number(record.original_image_count ?? record.image_count ?? record.count ?? 0)
  const sourcePath = record.source_directory ?? record.source_path ?? record.path
  const coverPath = record.cover_path ?? record.artifact_path ?? record.collage_path
  return {
    ...record,
    pid: String(record.pid ?? ''),
    image_count: imageCount,
    original_image_count: Number(record.original_image_count ?? imageCount),
    original_total_bytes: Number(record.original_total_bytes ?? 0),
    source_path: sourcePath,
    source_directory: record.source_directory ?? sourcePath,
    artifact_path: coverPath,
    cover_path: record.cover_path ?? coverPath,
  }
}

export const api = {
  async preflight(): Promise<Preflight> {
    const value = await request<Preflight>('/system/preflight')
    return { ...value, checks: (value.checks ?? []).map((check) => ({ ...check, key: check.key ?? check.id ?? check.label })) }
  },

  async listBatches(): Promise<Batch[]> {
    return listFrom<Batch>(await request<unknown>('/batches')).map(normalizeBatch)
  },

  async listGallery(input: { query?: string; membership?: string; limit?: number; offset?: number } = {}): Promise<GalleryResponse> {
    const params = new URLSearchParams()
    if (input.query?.trim()) params.set('query', input.query.trim())
    if (input.membership && input.membership !== 'all') params.set('membership', input.membership)
    params.set('limit', String(input.limit ?? 100))
    params.set('offset', String(input.offset ?? 0))
    const suffix = params.toString()
    const value = await request<GalleryResponse | GalleryPid[] | { items?: GalleryPid[]; total?: number; limit?: number; offset?: number; stats?: GalleryResponse['stats'] }>(`/gallery${suffix ? `?${suffix}` : ''}`)
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return { items: value.map(normalizeGalleryItem), total: value.length, limit: input.limit ?? 100, offset: input.offset ?? 0 }
    return {
      ...value,
      items: Array.isArray(value.items) ? value.items.map(normalizeGalleryItem) : [],
      total: Number(value.total ?? value.items?.length ?? 0),
      limit: Number(value.limit ?? input.limit ?? 100),
      offset: Number(value.offset ?? input.offset ?? 0),
    }
  },

  syncGallery(): Promise<GallerySyncResult> {
    return request<GallerySyncResult>('/gallery/sync-jspace', { method: 'POST' })
  },

  getGalleryMembershipStatus(): Promise<GalleryMembershipStatus> {
    return request<GalleryMembershipStatus>('/gallery/membership/status')
  },

  backfillGalleryMembership(): Promise<GalleryMembershipStatus> {
    return request<GalleryMembershipStatus>('/gallery/membership/backfill', { method: 'POST' })
  },

  checkGalleryFile(file: File): Promise<GalleryCheckResult> {
    const body = new FormData()
    body.append('file', file)
    return request<GalleryCheckResult>('/gallery/check-file', { method: 'POST', body })
  },

  async updateGalleryCategory(pid: string, category: string): Promise<GalleryPid> {
    return normalizeGalleryItem(await request<GalleryPid>(`/gallery/${encodeURIComponent(pid)}`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: JSON.stringify({ category }),
    }))
  },

  async getBatch(id: string): Promise<BatchDetail> {
    const payload = await request<BatchDetail | Batch>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`)
    const detail = normalizeDetail(payload)
    const record = payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload as unknown as Record<string, unknown> : {}
    const hasEmbeddedItems = Array.isArray(record.items)
      && (record.items.length > 0 || 'events' in record)
    const hasEmbeddedEvents = Array.isArray(record.events)
    const itemsRequest = hasEmbeddedItems
      ? null
      : request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/items`)
    const eventsRequest = hasEmbeddedEvents
      ? null
      : request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/events`)
    const [items, events] = await Promise.allSettled([
      itemsRequest ?? Promise.resolve(null),
      eventsRequest ?? Promise.resolve(null),
    ])
    return {
      ...detail,
      items: itemsRequest && items.status === 'fulfilled'
        ? listFrom<WorkflowItem>(items.value).map(normalizeItem)
        : detail.items,
      events: eventsRequest && events.status === 'fulfilled'
        ? listFrom<WorkflowEvent>(events.value)
        : detail.events ?? [],
    }
  },

  previewImport(input: { text?: string; file?: File }): Promise<ImportPreview> {
    if (input.file) {
      const body = new FormData()
      body.append('file', input.file)
      return request('/imports/preview-file', { method: 'POST', body })
    }
    return request('/imports/preview', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ text: input.text ?? '' }) })
  },

  async createBatch(input: { name: string; category: string; pids: string[]; worker_count?: number; profile_ids?: string[] }): Promise<Batch> {
    const value = await request<Batch>('/batches', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        name: input.name,
        category_mode: input.category,
        pids: input.pids,
        worker_count: input.worker_count ?? 3,
        profile_ids: input.profile_ids ?? [],
      }),
    })
    return normalizeBatch(value)
  },

  controlBatch(id: string, action: BatchAction): Promise<Batch | BatchDetail> {
    return request(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/${action}`, { method: 'POST' })
  },

  startBatch(id: string) {
    return this.controlBatch(id, 'start')
  },

  retryFailed(id: string): Promise<Batch | BatchDetail> {
    return request(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/retry-failed`, { method: 'POST' })
  },

  async getSettings(): Promise<Settings> {
    return normalizeSettings(await request<Settings>('/settings'))
  },
  async updateSettings(settings: Settings): Promise<Settings> {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('tk-workflow-profile-ids', JSON.stringify(settings.profile_ids ?? []))
    } catch {
      // The server settings still save when browser storage is unavailable.
    }
    const value = await request<Settings>('/settings', {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        execution_mode: settings.execution_mode,
        provider: settings.provider_base_url ?? settings.provider,
        model: settings.model,
        wire_api: settings.wire_api,
        auto_category_threshold: settings.confidence_threshold ?? settings.auto_category_threshold,
        worker_count: settings.worker_count,
        profile_ids: settings.profile_ids,
        master_summary_path: settings.product_summary_path ?? settings.summary_path ?? settings.master_summary_path,
        master_summary_mirror_path: settings.master_summary_mirror_path,
      }),
    })
    return normalizeSettings({ ...value, profile_ids: settings.profile_ids })
  },
  setSecret: (name: string, value: string) => request<{ configured: boolean }>(`/secrets/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    body: JSON.stringify({ value }),
  }),

  async getProfiles(refresh = false): Promise<ProfilesResponse> {
    const value = await request<ProfilesResponse | BrowserProfile[]>(`/integrations/bitbrowser/profiles${refresh ? '?refresh=true' : ''}`)
    return Array.isArray(value) ? { online: true, items: value } : { ...value, items: listFrom<BrowserProfile>(value) }
  },

  async exportBatch(id: string): Promise<ExportInfo> {
    const value = await request<ExportInfo>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/export`, { method: 'POST' })
    return {
      ...value,
      path: value.path ?? value.manifest_path ?? '',
      count: value.count ?? value.pid_count ?? 0,
    }
  },
  confirmIntegration: (id: string, kind: string, confirmed: boolean) => request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/confirmations`, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({ kind, confirmed }),
  }),
  updateItemCategory: (itemId: string, category: 'clothing' | 'non_clothing') => request<WorkflowItem>(`/items/${encodeURIComponent(itemId)}/category`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    body: JSON.stringify({ category }),
  }),
}

\n```\n\n## Thread 01a03ddd-6cf1-75b0-a4d6-f1af1e03031e\n- created_at_ms: 1787744410705\n- item_type: commandExecution\n\n```text\n"C:\\Windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe" -Command "Get-Content -Path C:\\Users\\EDY\\tk-image-workflow-web\\frontend\\src\\api.ts"\nGet-Content -Path C:\Users\EDY\tk-image-workflow-web\frontend\src\api.ts\napi.ts\nimport type {
  Batch,
  BatchAction,
  BatchDetail,
  BrowserProfile,
  ExportInfo,
  GalleryCheckResult,
  GalleryMembershipStatus,
  GalleryPid,
  GalleryResponse,
  GallerySyncResult,
  ImportPreview,
  Preflight,
  ProfilesResponse,
  Settings,
  WorkflowEvent,
  WorkflowItem,
} from './types'

const API_BASE = '/api/v1'
const MEBIBYTE = 1024 * 1024
const IMPORT_XLSX_MAX_BYTES = 5 * MEBIBYTE
const GALLERY_TXT_MAX_BYTES = MEBIBYTE

const XLSX_MIME_TYPES = new Set([
  'application/octet-stream',
  'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
])
const TXT_MIME_TYPES = new Set(['application/octet-stream', 'text/plain'])

export class ApiError extends Error {
  status: number

  constructor(message: string, status: number) {
    super(message)
    this.name = 'ApiError'
    this.status = status
  }
}

function payloadErrorMessage(payload: unknown, fallback: string): string {
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') {
    return typeof payload === 'string' && payload.trim() ? payload : fallback
  }
  const record = payload as Record<string, unknown>
  const nestedError = record.error && typeof record.error === 'object'
    ? record.error as Record<string, unknown>
    : null
  const message = record.detail ?? record.message ?? nestedError?.message ?? record.error
  return typeof message === 'string' && message.trim() ? message : fallback
}

function unwrap<T>(payload: unknown): T {
  if (payload && typeof payload === 'object') {
    const record = payload as Record<string, unknown>
    if ('success' in record && 'data' in record) return record.data as T
    if (Object.keys(record).length === 1 && 'data' in record) return record.data as T
  }
  return payload as T
}

export function listFrom<T>(payload: unknown): T[] {
  const value = unwrap<unknown>(payload)
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value as T[]
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return []
  const record = value as Record<string, unknown>
  if (Array.isArray(record.items)) return record.items as T[]
  if (Array.isArray(record.data)) return record.data as T[]
  if (record.data && typeof record.data === 'object' && Array.isArray((record.data as Record<string, unknown>).items)) {
    return (record.data as { items: T[] }).items
  }
  return []
}

async function request<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const headers = new Headers(init?.headers)
  if (init?.body && !(init.body instanceof FormData)) headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json')
  headers.set('Accept', 'application/json')

  let response: Response
  try {
    response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, { ...init, headers })
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError('鏃犳硶杩炴帴鏈湴鏈嶅姟锛岃纭鏈嶅姟宸茬粡鍚姩銆?, 0)
  }

  const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || ''
  const payload = contentType.includes('json') ? await response.json() : await response.text()
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new ApiError(payloadErrorMessage(payload, `璇锋眰澶辫触 (${response.status})`), response.status)
  }
  if (payload && typeof payload === 'object' && (payload as Record<string, unknown>).success === false) {
    throw new ApiError(payloadErrorMessage(payload, '璇锋眰鏈垚鍔熷畬鎴愩€?), response.status)
  }
  return unwrap<T>(payload)
}

function fileExtension(file: File): string {
  const separator = file.name.lastIndexOf('.')
  return separator >= 0 ? file.name.slice(separator).toLowerCase() : ''
}

function validateFileSize(file: File, maxBytes: number, message: string): void {
  if (file.size <= 0) throw new ApiError('鏂囦欢鍐呭涓虹┖锛岃閲嶆柊閫夋嫨銆?, 0)
  if (file.size > maxBytes) throw new ApiError(message, 0)
}

function validateMime(file: File, allowed: Set<string>, message: string): void {
  const mime = file.type.trim().toLowerCase()
  if (mime && !allowed.has(mime)) throw new ApiError(message, 0)
}

function validateImportFile(file: File): void {
  if (fileExtension(file) !== '.xlsx') throw new ApiError('鍙敮鎸?.xlsx 鏂囦欢銆?, 0)
  validateFileSize(file, IMPORT_XLSX_MAX_BYTES, 'Excel 鏂囦欢涓嶈兘瓒呰繃 5 MB銆?)
  validateMime(file, XLSX_MIME_TYPES, '鏂囦欢绫诲瀷涓?.xlsx 涓嶅尮閰嶃€?)
}

function validateGalleryCheckFile(file: File): void {
  const extension = fileExtension(file)
  if (extension !== '.xlsx' && extension !== '.txt') {
    throw new ApiError('鍙敮鎸?.xlsx 鎴?.txt 鏂囦欢銆?, 0)
  }
  if (extension === '.xlsx') {
    validateFileSize(file, IMPORT_XLSX_MAX_BYTES, 'Excel 鏂囦欢涓嶈兘瓒呰繃 5 MB銆?)
    validateMime(file, XLSX_MIME_TYPES, '鏂囦欢绫诲瀷涓?.xlsx 涓嶅尮閰嶃€?)
    return
  }
  validateFileSize(file, GALLERY_TXT_MAX_BYTES, 'TXT 鏂囦欢涓嶈兘瓒呰繃 1 MB銆?)
  validateMime(file, TXT_MIME_TYPES, '鏂囦欢绫诲瀷涓?.txt 涓嶅尮閰嶃€?)
}

export function safeArtifactDownloadUrl(value: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.startsWith(`${API_BASE}/artifacts?`)) return null
  try {
    const base = typeof window === 'undefined' ? 'http://localhost' : window.location.origin
    const url = new URL(value, base)
    if (url.origin !== base || url.pathname !== `${API_BASE}/artifacts` || url.hash) return null
    if (!url.searchParams.get('path')?.trim()) return null
    return value
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

function normalizeBatch(value: Batch | (Partial<Batch> & { id: string; name: string; status: string })): Batch {
  const record = value as Batch & { succeeded?: number }
  return {
    ...record,
    category: record.category ?? record.category_mode ?? 'auto',
    total: Number(record.total ?? 0),
    completed: Number(record.completed ?? record.succeeded ?? 0),
    failed: Number(record.failed ?? 0),
  }
}

function normalizeSettings(value: Settings): Settings {
  let storedProfiles: string[] = []
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('tk-workflow-profile-ids')
    storedProfiles = saved ? JSON.parse(saved) as string[] : []
  } catch {
    storedProfiles = []
  }
  return {
    ...value,
    provider_base_url: value.provider_base_url ?? value.provider,
    confidence_threshold: value.confidence_threshold ?? value.auto_category_threshold,
    product_summary_path: value.product_summary_path ?? value.summary_path ?? value.master_summary_path,
    profile_ids: value.profile_ids ?? storedProfiles,
  }
}

function normalizeItem(value: WorkflowItem): WorkflowItem {
  const artifactUrl = value.artifact_path
    ? `/api/v1/artifacts?path=${encodeURIComponent(value.artifact_path)}`
    : undefined
  return {
    ...value,
    error: value.error ?? value.error_message,
    original_url: value.original_url ?? value.image_url ?? value.thumbnail_url ?? artifactUrl,
    thumbnail_url: value.thumbnail_url ?? value.original_url ?? value.image_url ?? artifactUrl,
    collage_url: value.collage_url ?? artifactUrl,
  }
}

function normalizeDetail(payload: BatchDetail | Batch): BatchDetail {
  if ('batch' in payload) {
    const stats = payload.stats ?? {}
    return {
      ...payload,
      batch: normalizeBatch({
        ...payload.batch,
        total: payload.batch.total ?? stats.total ?? 0,
        completed: payload.batch.completed ?? stats.succeeded ?? stats.completed ?? 0,
        failed: payload.batch.failed ?? stats.failed ?? 0,
      }),
      items: (Array.isArray(payload.items) ? payload.items : listFrom<WorkflowItem>((payload as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).items)).map(normalizeItem),
      export: payload.export ? { ...payload.export, path: payload.export.path ?? payload.export.manifest_path, count: payload.export.count ?? payload.export.pid_count } : undefined,
    }
  }
  return { batch: normalizeBatch(payload), items: [] }
}

function normalizeGalleryItem(value: GalleryPid): GalleryPid {
  const record = value as GalleryPid & {
    count?: number
    path?: string
    collage_path?: string
  }
  const imageCount = Number(record.original_image_count ?? record.image_count ?? record.count ?? 0)
  const sourcePath = record.source_directory ?? record.source_path ?? record.path
  const coverPath = record.cover_path ?? record.artifact_path ?? record.collage_path
  return {
    ...record,
    pid: String(record.pid ?? ''),
    image_count: imageCount,
    original_image_count: Number(record.original_image_count ?? imageCount),
    original_total_bytes: Number(record.original_total_bytes ?? 0),
    source_path: sourcePath,
    source_directory: record.source_directory ?? sourcePath,
    artifact_path: coverPath,
    cover_path: record.cover_path ?? coverPath,
  }
}

export const api = {
  async preflight(): Promise<Preflight> {
    const value = await request<Preflight>('/system/preflight')
    return { ...value, checks: (value.checks ?? []).map((check) => ({ ...check, key: check.key ?? check.id ?? check.label })) }
  },

  async listBatches(): Promise<Batch[]> {
    return listFrom<Batch>(await request<unknown>('/batches')).map(normalizeBatch)
  },

  async listGallery(input: { query?: string; membership?: string; limit?: number; offset?: number } = {}): Promise<GalleryResponse> {
    const params = new URLSearchParams()
    if (input.query?.trim()) params.set('query', input.query.trim())
    if (input.membership && input.membership !== 'all') params.set('membership', input.membership)
    params.set('limit', String(input.limit ?? 100))
    params.set('offset', String(input.offset ?? 0))
    const suffix = params.toString()
    const value = await request<GalleryResponse | GalleryPid[] | { items?: GalleryPid[]; total?: number; limit?: number; offset?: number; stats?: GalleryResponse['stats'] }>(`/gallery${suffix ? `?${suffix}` : ''}`)
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return { items: value.map(normalizeGalleryItem), total: value.length, limit: input.limit ?? 100, offset: input.offset ?? 0 }
    return {
      ...value,
      items: Array.isArray(value.items) ? value.items.map(normalizeGalleryItem) : [],
      total: Number(value.total ?? value.items?.length ?? 0),
      limit: Number(value.limit ?? input.limit ?? 100),
      offset: Number(value.offset ?? input.offset ?? 0),
    }
  },

  syncGallery(): Promise<GallerySyncResult> {
    return request<GallerySyncResult>('/gallery/sync-jspace', { method: 'POST' })
  },

  getGalleryMembershipStatus(): Promise<GalleryMembershipStatus> {
    return request<GalleryMembershipStatus>('/gallery/membership/status')
  },

  backfillGalleryMembership(): Promise<GalleryMembershipStatus> {
    return request<GalleryMembershipStatus>('/gallery/membership/backfill', { method: 'POST' })
  },

  async checkGalleryFile(file: File): Promise<GalleryCheckResult> {
    validateGalleryCheckFile(file)
    const body = new FormData()
    body.append('file', file)
    return request<GalleryCheckResult>('/gallery/check-file', { method: 'POST', body })
  },

  async updateGalleryCategory(pid: string, category: string): Promise<GalleryPid> {
    return normalizeGalleryItem(await request<GalleryPid>(`/gallery/${encodeURIComponent(pid)}`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: JSON.stringify({ category }),
    }))
  },

  async getBatch(id: string): Promise<BatchDetail> {
    const payload = await request<BatchDetail | Batch>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`)
    const detail = normalizeDetail(payload)
    const record = payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload as unknown as Record<string, unknown> : {}
    const hasEmbeddedItems = Array.isArray(record.items)
      && (record.items.length > 0 || 'events' in record)
    const hasEmbeddedEvents = Array.isArray(record.events)
    const itemsRequest = hasEmbeddedItems
      ? null
      : request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/items`)
    const eventsRequest = hasEmbeddedEvents
      ? null
      : request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/events`)
    const [items, events] = await Promise.allSettled([
      itemsRequest ?? Promise.resolve(null),
      eventsRequest ?? Promise.resolve(null),
    ])
    return {
      ...detail,
      items: itemsRequest && items.status === 'fulfilled'
        ? listFrom<WorkflowItem>(items.value).map(normalizeItem)
        : detail.items,
      events: eventsRequest && events.status === 'fulfilled'
        ? listFrom<WorkflowEvent>(events.value)
        : detail.events ?? [],
    }
  },

  async previewImport(input: { text?: string; file?: File }): Promise<ImportPreview> {
    if (input.file) {
      validateImportFile(input.file)
      const body = new FormData()
      body.append('file', input.file)
      return request('/imports/preview-file', { method: 'POST', body })
    }
    return request('/imports/preview', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ text: input.text ?? '' }) })
  },

  async createBatch(input: { name: string; category: string; pids: string[]; worker_count?: number; profile_ids?: string[] }): Promise<Batch> {
    const value = await request<Batch>('/batches', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        name: input.name,
        category_mode: input.category,
        pids: input.pids,
        worker_count: input.worker_count ?? 3,
        profile_ids: input.profile_ids ?? [],
      }),
    })
    return normalizeBatch(value)
  },

  controlBatch(id: string, action: BatchAction): Promise<Batch | BatchDetail> {
    return request(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/${action}`, { method: 'POST' })
  },

  startBatch(id: string) {
    return this.controlBatch(id, 'start')
  },

  retryFailed(id: string): Promise<Batch | BatchDetail> {
    return request(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/retry-failed`, { method: 'POST' })
  },

  async getSettings(): Promise<Settings> {
    return normalizeSettings(await request<Settings>('/settings'))
  },
  async updateSettings(settings: Settings): Promise<Settings> {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('tk-workflow-profile-ids', JSON.stringify(settings.profile_ids ?? []))
    } catch {
      // The server settings still save when browser storage is unavailable.
    }
    const value = await request<Settings>('/settings', {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        execution_mode: settings.execution_mode,
        provider: settings.provider_base_url ?? settings.provider,
        model: settings.model,
        wire_api: settings.wire_api,
        auto_category_threshold: settings.confidence_threshold ?? settings.auto_category_threshold,
        worker_count: settings.worker_count,
        profile_ids: settings.profile_ids,
        master_summary_path: settings.product_summary_path ?? settings.summary_path ?? settings.master_summary_path,
        master_summary_mirror_path: settings.master_summary_mirror_path,
      }),
    })
    return normalizeSettings({ ...value, profile_ids: settings.profile_ids })
  },
  setSecret: (name: string, value: string) => request<{ configured: boolean }>(`/secrets/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    body: JSON.stringify({ value }),
  }),

  async getProfiles(refresh = false): Promise<ProfilesResponse> {
    const value = await request<ProfilesResponse | BrowserProfile[]>(`/integrations/bitbrowser/profiles${refresh ? '?refresh=true' : ''}`)
    return Array.isArray(value) ? { online: true, items: value } : { ...value, items: listFrom<BrowserProfile>(value) }
  },

  async exportBatch(id: string): Promise<ExportInfo> {
    const value = await request<ExportInfo>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/export`, { method: 'POST' })
    return {
      ...value,
      path: value.path ?? value.manifest_path ?? '',
      count: value.count ?? value.pid_count ?? 0,
    }
  },
  confirmIntegration: (id: string, kind: string, confirmed: boolean) => request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/confirmations`, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({ kind, confirmed }),
  }),
  updateItemCategory: (itemId: string, category: 'clothing' | 'non_clothing') => request<WorkflowItem>(`/items/${encodeURIComponent(itemId)}/category`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    body: JSON.stringify({ category }),
  }),
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import {
  Archive,
  AudioLines,
  CalendarDays,
  Check,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  Download,
  FileAudio2,
  FileText,
  Images,
  Info,
  Play,
  RefreshCw,
  Save,
  Search,
  Trash2,
  UploadCloud,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";
import {
  VIDEO_MODELS,
  filterVideoSuppliersByModel,
  type PublicVideoPromptModel,
  type PublicVideoSupplier,
  type VideoModelId,
} from "@/lib/workspace/production/catalog";
import {
  DEFAULT_VIDEO_ASPECT_RATIO,
  getDefaultVideoAspectRatio,
  getDefaultVideoDuration,
  getHighestVideoResolution,
  getVideoDurationOptions,
  type VideoCapability,
} from "@/lib/workspace/production/video-capabilities";
import { filterRecordsByShanghaiDate, shanghaiDate } from "@/lib/workspace/production/video-inventory";
import { filesFromDataTransfer, filterFilesByExtensions } from "@/lib/file-drop";
import {
  filterReferenceAudioAssets,
  validateReferenceAudioFileSelection,
  type ProductionAudioAsset,
  type ProductionImageAsset,
  type ProductionPromptAsset,
} from "./types";
import {
  type VideoReferenceRow,
} from "@/lib/workspace/production/video-reference";
import { matchVideoReferenceRow, videoReferencePid } from "@/lib/workspace/production/video-reference-pid";
import type { VideoTaskErrorDetail } from "@/lib/workspace/production/video-task-error";
import { displayVideoTaskPrompt } from "@/lib/workspace/production/video-task-prompt";
import { AssetImagePickerDialog } from "./AssetImagePickerDialog";
import { reconcileSavedPrompt } from "./prompt-draft-state";
import { promptForVideoSubmission } from "./video-prompt-input";
import styles from "./panels.module.css";

interface VideoProductionPanelProps {
  accountId: string;
  prompts: ProductionPromptAsset[];
  images: ProductionImageAsset[];
  audios: ProductionAudioAsset[];
  suppliers: PublicVideoSupplier[];
  promptModels: PublicVideoPromptModel[];
  canEdit: boolean;
  savedPromptDraft: string;
}

interface VideoTask {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  supplierId: string;
  modelId: string;
  promptMode: string;
  promptModel: string | null;
  promptPreview: string;
  suffixEnabled: boolean;
  duration: number;
  aspectRatio: string;
  resolution: string;
  status: VideoTaskStatus;
  progress: number;
  providerTaskId: string | null;
  videoUrl: string | null;
  childPrompt?: string | null;
  finalPrompt?: string | null;
  childPromptAvailable: boolean;
  audioAttached: boolean;
  inventorySaved: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  errorDetail: VideoTaskErrorDetail | null;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

interface VideoSuffixResponse {
  suffix?: string;
  source?: "saved" | "10000";
  updatedAt?: string | null;
}

type QueueTab = "active" | "completed" | "failed";
type TaskDialog = "video" | "prompt";
type VideoTaskStatus = "queued" | "prompting" | "submitting" | "submitted" | "processing" | "completed" | "failed";

async function responseData<T>(response: Response): Promise<T> {
  const payload = await response.json().catch(() => null) as { success?: boolean; data?: T; error?: string } | null;
  if (!response.ok || !payload?.success || !payload.data) throw new Error(payload?.error ?? "璇锋眰澶辫触");
  return payload.data;
}

const ACTIVE_STATUSES = new Set<VideoTaskStatus>(["queued", "prompting", "submitting", "submitted", "processing"]);
const STATUS_LABELS: Readonly<Record<VideoTaskStatus, string>> = {
  queued: "鎺掗槦涓?,
  prompting: "鎻愮ず璇?,
  submitting: "鎻愪氦涓?,
  submitted: "宸叉彁浜?,
  processing: "鐢熸垚涓?,
  completed: "宸插畬鎴?,
  failed: "澶辫触",
};

function taskPhase(task: VideoTask): string {
  if (task.status === "queued") return "绛夊緟鍚庡彴澶勭悊";
  if (task.status === "prompting") return "鐢熸垚鎻愮ず璇嶄腑";
  if (task.status === "submitting") return "鎻愮ず璇嶅凡瀹屾垚锛屾鍦ㄦ彁浜よ棰?;
  if (task.status === "submitted") return "瑙嗛鐢熸垚涓?;
  if (task.status === "processing") return `瑙嗛鐢熸垚涓?路 ${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, task.progress))}%`;
  if (task.status === "completed") return "宸插畬鎴?;
  return "浠诲姟澶辫触";
}

export function VideoProductionPanel({ accountId, prompts, images, audios, suppliers, promptModels, canEdit, savedPromptDraft }: VideoProductionPanelProps) {
  const [modelId, setModelId] = useState<VideoModelId>("omni");
  const [supplierId, setSupplierId] = useState("");
  const [promptMode, setPromptMode] = useState<"manual" | "asset-template-child-prompt">("manual");
  const [promptTemplates, setPromptTemplates] = useState<ProductionPromptAsset[]>(() => [...prompts]);
  const [templateId, setTemplateId] = useState("");
  const [manualTemplateId, setManualTemplateId] = useState("");
  const [saveAsTemplate, setSaveAsTemplate] = useState(false);
  const [templateName, setTemplateName] = useState("");
  const [promptModel, setPromptModel] = useState("gpt-2999");
  const [savedPrompt, setSavedPrompt] = useState(savedPromptDraft);
  const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState(savedPromptDraft);
  const [promptSaving, setPromptSaving] = useState(false);
  const [promptUpdatedAt, setPromptUpdatedAt] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [assetImageIds, setAssetImageIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [assetSearch, setAssetSearch] = useState("");
  const [assetPickerOpen, setAssetPickerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [audioAssets, setAudioAssets] = useState<ProductionAudioAsset[]>(() => [...audios]);
  const [selectedAudioAssetId, setSelectedAudioAssetId] = useState("");
  const [audioSearch, setAudioSearch] = useState("");
  const [audioUploading, setAudioUploading] = useState(false);
  const [audioDragActive, setAudioDragActive] = useState(false);
  const [audioError, setAudioError] = useState("");
  const [referenceRows, setReferenceRows] = useState<VideoReferenceRow[]>([]);
  const [referenceExcelName, setReferenceExcelName] = useState("");
  const [referenceExcelError, setReferenceExcelError] = useState("");
  const [referenceExcelDragActive, setReferenceExcelDragActive] = useState(false);
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState("10");
  const [aspectRatio, setAspectRatio] = useState<string>(DEFAULT_VIDEO_ASPECT_RATIO);
  const [resolution, setResolution] = useState("720p");
  const [count, setCount] = useState("1");
  const [suffixEnabled, setSuffixEnabled] = useState(false);
  const [savedSuffix, setSavedSuffix] = useState("");
  const [suffixDraft, setSuffixDraft] = useState("");
  const [suffixSource, setSuffixSource] = useState<"saved" | "10000">("10000");
  const [suffixUpdatedAt, setSuffixUpdatedAt] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [suffixLoading, setSuffixLoading] = useState(true);
  const [suffixSaving, setSuffixSaving] = useState(false);
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState<VideoTask[]>([]);
  const [queueTab, setQueueTab] = useState<QueueTab>("active");
  const [queueDate, setQueueDate] = useState(() => shanghaiDate());
  const [taskActionBusy, setTaskActionBusy] = useState("");
  const [dialogTask, setDialogTask] = useState<VideoTask | null>(null);
  const [dialogMode, setDialogMode] = useState<TaskDialog | null>(null);
  const [dialogPrompt, setDialogPrompt] = useState("");
  const [dialogLoading, setDialogLoading] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const previousCapabilityKey = useRef("");
  const taskLoadSequence = useRef(0);
  const submissionLock = useRef(false);
  const pendingSubmission = useRef<{ id: string; payload: string } | null>(null);

  const availableSuppliers = useMemo(() => filterVideoSuppliersByModel(suppliers, modelId), [modelId, suppliers]);
  const selectedSupplier = availableSuppliers.find((supplier) => supplier.id === supplierId) ?? null;
  const isMiniMax = selectedSupplier?.id === "minimax";
  const selectedCapability: VideoCapability | null = selectedSupplier?.capabilities?.[modelId] ?? null;
  const capabilityKey = selectedSupplier ? `${selectedSupplier.id}:${modelId}` : "";
  const durationOptions = useMemo(
    () => selectedCapability ? getVideoDurationOptions(selectedCapability) : [],
    [selectedCapability],
  );
  const selectedImages = useMemo(
    () => assetImageIds.map((id) => images.find((image) => image.id === id)).filter((image): image is ProductionImageAsset => Boolean(image)),
    [assetImageIds, images],
  );
  const filteredAudioAssets = useMemo(
    () => filterReferenceAudioAssets(audioAssets, audioSearch),
    [audioAssets, audioSearch],
  );
  const selectedAudioAsset = audioAssets.find((asset) => asset.id === selectedAudioAssetId) ?? null;
  const selectedImage = selectedImages[0] ?? null;
  const selectedImagePid = selectedImage ? videoReferencePid(selectedImage.originalName) : "";
  const selectedReferenceRow = selectedImage ? matchVideoReferenceRow(referenceRows, selectedImage.originalName) : null;
  const templateReferenceIssue = promptMode !== "asset-template-child-prompt"
    ? ""
    : selectedImages.length === 0
      ? "璇峰厛閫夋嫨鍙傝€冨浘"
      : !selectedReferenceRow
        ? "褰撳墠鍙傝€冨浘娌℃湁鍖归厤鍒板弬鑰?Excel"
        : !selectedReferenceRow.title.trim()
          ? "褰撳墠 PID 娌℃湁鍖归厤鍒版爣棰?
          : !selectedReferenceRow.description.trim()
            ? "褰撳墠 PID 娌℃湁鍖归厤鍒版弿杩?
            : "";
  const selectedTemplate = promptTemplates.find((item) => item.id === templateId) ?? null;
  const selectedPromptModel = promptModels.find((item) => item.id === promptModel) ?? null;
  const visibleDateTasks = useMemo(() => filterRecordsByShanghaiDate(tasks, queueDate), [queueDate, tasks]);
  const activeTasks = visibleDateTasks.filter((task) => ACTIVE_STATUSES.has(task.status));
  const completedTasks = visibleDateTasks.filter((task) => task.status === "completed");
  const failedTasks = visibleDateTasks.filter((task) => task.status === "failed");
  const visibleTasks = queueTab === "active" ? activeTasks : queueTab === "completed" ? completedTasks : failedTasks;
  const suffixDirty = suffixDraft !== savedSuffix;
  const promptDirty = prompt !== savedPrompt;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!availableSuppliers.some((supplier) => supplier.id === supplierId)) setSupplierId(availableSuppliers[0]?.id ?? "");
  }, [availableSuppliers, supplierId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedCapability) return;
    const capabilityChanged = previousCapabilityKey.current !== capabilityKey;
    previousCapabilityKey.current = capabilityKey;
    if (capabilityChanged) {
      setDuration(String(getDefaultVideoDuration(selectedCapability)));
      setAspectRatio(getDefaultVideoAspectRatio(selectedCapability.aspectRatios));
      setResolution(getHighestVideoResolution(selectedCapability.resolutions));
    }
    if (!durationOptions.includes(Number(duration))) {
      setDuration(String(getDefaultVideoDuration(selectedCapability)));
    }
    if (!selectedCapability.aspectRatios.includes(aspectRatio as never)) setAspectRatio(getDefaultVideoAspectRatio(selectedCapability.aspectRatios));
    if (!selectedCapability.resolutions.includes(resolution as never)) setResolution(getHighestVideoResolution(selectedCapability.resolutions));
    if (selectedCapability.referenceImages.max === 0 && assetImageIds.length > 0) setAssetImageIds([]);
    if (selectedCapability.referenceImages.max > 0 && assetImageIds.length > selectedCapability.referenceImages.max) {
      setAssetImageIds((current) => current.slice(0, selectedCapability.referenceImages.max));
    }
  }, [assetImageIds, aspectRatio, capabilityKey, duration, durationOptions, resolution, selectedCapability]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!promptModels.some((model) => model.id === promptModel)) setPromptModel(promptModels[0]?.id ?? "gpt-2999");
  }, [promptModel, promptModels]);

  const loadTasks = useCallback(async (date = queueDate) => {
    const sequence = ++taskLoadSequence.current;
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/workspace/accounts/${accountId}/video-tasks?date=${encodeURIComponent(date)}`, { cache: "no-store" });
      const payload = await response.json() as { success?: boolean; data?: { tasks?: VideoTask[] } };
      if (response.ok && payload.success && sequence === taskLoadSequence.current) setTasks(payload.data?.tasks ?? []);
    } catch {
      // Polling retries on the next interval.
    }
  }, [accountId, queueDate]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadTasks();
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => void loadTasks(), 8_000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, [loadTasks]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    async function loadSuffix() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/workspace/video-settings", { cache: "no-store" });
        const payload = await response.json() as { success?: boolean; data?: VideoSuffixResponse; error?: string };
        if (!response.ok || !payload.success || !payload.data || cancelled) {
          if (!cancelled) setMessage(payload.error ?? "瑙嗛鍚庣紑璇诲彇澶辫触");
          return;
        }
        const nextSuffix = payload.data.suffix ?? "";
        setSavedSuffix(nextSuffix);
        setSuffixDraft(nextSuffix);
        setSuffixSource(payload.data.source ?? "10000");
        setSuffixUpdatedAt(payload.data.updatedAt ?? null);
      } catch {
        if (!cancelled) setMessage("瑙嗛鍚庣紑璇诲彇澶辫触锛岃绋嶅悗閲嶈瘯");
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setSuffixLoading(false);
      }
    }
    void loadSuffix();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);

  function changeModel(nextModelId: VideoModelId) {
    const nextSuppliers = filterVideoSuppliersByModel(suppliers, nextModelId);
    setModelId(nextModelId);
    setSupplierId(nextSuppliers[0]?.id ?? "");
    const capability = nextSuppliers[0]?.capabilities?.[nextModelId];
    if (capability) {
      setAspectRatio(getDefaultVideoAspectRatio(capability.aspectRatios));
      setResolution(getHighestVideoResolution(capability.resolutions));
      setDuration(String(getDefaultVideoDuration(capability)));
    }
  }

  function changeSupplier(nextSupplierId: string) {
    setSupplierId(nextSupplierId);
    const capability = availableSuppliers.find((supplier) => supplier.id === nextSupplierId)?.capabilities?.[modelId];
    if (!capability) return;
    setAspectRatio(getDefaultVideoAspectRatio(capability.aspectRatios));
    setResolution(getHighestVideoResolution(capability.resolutions));
    setDuration(String(getDefaultVideoDuration(capability)));
  }

  function selectTemplate(id: string) {
    setTemplateId(id);
    setMessage(id ? "宸查€夋嫨妯℃澘锛屾彁浜ゆ椂浼氳嚜鍔ㄧ敓鎴愬苟淇濆瓨瀛愭彁绀鸿瘝" : "");
  }

  function selectManualTemplate(id: string) {
    setManualTemplateId(id);
    const selectedTemplate = promptTemplates.find((item) => item.id === id);
    if (!selectedTemplate) {
      setMessage("");
      return;
    }
    setPrompt(selectedTemplate.content);

  }

  function toggleAssetImage(id: string) {
    setAssetImageIds((current) => {
      if (current.includes(id)) return current.filter((imageId) => imageId !== id);
      const maximum = selectedCapability?.referenceImages.max ?? 0;
      if (maximum === 0) return current;
      if (current.length >= maximum) {
        setMessage(`褰撳墠妯″瀷鏈€澶氭敮鎸?${maximum} 寮犲弬鑰冨浘`);
        return current;
      }
      setMessage("");
      return [...current, id];
    });

  async function saveSuffix() {
    if (!canEdit || suffixSaving) return;
    if (!suffixDirty) {
      setMessage("褰撳墠鍚庣紑娌℃湁鏂扮殑淇敼");
      return;
    }
    setSuffixSaving(true);
    setMessage("姝ｅ湪淇濆瓨缁熶竴鍚庣紑...");
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/workspace/video-settings", {
        method: "POST",

        body: JSON.stringify({ suffix: suffixDraft }),
      });
      const payload = await response.json() as { success?: boolean; data?: VideoSuffixResponse; error?: string };
      if (!response.ok || !payload.success || !payload.data) {
        setMessage(payload.error ?? "瑙嗛鍚庣紑淇濆瓨澶辫触");
        return;
      }
      const nextSuffix = payload.data.suffix ?? "";
      setSavedSuffix(nextSuffix);
      setSuffixDraft(nextSuffix);
      setSuffixSource(payload.data.source ?? "saved");
      setSuffixUpdatedAt(payload.data.updatedAt ?? null);

    } finally {
      setSuffixSaving(false);
    }
  }

        setPromptTemplates((current) => [

      const errorMessage = requestError instanceof Error ? requestError.message : "璇锋眰澶辫触";

    } finally {
      setPromptSaving(false);
    }
  }

\n```\n\n## Thread 01a04747-6d1e-7d92-9785-813375512187\n- created_at_ms: 1787902333827\n- item_type: commandExecution\n\n```text\n"C:\\Windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe" -Command "Get-Content C:\\Users\\EDY\\tk-image-workflow-web\\backend\\app\\schemas.py | Select-Object -First 320"\nGet-Content C:\Users\EDY\tk-image-workflow-web\backend\app\schemas.py | Select-Object -First 320\nfrom __future__ import annotations

import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, SecretStr, field_validator

from app.validation import PID_PATTERN, PID_REQUIREMENT

BITBROWSER_PROFILE_ID_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$")
BITBROWSER_PROFILE_ID_REQUIREMENT = (
    "BitBrowser 閰嶇疆 ID 鍙兘鍖呭惈瀛楁瘝銆佹暟瀛椼€佷笅鍒掔嚎鍜岃繛瀛楃"
)


class StrictModel(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", str_strip_whitespace=True)


class PreviewTextRequest(StrictModel):
    text: str = Field(max_length=1_048_576)


class CreateBatchRequest(StrictModel):
    name: str = Field(default="鏈懡鍚嶆壒娆?, min_length=1, max_length=100)
    pids: list[str] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=10_000)
    category_mode: Literal["auto", "clothing", "non_clothing"] = "auto"
    worker_count: int = Field(default=3, ge=1, le=3)
    profile_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=3)

    @field_validator("pids")
    @classmethod
    def validate_pids(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        normalized = [value.strip() for value in values]
        invalid = [value for value in normalized if not PID_PATTERN.fullmatch(value)]
        if invalid:
            raise ValueError(PID_REQUIREMENT)
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))

    @field_validator("profile_ids")
    @classmethod
    def validate_profiles(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        normalized = [value.strip() for value in values]
        if any(
            not BITBROWSER_PROFILE_ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(value) for value in normalized
        ):
            raise ValueError(BITBROWSER_PROFILE_ID_REQUIREMENT)
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))


class SettingsUpdateRequest(StrictModel):
    data_root: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    master_summary_path: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    master_summary_mirror_path: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    provider: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    model: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=100)
    wire_api: Literal["responses"] | None = None
    auto_category_threshold: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=1)
    worker_count: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1, le=3)
    profile_ids: list[str] | None = Field(default=None, max_length=3)
    execution_mode: Literal["real", "mock"] | None = None

    @field_validator("profile_ids")
    @classmethod
    def validate_profile_ids(cls, values: list[str] | None) -> list[str] | None:
        if values is None:
            return None
        normalized = [value.strip() for value in values]
        if any(
            not BITBROWSER_PROFILE_ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(value) for value in normalized
        ):
            raise ValueError(BITBROWSER_PROFILE_ID_REQUIREMENT)
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))

    @field_validator("data_root", "master_summary_path", "master_summary_mirror_path")
    @classmethod
    def validate_absolute_path(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is not None and not Path(value).expanduser().is_absolute():
            raise ValueError("蹇呴』浣跨敤缁濆璺緞")
        return value

    @field_validator("master_summary_path", "master_summary_mirror_path")
    @classmethod
    def validate_summary_workbook(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is not None and Path(value).suffix.casefold() != ".xlsx":
            raise ValueError("鍟嗗搧姹囨€荤洰鏍囧繀椤绘槸 .xlsx 鏂囦欢")
        return value

    @field_validator("provider")
    @classmethod
    def validate_provider(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is None:
            return value
        parsed = urlsplit(value)
        if parsed.scheme != "https" or not parsed.hostname or parsed.username or parsed.password:
            raise ValueError("妯″瀷鏈嶅姟鍦板潃蹇呴』鏄?HTTPS URL")
        return value.rstrip("/")


class SecretUpdateRequest(StrictModel):
    value: SecretStr = Field(min_length=1, max_length=8192)


class ConfirmationRequest(StrictModel):
    kind: Literal[
        "feishu_marked", "jspace_products_uploaded", "jspace_raw_uploaded"
    ]
    confirmed: bool


class CategoryConfirmationRequest(StrictModel):
    category: Literal["clothing", "non_clothing"]


class GalleryImportItem(StrictModel):
    pid: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=64)
    category: Literal["cap", "tap", "unknown"] = "unknown"
    source_path: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=1000)
    artifact_path: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=1000)

    @field_validator("pid")
    @classmethod
    def validate_pid(cls, value: str) -> str:
        normalized = value.strip()
        if not PID_PATTERN.fullmatch(normalized):
            raise ValueError(PID_REQUIREMENT)
        return normalized


class GalleryImportRequest(StrictModel):
    items: list[GalleryImportItem] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100_000)


class GalleryCheckPidsRequest(StrictModel):
    pids: list[str] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100_000)

    @field_validator("pids")
    @classmethod
    def validate_pids(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        normalized = [value.strip() for value in values]
        invalid = [value for value in normalized if not PID_PATTERN.fullmatch(value)]
        if invalid:
            raise ValueError(PID_REQUIREMENT)
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))


class GalleryLiveBackfillRequest(GalleryCheckPidsRequest):
    pids: list[str] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=5_000)


class GalleryCategoryUpdateRequest(StrictModel):
    category: Literal["cap", "tap", "unknown"]


class OriginalGalleryDiscoverRequest(StrictModel):
    source_roots: list[str] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)
    target_root: Literal["/sata11/public/鏂板獟浣撻儴/鍘熷浘"] = "/sata11/public/鏂板獟浣撻儴/鍘熷浘"

    @field_validator("source_roots")
    @classmethod
    def validate_source_roots(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        normalized: list[str] = []
        for value in values:
            path = "/" + str(value).strip().replace("\\", "/").strip("/")
            parts = path.split("/")[1:]
            if any(not part or part in {".", ".."} for part in parts):
                raise ValueError("鏋佺┖闂存簮鐩綍蹇呴』鏄鑼冪殑缁濆璺緞")
            if not path.startswith("/sata11/public/鏂板獟浣撻儴/"):
                raise ValueError("鏋佺┖闂存簮鐩綍蹇呴』浣嶄簬鏂板獟浣撻儴鐩綍涓?)
            normalized.append(path)
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))


class OriginalGalleryCopyRequest(StrictModel):
    max_pids: int = Field(default=20, ge=1, le=100)

BITBROWSER_PROFILE_ID_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$")

class StrictModel(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", str_strip_whitespace=True)


class PreviewTextRequest(StrictModel):
    text: str = Field(max_length=1_048_576)


class CreateBatchRequest(StrictModel):
    name: str = Field(default="鏈懡鍚嶆壒娆?, min_length=1, max_length=100)
    pids: list[str] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=10_000)
    category_mode: Literal["auto", "clothing", "non_clothing"] = "auto"
    worker_count: int = Field(default=3, ge=1, le=3)
    profile_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=3)

    @field_validator("pids")
    @classmethod
    def validate_pids(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        normalized = [value.strip() for value in values]
        invalid = [value for value in normalized if not PID_PATTERN.fullmatch(value)]
        if invalid:
            raise ValueError(PID_REQUIREMENT)
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))

    @field_validator("profile_ids")
    @classmethod
    def validate_profiles(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        normalized = [value.strip() for value in values]
        if any(
            not BITBROWSER_PROFILE_ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(value) for value in normalized
        ):
            raise ValueError(BITBROWSER_PROFILE_ID_REQUIREMENT)
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))


class SettingsUpdateRequest(StrictModel):
    data_root: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    master_summary_path: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)

    worker_count: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1, le=3)
    profile_ids: list[str] | None = Field(default=None, max_length=3)

    @field_validator("profile_ids")

        if any(

        return value

    kind: Literal[        "feishu_marked", "jspace_products_uploaded", "jspace_raw_uploaded"    ]
    confirmed: bool


class CategoryConfirmationRequest(StrictModel):
    category: Literal["clothing", "non_clothing"]


class GalleryImportItem(StrictModel):
    pid: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=64)
    category: Literal["cap", "tap", "unknown"] = "unknown"
    source_path: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=1000)
    artifact_path: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=1000)

    @field_validator("pid")
    @classmethod
    def validate_pid(cls, value: str) -> str:
        normalized = value.strip()

class GalleryImportRequest(StrictModel):
    items: list[GalleryImportItem] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100_000)


class GalleryCheckPidsRequest(StrictModel):
    pids: list[str] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100_000)

    @field_validator("pids")
    @classmethod

        normalized = [value.strip() for value in values]

        if invalid:
            raise ValueError(PID_REQUIREMENT)
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))


class GalleryLiveBackfillRequest(GalleryCheckPidsRequest):

class GalleryCategoryUpdateRequest(StrictModel):

def _allowed_hosts_from_environment() -> tuple[str, ...]:
    configured = os.environ.get("TK_WORKFLOW_ALLOWED_HOSTS")
    if configured is None:
        return DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTS
    hosts = tuple(
        dict.fromkeys(
            host.strip().casefold()
            for host in configured.split(",")
            if host.strip()
        )
    )
    return hosts or DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTS


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AppConfig:
    data_root: Path = DEFAULT_DATA_ROOT
    database_path: Path | None = None
    master_summary_path: Path = DEFAULT_MASTER_SUMMARY
    master_summary_mirror_path: Path = DEFAULT_MASTER_SUMMARY_MIRROR
    bitbrowser_executable: Path = DEFAULT_BITBROWSER_EXECUTABLE

    api_prefix: str = "/api/v1"
    allowed_hosts: tuple[str, ...] = field(default=DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTS)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        normalized_root = Path(self.data_root).expanduser().resolve()
        object.__setattr__(self, "data_root", normalized_root)
        database_path = self.database_path or normalized_root / "workflow.db"
        object.__setattr__(self, "database_path", Path(database_path).expanduser().resolve())
        summary_path = Path(self.master_summary_path).expanduser().resolve()
        if summary_path.suffix.casefold() != ".xlsx":
            raise ValueError("master_summary_path 蹇呴』鏄?.xlsx 鏂囦欢")
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "master_summary_path",
            summary_path,
        )
        mirror_path = Path(self.master_summary_mirror_path).expanduser().resolve()
        if mirror_path.suffix.casefold() != ".xlsx":
            raise ValueError("master_summary_mirror_path 蹇呴』鏄?.xlsx 鏂囦欢")
        object.__setattr__(self, "master_summary_mirror_path", mirror_path)
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "bitbrowser_executable",

        )
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "bitbrowser_db_path",
            Path(self.bitbrowser_db_path).expanduser().resolve(),
        )

    @classmethod
    def from_environment(cls) -> AppConfig:
        data_root = Path(os.environ.get("TK_WORKFLOW_DATA_ROOT", str(DEFAULT_DATA_ROOT)))
        return cls(
            data_root=data_root,
            database_path=Path(os.environ["TK_WORKFLOW_DATABASE_PATH"])

            master_summary_path=Path(

    @app.post(f"{prefix}/imports/preview-file")
    async def preview_file(file: Annotated[UploadFile, File()]) -> JSONResponse:
        suffix = Path(file.filename or "").suffix.casefold()
        if suffix != ".xlsx":

        content = await file.read(MAX_XLSX_BYTES + 1)
        return success(parse_pid_xlsx(content).to_dict())

    @app.get(f"{prefix}/gallery")
    def list_gallery(
        query: str = Query(default="", max_length=100),
        category: str | None = Query(default=None),
        membership: str | None = Query(default=None),
        limit: int = Query(default=100, ge=1, le=1000),
        offset: int = Query(default=0, ge=0),
    ) -> JSONResponse:
        items, total = app.state.gallery_repository.list_items(
            query=query,
            category=category,
            membership=membership,
            limit=limit,
            offset=offset,
        )
        return success({
            "items": [serialize_gallery_item(item, prefix) for item in items],
            "total": total,
            "limit": limit,
            "offset": offset,
            "stats": app.state.gallery_repository.stats(),
        })

    @app.get(f"{prefix}/gallery/{{pid}}/cover")
    async def read_gallery_cover(pid: str) -> FileResponse:
        try:
            artifact = await asyncio.to_thread(
                app.state.gallery_cover_service.resolve, pid
            )
        except GalleryCoverNotFoundError as error:
            raise NotFoundError(str(error)) from error
        except GalleryCoverError as error:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=502,
                detail={
                    "code": "gallery_cover_unavailable",
                    "message": str(error),
                },
            ) from error
        return FileResponse(
            artifact.path,
            media_type=artifact.media_type,
            content_disposition_type="inline",
            headers={
                "Cache-Control": "private, max-age=86400, immutable",
                "ETag": f'"{artifact.etag}"',
                "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff",
            },
        )

    @app.post(f"{prefix}/gallery/import")
    async def import_gallery(payload: GalleryImportRequest) -> JSONResponse:
        items = [item.model_dump() for item in payload.items]
        imported = await asyncio.to_thread(
            gallery_membership_service.import_items,
            items,
        )
        return success({
            "imported": imported,
            "total": app.state.gallery_repository.count(),
            "membership_backfill_started": False,
        })

    @app.get(f"{prefix}/gallery/membership/status")
    def gallery_membership_status() -> JSONResponse:
        return success(gallery_membership_service.status())

    @app.post(f"{prefix}/gallery/membership/backfill", status_code=202)
    async def backfill_gallery_membership() -> JSONResponse:
        await app.state.schedule_membership_backfill()
        return success(gallery_membership_service.status(), status_code=202)

    @app.post(f"{prefix}/gallery/membership/live-backfill", status_code=202)
    async def live_backfill_gallery_membership(
        payload: GalleryLiveBackfillRequest,
    ) -> JSONResponse:
        current = gallery_membership_service.status()
        if current["running"]:
            return success(
                {**current, "queued_for_live_lookup": 0},
                status_code=202,
            )
        try:
            queued = gallery_repository.queue_neither_for_live_lookup(payload.pids)
        except ValueError as error:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error)) from error
        await app.state.schedule_membership_backfill(queued)
        return success(
            {
                **gallery_membership_service.status(),
                "queued_for_live_lookup": len(queued),
            },
            status_code=202,
        )

    @app.post(f"{prefix}/gallery/check-pids")
    def check_gallery_pids(payload: GalleryCheckPidsRequest) -> JSONResponse:
        known = sorted(app.state.gallery_repository.existing_pids(payload.pids))
        known_set = set(known)
        missing = [pid for pid in payload.pids if pid not in known_set]
        return success({"known": known, "missing": missing, "items": app.state.gallery_repository.get_items(known)})

        result = gallery_check_service.check_upload(
            filename=file.filename or "",
            content=content,
        )
        download_path = result.get("download_path")

            "download_url": _artifact_url(download_path, prefix),
        })

} from './types'

const API_BASE = '/api/v1'
const MEBIBYTE = 1024 * 1024
const IMPORT_XLSX_MAX_BYTES = 5 * MEBIBYTE
const GALLERY_TXT_MAX_BYTES = MEBIBYTE

const XLSX_MIME_TYPES = new Set([
  'application/octet-stream',
  'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
])
const TXT_MIME_TYPES = new Set(['application/octet-stream', 'text/plain'])

export class ApiError extends Error {
  status: number

  constructor(message: string, status: number) {
    super(message)
    this.name = 'ApiError'
    this.status = status
  }
}

function payloadErrorMessage(payload: unknown, fallback: string): string {
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') {
    return typeof payload === 'string' && payload.trim() ? payload : fallback
  }
  const record = payload as Record<string, unknown>
  const nestedError = record.error && typeof record.error === 'object'
    ? record.error as Record<string, unknown>
    : null
  const message = record.detail ?? record.message ?? nestedError?.message ?? record.error
  return typeof message === 'string' && message.trim() ? message : fallback
}

function unwrap<T>(payload: unknown): T {
  if (payload && typeof payload === 'object') {
    const record = payload as Record<string, unknown>
    if ('success' in record && 'data' in record) return record.data as T
    if (Object.keys(record).length === 1 && 'data' in record) return record.data as T
  }
  return payload as T
}

export function listFrom<T>(payload: unknown): T[] {
  const value = unwrap<unknown>(payload)
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value as T[]
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return []
  const record = value as Record<string, unknown>
  if (Array.isArray(record.items)) return record.items as T[]
  if (Array.isArray(record.data)) return record.data as T[]
  if (record.data && typeof record.data === 'object' && Array.isArray((record.data as Record<string, unknown>).items)) {
    return (record.data as { items: T[] }).items
  }
  return []
}

async function request<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const headers = new Headers(init?.headers)
  if (init?.body && !(init.body instanceof FormData)) headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json')
  headers.set('Accept', 'application/json')

  let response: Response
  try {
    response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, { ...init, headers })
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError('鏃犳硶杩炴帴鏈湴鏈嶅姟锛岃纭鏈嶅姟宸茬粡鍚姩銆?, 0)
  }

  const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || ''
  let payload: unknown
  try {
    payload = contentType.includes('json') ? await response.json() : await response.text()
  } catch {
    const message = response.ok ? '鏈湴鏈嶅姟杩斿洖浜嗘棤娉曡В鏋愮殑鏁版嵁銆? : `璇锋眰澶辫触 (${response.status})`
    throw new ApiError(message, response.status)
  }
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new ApiError(payloadErrorMessage(payload, `璇锋眰澶辫触 (${response.status})`), response.status)
  }
  if (payload && typeof payload === 'object' && (payload as Record<string, unknown>).success === false) {
    throw new ApiError(payloadErrorMessage(payload, '璇锋眰鏈垚鍔熷畬鎴愩€?), response.status)
  }
  return unwrap<T>(payload)
}

function fileExtension(file: File): string {
  const separator = file.name.lastIndexOf('.')
  return separator >= 0 ? file.name.slice(separator).toLowerCase() : ''
}

function validateFileSize(file: File, maxBytes: number, message: string): void {
  if (file.size <= 0) throw new ApiError('鏂囦欢鍐呭涓虹┖锛岃閲嶆柊閫夋嫨銆?, 0)
  if (file.size > maxBytes) throw new ApiError(message, 0)
}

function validateMime(file: File, allowed: Set<string>, message: string): void {
  const mime = file.type.trim().toLowerCase()
  if (mime && !allowed.has(mime)) throw new ApiError(message, 0)
}

function validateImportFile(file: File): void {
  if (fileExtension(file) !== '.xlsx') throw new ApiError('鍙敮鎸?.xlsx 鏂囦欢銆?, 0)
  validateFileSize(file, IMPORT_XLSX_MAX_BYTES, 'Excel 鏂囦欢涓嶈兘瓒呰繃 5 MB銆?)
  validateMime(file, XLSX_MIME_TYPES, '鏂囦欢绫诲瀷涓?.xlsx 涓嶅尮閰嶃€?)
}

function validateGalleryCheckFile(file: File): void {
  const extension = fileExtension(file)
  if (extension !== '.xlsx' && extension !== '.txt') {
    throw new ApiError('鍙敮鎸?.xlsx 鎴?.txt 鏂囦欢銆?, 0)
  }
  if (extension === '.xlsx') {
    validateFileSize(file, IMPORT_XLSX_MAX_BYTES, 'Excel 鏂囦欢涓嶈兘瓒呰繃 5 MB銆?)
    validateMime(file, XLSX_MIME_TYPES, '鏂囦欢绫诲瀷涓?.xlsx 涓嶅尮閰嶃€?)
    return
  }
  validateFileSize(file, GALLERY_TXT_MAX_BYTES, 'TXT 鏂囦欢涓嶈兘瓒呰繃 1 MB銆?)
  validateMime(file, TXT_MIME_TYPES, '鏂囦欢绫诲瀷涓?.txt 涓嶅尮閰嶃€?)
}

function validateBusinessCategoryFile(file: File): void {
  validateImportFile(file)
}

export function safeArtifactDownloadUrl(value: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.startsWith(`${API_BASE}/artifacts?`)) return null
  try {
    const base = typeof window === 'undefined' ? 'http://localhost' : window.location.origin
    const url = new URL(value, base)
    if (url.origin !== base || url.pathname !== `${API_BASE}/artifacts` || url.hash) return null
    if (!url.searchParams.get('path')?.trim()) return null
    return value
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

function normalizeBatch(value: Batch | (Partial<Batch> & { id: string; name: string; status: string })): Batch {
  const record = value as Batch & { succeeded?: number }
  return {
    ...record,
    category: record.category ?? record.category_mode ?? 'auto',
    total: Number(record.total ?? 0),
    completed: Number(record.completed ?? record.succeeded ?? 0),
    failed: Number(record.failed ?? 0),
  }
}

function normalizeSettings(value: Settings): Settings {
  let storedProfiles: string[] = []
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('tk-workflow-profile-ids')
    storedProfiles = saved ? JSON.parse(saved) as string[] : []
  } catch {
    storedProfiles = []
  }
  return {
    ...value,
    provider_base_url: value.provider_base_url ?? value.provider,
    confidence_threshold: value.confidence_threshold ?? value.auto_category_threshold,
    product_summary_path: value.product_summary_path ?? value.summary_path ?? value.master_summary_path,
    profile_ids: value.profile_ids ?? storedProfiles,
  }
}

function normalizeItem(value: WorkflowItem): WorkflowItem {
  const artifactUrl = value.artifact_path
    ? `/api/v1/artifacts?path=${encodeURIComponent(value.artifact_path)}`
    : undefined
  return {
    ...value,
    error: value.error ?? value.error_message,
    original_url: value.original_url ?? value.image_url ?? value.thumbnail_url ?? artifactUrl,
    thumbnail_url: value.thumbnail_url ?? value.original_url ?? value.image_url ?? artifactUrl,
    collage_url: value.collage_url ?? artifactUrl,
  }
}

function normalizeDetail(payload: BatchDetail | Batch): BatchDetail {
  if ('batch' in payload) {
    const stats = payload.stats ?? {}
    return {
      ...payload,
      batch: normalizeBatch({
        ...payload.batch,
        total: payload.batch.total ?? stats.total ?? 0,
        completed: payload.batch.completed ?? stats.succeeded ?? stats.completed ?? 0,
        failed: payload.batch.failed ?? stats.failed ?? 0,
      }),
      items: (Array.isArray(payload.items) ? payload.items : listFrom<WorkflowItem>((payload as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).items)).map(normalizeItem),
      export: payload.export ? { ...payload.export, path: payload.export.path ?? payload.export.manifest_path, count: payload.export.count ?? payload.export.pid_count } : undefined,
    }
  }
  return { batch: normalizeBatch(payload), items: [] }
}

function normalizeGalleryItem(value: GalleryPid): GalleryPid {
  const record = value as GalleryPid & {
    count?: number
    path?: string
    collage_path?: string
  }
  const imageCount = Number(record.original_image_count ?? record.image_count ?? record.count ?? 0)
  const sourcePath = record.source_directory ?? record.source_path ?? record.path
  const coverPath = record.cover_path ?? record.artifact_path ?? record.collage_path
  return {
    ...record,
    pid: String(record.pid ?? ''),
    image_count: imageCount,
    original_image_count: Number(record.original_image_count ?? imageCount),
    original_total_bytes: Number(record.original_total_bytes ?? 0),
    source_path: sourcePath,
    source_directory: record.source_directory ?? sourcePath,
    artifact_path: coverPath,
    cover_path: record.cover_path ?? coverPath,
  }
}

export const api = {
  async preflight(): Promise<Preflight> {
    const value = await request<Preflight>('/system/preflight')
    return { ...value, checks: (value.checks ?? []).map((check) => ({ ...check, key: check.key ?? check.id ?? check.label })) }
  },

  async listBatches(): Promise<Batch[]> {
    return listFrom<Batch>(await request<unknown>('/batches')).map(normalizeBatch)
  },

  async listGallery(input: { query?: string; membership?: string; limit?: number; offset?: number } = {}): Promise<GalleryResponse> {
    const params = new URLSearchParams()
    if (input.query?.trim()) params.set('query', input.query.trim())
    if (input.membership && input.membership !== 'all') params.set('membership', input.membership)
    params.set('limit', String(input.limit ?? 100))
    params.set('offset', String(input.offset ?? 0))
    const suffix = params.toString()
    const value = await request<GalleryResponse | GalleryPid[] | { items?: GalleryPid[]; total?: number; limit?: number; offset?: number; stats?: GalleryResponse['stats'] }>(`/gallery${suffix ? `?${suffix}` : ''}`)
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return { items: value.map(normalizeGalleryItem), total: value.length, limit: input.limit ?? 100, offset: input.offset ?? 0 }
    return {
      ...value,
      items: Array.isArray(value.items) ? value.items.map(normalizeGalleryItem) : [],
      total: Number(value.total ?? value.items?.length ?? 0),
      limit: Number(value.limit ?? input.limit ?? 100),
      offset: Number(value.offset ?? input.offset ?? 0),
    }
  },

  syncGallery(): Promise<GallerySyncResult> {
    return request<GallerySyncResult>('/gallery/sync-jspace', { method: 'POST' })
  },

  getGalleryMembershipStatus(): Promise<GalleryMembershipStatus> {
    return request<GalleryMembershipStatus>('/gallery/membership/status')
  },

  backfillGalleryMembership(): Promise<GalleryMembershipStatus> {
    return request<GalleryMembershipStatus>('/gallery/membership/backfill', { method: 'POST' })
  },

  async checkGalleryFile(file: File): Promise<GalleryCheckResult> {
    validateGalleryCheckFile(file)
    const body = new FormData()
    body.append('file', file)
    return request<GalleryCheckResult>('/gallery/check-file', { method: 'POST', body })
  },

  async updateGalleryCategory(pid: string, category: string): Promise<GalleryPid> {
    return normalizeGalleryItem(await request<GalleryPid>(`/gallery/${encodeURIComponent(pid)}`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: JSON.stringify({ category }),
    }))
  },

  async updateGalleryBusinessCategory(pid: string, category: 'clothing' | 'non_clothing' | 'unknown'): Promise<GalleryPid> {
    return normalizeGalleryItem(await request<GalleryPid>(`/gallery/${encodeURIComponent(pid)}/business-category`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: JSON.stringify({ category }),
    }))
  },

  async importGalleryBusinessCategories(file: File): Promise<BusinessCategoryImportResult> {
    validateBusinessCategoryFile(file)
    const body = new FormData()
    body.append('file', file)
    return request<BusinessCategoryImportResult>('/gallery/business-category/import', {
      method: 'POST',
      body,
    })
  },
