import os
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

DEFAULT_DATA_ROOT = Path(r"C:\Users\EDY\TKWorkflowData")
LEGACY_MASTER_SUMMARY = Path(r"C:\Users\EDY\Downloads\product_summary姹囨€?xlsx")
PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
DEFAULT_MASTER_SUMMARY = PROJECT_ROOT / "product_summary姹囨€?xlsx"
DEFAULT_MASTER_SUMMARY_MIRROR = Path(r"C:\Users\EDY\Desktop\product_summary姹囨€?xlsx")
DEFAULT_BITBROWSER_EXECUTABLE = Path(r"D:\bitbrowser\姣旂壒娴忚鍣?exe")
DEFAULT_BITBROWSER_DB = Path(r"C:\Users\EDY\AppData\Roaming\BitBrowser\db.sqlite")
DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTS = ("127.0.0.1", "localhost", "testserver")


def _allowed_hosts_from_environment() -> tuple[str, ...]:
    configured = os.environ.get("TK_WORKFLOW_ALLOWED_HOSTS")
    if configured is None:
        return DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTS
    hosts = tuple(
        dict.fromkeys(
            host.strip().casefold()
            for host in configured.split(",")
            if host.strip()
        )
    )
    return hosts or DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTS


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AppConfig:
    data_root: Path = DEFAULT_DATA_ROOT
    database_path: Path | None = None
    master_summary_path: Path = DEFAULT_MASTER_SUMMARY
    master_summary_mirror_path: Path = DEFAULT_MASTER_SUMMARY_MIRROR
    bitbrowser_executable: Path = DEFAULT_BITBROWSER_EXECUTABLE
    bitbrowser_db_path: Path = DEFAULT_BITBROWSER_DB
    bitbrowser_base_url: str = "http://127.0.0.1:54345"
    product_pool_api_base: str = "http://127.0.0.1:8003"
    provider: str = "https://2999api.com/v1"
    model: str = "gpt-5.5"
    wire_api: str = "responses"
    auto_category_threshold: float = 0.8
    worker_count: int = 3
    execution_mode: str = "real"
    api_prefix: str = "/api/v1"
    allowed_hosts: tuple[str, ...] = field(default=DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTS)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        normalized_root = Path(self.data_root).expanduser().resolve()
        object.__setattr__(self, "data_root", normalized_root)
        database_path = self.database_path or normalized_root / "workflow.db"
        object.__setattr__(self, "database_path", Path(database_path).expanduser().resolve())
        summary_path = Path(self.master_summary_path).expanduser().resolve()
        if summary_path.suffix.casefold() != ".xlsx":
            raise ValueError("master_summary_path 蹇呴』鏄?.xlsx 鏂囦欢")
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "master_summary_path",
            summary_path,
        )
        mirror_path = Path(self.master_summary_mirror_path).expanduser().resolve()
        if mirror_path.suffix.casefold() != ".xlsx":
            raise ValueError("master_summary_mirror_path 蹇呴』鏄?.xlsx 鏂囦欢")
        object.__setattr__(self, "master_summary_mirror_path", mirror_path)
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "bitbrowser_executable",
            Path(self.bitbrowser_executable).expanduser().resolve(),
        )
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "bitbrowser_db_path",
            Path(self.bitbrowser_db_path).expanduser().resolve(),
        )

    @classmethod
    def from_environment(cls) -> AppConfig:
        data_root = Path(os.environ.get("TK_WORKFLOW_DATA_ROOT", str(DEFAULT_DATA_ROOT)))
        return cls(
            data_root=data_root,
            database_path=Path(os.environ["TK_WORKFLOW_DATABASE_PATH"])
            if os.environ.get("TK_WORKFLOW_DATABASE_PATH")
            else None,
            master_summary_path=Path(
                os.environ.get("TK_WORKFLOW_MASTER_SUMMARY", str(DEFAULT_MASTER_SUMMARY))
            ),
            master_summary_mirror_path=Path(
                os.environ.get(
                    "TK_WORKFLOW_MASTER_SUMMARY_MIRROR",
                    str(DEFAULT_MASTER_SUMMARY_MIRROR),
                )
            ),
            bitbrowser_executable=Path(
                os.environ.get(
                    "TK_WORKFLOW_BITBROWSER_EXECUTABLE",
                    str(DEFAULT_BITBROWSER_EXECUTABLE),
                )
            ),
            bitbrowser_db_path=Path(
                os.environ.get("TK_WORKFLOW_BITBROWSER_DB", str(DEFAULT_BITBROWSER_DB))
            ),
            bitbrowser_base_url=os.environ.get(
                "TK_WORKFLOW_BITBROWSER_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:54345"
            ),
            product_pool_api_base=os.environ.get(
                "TK_PRODUCT_POOL_API_BASE", "http://127.0.0.1:8003"
            ),
            allowed_hosts=_allowed_hosts_from_environment(),
        )

    def default_settings(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {
            "data_root": str(self.data_root),
            "master_summary_path": str(self.master_summary_path),
            "master_summary_mirror_path": str(self.master_summary_mirror_path),
            "bitbrowser_base_url": self.bitbrowser_base_url,
            "provider": self.provider,
            "model": self.model,
            "wire_api": self.wire_api,
            "auto_category_threshold": self.auto_category_threshold,
            "worker_count": self.worker_count,
            "profile_ids": [],
            "execution_mode": self.execution_mode,
        }

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

DEFAULT_DATA_ROOT = Path(r"C:\Users\EDY\TKWorkflowData")
LEGACY_MASTER_SUMMARY = Path(r"C:\Users\EDY\Downloads\product_summary姹囨€?xlsx")
PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
DEFAULT_MASTER_SUMMARY = PROJECT_ROOT / "product_summary姹囨€?xlsx"
DEFAULT_MASTER_SUMMARY_MIRROR = Path(r"C:\Users\EDY\Desktop\product_summary姹囨€?xlsx")
DEFAULT_BITBROWSER_EXECUTABLE = Path(r"D:\bitbrowser\姣旂壒娴忚鍣?exe")
DEFAULT_BITBROWSER_DB = Path(r"C:\Users\EDY\AppData\Roaming\BitBrowser\db.sqlite")
DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTS = ("127.0.0.1", "localhost", "testserver")


def _allowed_hosts_from_environment() -> tuple[str, ...]:
    configured = os.environ.get("TK_WORKFLOW_ALLOWED_HOSTS")
    if configured is None:
        return DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTS
    hosts = tuple(
        dict.fromkeys(
            host.strip().casefold()
            for host in configured.split(",")
            if host.strip()
        )
    )
    return hosts or DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTS


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AppConfig:
    data_root: Path = DEFAULT_DATA_ROOT
    database_path: Path | None = None
    master_summary_path: Path = DEFAULT_MASTER_SUMMARY
    master_summary_mirror_path: Path = DEFAULT_MASTER_SUMMARY_MIRROR
    bitbrowser_executable: Path = DEFAULT_BITBROWSER_EXECUTABLE
    bitbrowser_db_path: Path = DEFAULT_BITBROWSER_DB
    bitbrowser_base_url: str = "http://127.0.0.1:54345"
    product_pool_api_base: str = "http://127.0.0.1:8003"
    provider: str = "https://2999api.com/v1"
    model: str = "gpt-5.5"
    wire_api: str = "responses"
    auto_category_threshold: float = 0.8
    worker_count: int = 3
    execution_mode: str = "real"
    api_prefix: str = "/api/v1"
    allowed_hosts: tuple[str, ...] = field(default=DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTS)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        normalized_root = Path(self.data_root).expanduser().resolve()
        object.__setattr__(self, "data_root", normalized_root)
        database_path = self.database_path or normalized_root / "workflow.db"
        object.__setattr__(self, "database_path", Path(database_path).expanduser().resolve())
        summary_path = Path(self.master_summary_path).expanduser().resolve()
        if summary_path.suffix.casefold() != ".xlsx":
            raise ValueError("master_summary_path 蹇呴』鏄?.xlsx 鏂囦欢")
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "master_summary_path",
            summary_path,
        )
        mirror_path = Path(self.master_summary_mirror_path).expanduser().resolve()
        if mirror_path.suffix.casefold() != ".xlsx":
            raise ValueError("master_summary_mirror_path 蹇呴』鏄?.xlsx 鏂囦欢")
        object.__setattr__(self, "master_summary_mirror_path", mirror_path)
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "bitbrowser_executable",
            Path(self.bitbrowser_executable).expanduser().resolve(),
        )
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "bitbrowser_db_path",
            Path(self.bitbrowser_db_path).expanduser().resolve(),
        )

    @classmethod
    def from_environment(cls) -> AppConfig:
        data_root = Path(os.environ.get("TK_WORKFLOW_DATA_ROOT", str(DEFAULT_DATA_ROOT)))
        return cls(
            data_root=data_root,
            database_path=Path(os.environ["TK_WORKFLOW_DATABASE_PATH"])
            if os.environ.get("TK_WORKFLOW_DATABASE_PATH")
            else None,
            master_summary_path=Path(
                os.environ.get("TK_WORKFLOW_MASTER_SUMMARY", str(DEFAULT_MASTER_SUMMARY))
            ),
            master_summary_mirror_path=Path(
                os.environ.get(
                    "TK_WORKFLOW_MASTER_SUMMARY_MIRROR",
                    str(DEFAULT_MASTER_SUMMARY_MIRROR),
                )
            ),
            bitbrowser_executable=Path(
                os.environ.get(
                    "TK_WORKFLOW_BITBROWSER_EXECUTABLE",
                    str(DEFAULT_BITBROWSER_EXECUTABLE),
                )
            ),
            bitbrowser_db_path=Path(
                os.environ.get("TK_WORKFLOW_BITBROWSER_DB", str(DEFAULT_BITBROWSER_DB))
            ),
            bitbrowser_base_url=os.environ.get(
                "TK_WORKFLOW_BITBROWSER_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:54345"
            ),
            product_pool_api_base=os.environ.get(
                "TK_PRODUCT_POOL_API_BASE", "http://127.0.0.1:8003"
            ),
            allowed_hosts=_allowed_hosts_from_environment(),
        )

    def default_settings(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {
            "data_root": str(self.data_root),
            "master_summary_path": str(self.master_summary_path),
            "master_summary_mirror_path": str(self.master_summary_mirror_path),
            "bitbrowser_base_url": self.bitbrowser_base_url,
            "provider": self.provider,
            "model": self.model,
            "wire_api": self.wire_api,
            "auto_category_threshold": self.auto_category_threshold,
            "worker_count": self.worker_count,
            "profile_ids": [],
            "execution_mode": self.execution_mode,
        }

const TXT_MIME_TYPES = new Set(['application/octet-stream', 'text/plain'])

export class ApiError extends Error {
  status: number

  constructor(message: string, status: number) {
    super(message)
    this.name = 'ApiError'
    this.status = status
  }
}

function payloadErrorMessage(payload: unknown, fallback: string): string {
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') {
    return typeof payload === 'string' && payload.trim() ? payload : fallback
  }
  const record = payload as Record<string, unknown>
  const nestedError = record.error && typeof record.error === 'object'
    ? record.error as Record<string, unknown>
    : null
  const message = record.detail ?? record.message ?? nestedError?.message ?? record.error
  return typeof message === 'string' && message.trim() ? message : fallback
}

function unwrap<T>(payload: unknown): T {
  if (payload && typeof payload === 'object') {
    const record = payload as Record<string, unknown>
    if ('success' in record && 'data' in record) return record.data as T
    if (Object.keys(record).length === 1 && 'data' in record) return record.data as T
  }
  return payload as T
}

export function listFrom<T>(payload: unknown): T[] {
  const value = unwrap<unknown>(payload)
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value as T[]
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return []
  const record = value as Record<string, unknown>
  if (Array.isArray(record.items)) return record.items as T[]
  if (Array.isArray(record.data)) return record.data as T[]
  if (record.data && typeof record.data === 'object' && Array.isArray((record.data as Record<string, unknown>).items)) {
    return (record.data as { items: T[] }).items  headers.set('Accept', 'application/json')
  }
  if (payload && typeof payload === 'object' && (payload as Record<string, unknown>).success === false) {
    throw new ApiError(payloadErrorMessage(payload, '璇锋眰鏈垚鍔熷畬鎴愩€?), response.status)
  }
  return unwrap<T>(payload)
}

async function requestBlob(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<Blob> {
  const headers = new Headers(init?.headers)
  if (init?.body && !(init.body instanceof FormData)) headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json')
  headers.set('Accept', 'application/zip, application/octet-stream')
  let response: Response
  try {
    response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, { ...init, headers })
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError('鏃犳硶杩炴帴鏈湴鏈嶅姟锛岃纭鏈嶅姟宸茬粡鍚姩銆?, 0)
  }
  if (!response.ok) {
    const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || ''
    let payload: unknown
    try {
      payload = contentType.includes('json') ? await response.json() : await response.text()
    } catch {
      payload = undefined
    }
    throw new ApiError(payloadErrorMessage(payload, `璇锋眰澶辫触 (${response.status})`), response.status)
  }
  return response.blob()
}

function fileExtension(file: File): string {
  const separator = file.name.lastIndexOf('.')
  return separator >= 0 ? file.name.slice(separator).toLowerCase() : ''
}

function validateFileSize(file: File, maxBytes: number, message: string): void {
  if (file.size <= 0) throw new ApiError('鏂囦欢鍐呭涓虹┖锛岃閲嶆柊閫夋嫨銆?, 0)
  if (file.size > maxBytes) throw new ApiError(message, 0)
}

function validateMime(file: File, allowed: Set<string>, message: string): void {
  const mime = file.type.trim().toLowerCase()
  if (mime && !allowed.has(mime)) throw new ApiError(message, 0)
}

function validateImportFile(file: File): void {
  if (fileExtension(file) !== '.xlsx') throw new ApiError('鍙敮鎸?.xlsx 鏂囦欢銆?, 0)
  validateFileSize(file, IMPORT_XLSX_MAX_BYTES, 'Excel 鏂囦欢涓嶈兘瓒呰繃 5 MB銆?)
  validateMime(file, XLSX_MIME_TYPES, '鏂囦欢绫诲瀷涓?.xlsx 涓嶅尮閰嶃€?)
}

function validateGalleryCheckFile(file: File): void {
  const extension = fileExtension(file)
  if (extension !== '.xlsx' && extension !== '.txt') {
    throw new ApiError('鍙敮鎸?.xlsx 鎴?.txt 鏂囦欢銆?, 0)
  }
  if (extension === '.xlsx') {
    validateFileSize(file, IMPORT_XLSX_MAX_BYTES, 'Excel 鏂囦欢涓嶈兘瓒呰繃 5 MB銆?)
    validateMime(file, XLSX_MIME_TYPES, '鏂囦欢绫诲瀷涓?.xlsx 涓嶅尮閰嶃€?)
    return
  }
  validateFileSize(file, GALLERY_TXT_MAX_BYTES, 'TXT 鏂囦欢涓嶈兘瓒呰繃 1 MB銆?)
  validateMime(file, TXT_MIME_TYPES, '鏂囦欢绫诲瀷涓?.txt 涓嶅尮閰嶃€?)
}

function validateBusinessCategoryFile(file: File): void {
  validateImportFile(file)
}

export function safeArtifactDownloadUrl(value: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.startsWith(`${API_BASE}/artifacts?`)) return null
  try {
    const base = typeof window === 'undefined' ? 'http://localhost' : window.location.origin
    const url = new URL(value, base)
    if (url.origin !== base || url.pathname !== `${API_BASE}/artifacts` || url.hash) return null
    if (!url.searchParams.get('path')?.trim()) return null
    return value
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

function normalizeBatch(value: Batch | (Partial<Batch> & { id: string; name: string; status: string })): Batch {
  const record = value as Batch & { succeeded?: number }
  return {
    ...record,
    category: record.category ?? record.category_mode ?? 'auto',
    total: Number(record.total ?? 0),
    completed: Number(record.completed ?? record.succeeded ?? 0),
    failed: Number(record.failed ?? 0),
  }
}

function normalizeSettings(value: Settings): Settings {
  let storedProfiles: string[] = []
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('tk-workflow-profile-ids')
    storedProfiles = saved ? JSON.parse(saved) as string[] : []
  } catch {
    storedProfiles = []
  }
  return {
    ...value,
    provider_base_url: value.provider_base_url ?? value.provider,
    confidence_threshold: value.confidence_threshold ?? value.auto_category_threshold,
    product_summary_path: value.product_summary_path ?? value.summary_path ?? value.master_summary_path,
    profile_ids: value.profile_ids ?? storedProfiles,
  }
}

function normalizeItem(value: WorkflowItem): WorkflowItem {
  const artifactUrl = value.artifact_path
    ? `/api/v1/artifacts?path=${encodeURIComponent(value.artifact_path)}`
    : undefined
  return {
    ...value,
    error: value.error ?? value.error_message,
    original_url: value.original_url ?? value.image_url ?? value.thumbnail_url ?? artifactUrl,
    thumbnail_url: value.thumbnail_url ?? value.original_url ?? value.image_url ?? artifactUrl,
    collage_url: value.collage_url ?? artifactUrl,
  }
}

function normalizeDetail(payload: BatchDetail | Batch): BatchDetail {
  if ('batch' in payload) {
    const stats = payload.stats ?? {}
    return {
      ...payload,
      batch: normalizeBatch({
        ...payload.batch,
        total: payload.batch.total ?? stats.total ?? 0,
        completed: payload.batch.completed ?? stats.succeeded ?? stats.completed ?? 0,
        failed: payload.batch.failed ?? stats.failed ?? 0,
      }),
      items: (Array.isArray(payload.items) ? payload.items : listFrom<WorkflowItem>((payload as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).items)).map(normalizeItem),
      export: payload.export ? { ...payload.export, path: payload.export.path ?? payload.export.manifest_path, count: payload.export.count ?? payload.export.pid_count } : undefined,
    }
  }
  return { batch: normalizeBatch(payload), items: [] }
}

function normalizeGalleryItem(value: GalleryPid): GalleryPid {
  const record = value as GalleryPid & {
    count?: number
    path?: string
    collage_path?: string
  }
  const imageCount = Number(record.original_image_count ?? record.image_count ?? record.count ?? 0)
  const sourcePath = record.source_directory ?? record.source_path ?? record.path
  const coverPath = record.cover_path ?? record.artifact_path ?? record.collage_path
  return {
    ...record,
    pid: String(record.pid ?? ''),
    image_count: imageCount,
    original_image_count: Number(record.original_image_count ?? imageCount),
    original_total_bytes: Number(record.original_total_bytes ?? 0),
    source_path: sourcePath,
    source_directory: record.source_directory ?? sourcePath,
    artifact_path: coverPath,
    cover_path: record.cover_path ?? coverPath,
  }
}

export const api = {
  async preflight(): Promise<Preflight> {
    const value = await request<Preflight>('/system/preflight')
    return { ...value, checks: (value.checks ?? []).map((check) => ({ ...check, key: check.key ?? check.id ?? check.label })) }
  },

  async listBatches(): Promise<Batch[]> {
    return listFrom<Batch>(await request<unknown>('/batches')).map(normalizeBatch)
  },

  async listGallery(input: { query?: string; membership?: string; limit?: number; offset?: number } = {}): Promise<GalleryResponse> {
    const params = new URLSearchParams()
    if (input.query?.trim()) params.set('query', input.query.trim())
    if (input.membership && input.membership !== 'all') params.set('membership', input.membership)
    params.set('limit', String(input.limit ?? 100))
    params.set('offset', String(input.offset ?? 0))
    const suffix = params.toString()
    const value = await request<GalleryResponse | GalleryPid[] | { items?: GalleryPid[]; total?: number; limit?: number; offset?: number; stats?: GalleryResponse['stats'] }>(`/gallery${suffix ? `?${suffix}` : ''}`)
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return { items: value.map(normalizeGalleryItem), total: value.length, limit: input.limit ?? 100, offset: input.offset ?? 0 }
    return {
      ...value,
      items: Array.isArray(value.items) ? value.items.map(normalizeGalleryItem) : [],
      total: Number(value.total ?? value.items?.length ?? 0),
      limit: Number(value.limit ?? input.limit ?? 100),
      offset: Number(value.offset ?? input.offset ?? 0),
    }
  },

  syncGallery(): Promise<GallerySyncResult> {
    return request<GallerySyncResult>('/gallery/sync-jspace', { method: 'POST' })
  },

  getGalleryMembershipStatus(): Promise<GalleryMembershipStatus> {
    return request<GalleryMembershipStatus>('/gallery/membership/status')
  },

  backfillGalleryMembership(): Promise<GalleryMembershipStatus> {
    return request<GalleryMembershipStatus>('/gallery/membership/backfill', { method: 'POST' })
  },

  async checkGalleryFile(file: File): Promise<GalleryCheckResult> {
    validateGalleryCheckFile(file)
    const body = new FormData()
    body.append('file', file)
    return request<GalleryCheckResult>('/gallery/check-file', { method: 'POST', body })
  },

  downloadGalleryFolders(pids: string[]): Promise<Blob> {
    return requestBlob('/gallery/download-folder', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ pids }),
    })
  },

  async updateGalleryCategory(pid: string, category: string): Promise<GalleryPid> {
    return normalizeGalleryItem(await request<GalleryPid>(`/gallery/${encodeURIComponent(pid)}`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: JSON.stringify({ category }),
    }))
  },

  async updateGalleryBusinessCategory(pid: string, category: 'clothing' | 'non_clothing' | 'unknown'): Promise<GalleryPid> {
    return normalizeGalleryItem(await request<GalleryPid>(`/gallery/${encodeURIComponent(pid)}/business-category`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: JSON.stringify({ category }),
    }))
  },

  async importGalleryBusinessCategories(file: File): Promise<BusinessCategoryImportResult> {
    validateBusinessCategoryFile(file)
    const body = new FormData()
    body.append('file', file)
    return request<BusinessCategoryImportResult>('/gallery/business-category/import', {
      method: 'POST',
      body,
    })
  },

  async getBatch(id: string): Promise<BatchDetail> {
    const payload = await request<BatchDetail | Batch>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`)
    const detail = normalizeDetail(payload)
    const record = payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload as unknown as Record<string, unknown> : {}
    const hasEmbeddedItems = Array.isArray(record.items)
      && (record.items.length > 0 || 'events' in record)
    const hasEmbeddedEvents = Array.isArray(record.events)
    const itemsRequest = hasEmbeddedItems
      ? null
      : request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/items`)
    const eventsRequest = hasEmbeddedEvents
      ? null
      : request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/events`)
    const [items, events] = await Promise.allSettled([
      itemsRequest ?? Promise.resolve(null),
      eventsRequest ?? Promise.resolve(null),
    ])
    return {
      ...detail,
      items: itemsRequest && items.status === 'fulfilled'
        ? listFrom<WorkflowItem>(items.value).map(normalizeItem)
        : detail.items,
      events: eventsRequest && events.status === 'fulfilled'
        ? listFrom<WorkflowEvent>(events.value)
        : detail.events ?? [],
    }
  },

  async previewImport(input: { text?: string; file?: File }): Promise<ImportPreview> {
    if (input.file) {
      validateImportFile(input.file)
      const body = new FormData()
      body.append('file', input.file)
      return request('/imports/preview-file', { method: 'POST', body })
    }
    return request('/imports/preview', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ text: input.text ?? '' }) })
  },

  async createBatch(input: { name: string; category: string; pids: string[]; worker_count?: number; profile_ids?: string[] }): Promise<Batch> {
    const value = await request<Batch>('/batches', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        name: input.name,
        category_mode: input.category,
        pids: input.pids,
        worker_count: input.worker_count ?? 3,
        profile_ids: input.profile_ids ?? [],
      }),
    })
    return normalizeBatch(value)
  },

  controlBatch(id: string, action: BatchAction): Promise<Batch | BatchDetail> {
    return request(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/${action}`, { method: 'POST' })
  },

  startBatch(id: string) {
    return this.controlBatch(id, 'start')
  },

  retryFailed(id: string): Promise<Batch | BatchDetail> {
    return request(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/retry-failed`, { method: 'POST' })
  },

  async getSettings(): Promise<Settings> {
    return normalizeSettings(await request<Settings>('/settings'))
  },
  async updateSettings(settings: Settings): Promise<Settings> {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('tk-workflow-profile-ids', JSON.stringify(settings.profile_ids ?? []))
    } catch {
      // The server settings still save when browser storage is unavailable.
    }
    const value = await request<Settings>('/settings', {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        execution_mode: settings.execution_mode,
        provider: settings.provider_base_url ?? settings.provider,
        model: settings.model,
        wire_api: settings.wire_api,
        auto_category_threshold: settings.confidence_threshold ?? settings.auto_category_threshold,
        worker_count: settings.worker_count,
        profile_ids: settings.profile_ids,
        master_summary_path: settings.product_summary_path ?? settings.summary_path ?? settings.master_summary_path,
        master_summary_mirror_path: settings.master_summary_mirror_path,
      }),
    })
    return normalizeSettings({ ...value, profile_ids: settings.profile_ids })
  },
  setSecret: (name: string, value: string) => request<{ configured: boolean }>(`/secrets/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    body: JSON.stringify({ value }),
  }),

  async getProfiles(refresh = false): Promise<ProfilesResponse> {
    const value = await request<ProfilesResponse | BrowserProfile[]>(`/integrations/bitbrowser/profiles${refresh ? '?refresh=true' : ''}`)
    return Array.isArray(value) ? { online: true, items: value } : { ...value, items: listFrom<BrowserProfile>(value) }
  },

  async exportBatch(id: string): Promise<ExportInfo> {
    const value = await request<ExportInfo>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/export`, { method: 'POST' })
    return {
      ...value,
      path: value.path ?? value.manifest_path ?? '',
      count: value.count ?? value.pid_count ?? 0,
    }
  },
  confirmIntegration: (id: string, kind: string, confirmed: boolean) => request<unknown>(`/batches/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/confirmations`, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({ kind, confirmed }),
  }),
  updateItemCategory: (itemId: string, category: 'clothing' | 'non_clothing') => request<WorkflowItem>(`/items/${encodeURIComponent(itemId)}/category`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    body: JSON.stringify({ category }),
  }),
}

vi.mock('./api', () => ({

    getBatch: vi.fn(),

  },
}))

const mockedApi = vi.mocked(api)

beforeEach(() => {
  vi.clearAllMocks()
  sessionStorage.clear()
  Object.defineProperty(window, 'matchMedia', {
    configurable: true,
    writable: true,
    value: vi.fn((query: string) => ({
      matches: false,
      media: query,
      onchange: null,
      addListener: vi.fn(),
      removeListener: vi.fn(),
      addEventListener: vi.fn(),
      removeEventListener: vi.fn(),
      dispatchEvent: vi.fn(() => true),
    })),
  })
  mockedApi.preflight.mockResolvedValue({ overall: 'ready', checks: [] })
  mockedApi.listBatches.mockResolvedValue([])
  mockedApi.getBatch.mockResolvedValue({ batch: { id: 'b1', name: '鏂版壒娆?, status: 'draft', total: 1, completed: 0, failed: 0, category: 'auto' }, items: [] })
  mockedApi.getSettings.mockResolvedValue({ worker_count: 3, profile_ids: [], execution_mode: 'real' })
  mockedApi.getProfiles.mockResolvedValue({ online: true, items: [] })
  mockedApi.previewImport.mockResolvedValue({ valid_pids: ['1234567890'], duplicates: [], invalid: [], total: 1 })
  mockedApi.createBatch.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'b1', name: '鏂版壒娆?, status: 'draft', total: 1, completed: 0, failed: 0, category: 'auto' })
})

describe('App', () => {
  it('renders the Majestic workflow shell with a topbar and primary sidebar', () => {

  it('shows only today batches by default and lets the user revisit a historical date', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    const localDateKey = (value: Date) => {
      const year = value.getFullYear()
      const month = String(value.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')
      const day = String(value.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
      return `${year}-${month}-${day}`
    }
    const today = new Date()
    const todayKey = localDateKey(today)
    const historicalDate = new Date(today)
    historicalDate.setDate(historicalDate.getDate() - 1)
    const historicalKey = localDateKey(historicalDate)
    const todayBatch = {
      id: 'today-batch', name: 'TODAY_BATCH', status: 'completed', total: 2, completed: 2, failed: 0, category: 'auto' as const,
      created_at: `${todayKey}T09:00:00`,
    }
    const historicalBatch = {
      id: 'historical-batch', name: 'HISTORICAL_BATCH', status: 'failed', total: 2, completed: 1, failed: 1, category: 'auto' as const,
      created_at: `${historicalKey}T09:00:00`,
    }
    mockedApi.listBatches.mockResolvedValue([todayBatch, historicalBatch])
    mockedApi.getBatch.mockImplementation(async (id) => ({
      batch: id === historicalBatch.id ? historicalBatch : todayBatch,
      items: [],
    }))

    render(<App />)

    const sidebar = screen.getByRole('complementary', { name: '涓诲鑸晶鏍? })
    expect(await within(sidebar).findByRole('button', { name: /TODAY_BATCH/ })).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(within(sidebar).queryByRole('button', { name: /HISTORICAL_BATCH/ })).not.toBeInTheDocument()

    const dateInput = within(sidebar).getByLabelText('鎸夋棩鏈熺瓫閫夋壒娆?)
    expect(dateInput).toHaveValue(todayKey)

    fireEvent.change(dateInput, { target: { value: historicalKey } })
    expect(await within(sidebar).findByRole('button', { name: /HISTORICAL_BATCH/ })).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(within(sidebar).queryByRole('button', { name: /TODAY_BATCH/ })).not.toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(within(sidebar).getByRole('button', { name: '鍥炲埌浠婂ぉ' })).toBeInTheDocument()

    await user.click(within(sidebar).getByRole('button', { name: '鍥炲埌浠婂ぉ' }))
    expect(await within(sidebar).findByRole('button', { name: /TODAY_BATCH/ })).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(within(sidebar).queryByRole('button', { name: /HISTORICAL_BATCH/ })).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('ignores a stale running-batch poll after selecting another batch', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    let runBatchPoll: (() => void) | undefined
    const intervalSpy = vi.spyOn(window, 'setInterval').mockImplementation((handler, timeout) => {
      if (timeout === 4_000 && typeof handler === 'function') runBatchPoll = () => handler()
      return 1
    })
    try {
      const batchA = {
        id: 'batch-a', name: 'Batch A', status: 'running', total: 1, completed: 0, failed: 0, category: 'auto' as const,
      }
      const batchB = {
        id: 'batch-b', name: 'Batch B', status: 'completed', total: 1, completed: 1, failed: 0, category: 'auto' as const,
      }
      let resolveStalePoll: ((detail: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof api.getBatch>>) => void) | undefined
      mockedApi.listBatches.mockResolvedValue([batchA, batchB])
      mockedApi.getBatch
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ batch: batchA, items: [] })
        .mockReturnValueOnce(new Promise((resolve) => { resolveStalePoll = resolve }))
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ batch: batchB, items: [] })

      render(<App />)
      expect(await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Batch A' })).toBeInTheDocument()
      await waitFor(() => expect(runBatchPoll).toBeTypeOf('function'))

      act(() => runBatchPoll?.())
      expect(mockedApi.getBatch).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
      await user.click(screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: /Batch B/ })[0])
      expect(await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Batch B' })).toBeInTheDocument()

      await act(async () => {
        resolveStalePoll?.({ batch: batchA, items: [] })
        await Promise.resolve()
      })
      expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Batch B' })).toBeInTheDocument()
    } finally {
      intervalSpy.mockRestore()
    }
  })

    async def stream_batch_events(
        request: Request,
        batch_id: str,
        after: int = Query(default=0, ge=0),
        follow: bool = True,
    ) -> StreamingResponse:
        batch_repository.get_batch(batch_id)
        header_id = request.headers.get("last-event-id")
        cursor = max(after, int(header_id)) if header_id and header_id.isdigit() else after

        async def generate() -> Any:
            nonlocal cursor
            while True:
                events = batch_repository.list_events(batch_id, after_id=cursor)
                for event in events:
                    cursor = event["id"]
                    payload = json.dumps(event, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
                    yield f"id: {event['id']}\nevent: {event['event_type']}\ndata: {payload}\n\n"
                if not follow:
                    break
                if await request.is_disconnected():
                    break
                if not events:
                    yield ": heartbeat\n\n"
                await asyncio.sleep(1)

        return StreamingResponse(
            generate(),
            media_type="text/event-stream",
            headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache", "X-Accel-Buffering": "no"},

    def control_batch(batch_id: str, action: str) -> JSONResponse:
        if action in {"start", "resume", "retry-failed"}:
            if scheduler.is_stopping():
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=409,
                    detail={
                        "code": "service_stopping",
                        "message": "鏈嶅姟姝ｅ湪鍋滄锛屼笉鑳藉惎鍔ㄦ柊浠诲姟",
                    },
                )
            batch_before = batch_repository.get_batch(batch_id)
            settings = settings_service.runner_settings()
            if (
                settings.get("execution_mode") == "real"
                and not batch_before.get("profile_ids")
            ):
                default_profiles = list(settings.get("profile_ids") or [])
                if default_profiles:
                    batch_before = batch_repository.assign_profile_ids(
                        batch_id, default_profiles
                    )
            if (
                settings.get("execution_mode") == "real"
                and not batch_before.get("profile_ids")
            ):
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=409,
                    detail={
                        "code": "profile_required",
                        "message": "鐪熷疄妯″紡鑷冲皯闇€瑕侀€夋嫨涓€涓?BitBrowser 閰嶇疆",
                    },
                )
        batch = batch_repository.transition(batch_id, action)
        if action in {"start", "retry-failed"}:
            scheduled = scheduler.start(batch_id)
            if not scheduled:
                batch_repository.transition(batch_id, "cancel")
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=409,
                    detail={
                        "code": "service_stopping",
                        "message": "鏈嶅姟姝ｅ湪鍋滄锛屼换鍔℃湭鍚姩",
                    },
                )
        elif action == "pause":
            scheduler.pause(batch_id)
        elif action == "resume":
            scheduled = scheduler.resume(batch_id)
            if not scheduled:
                batch_repository.transition(batch_id, "cancel")
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=409,
                    detail={
                        "code": "service_stopping",
                        "message": "鏈嶅姟姝ｅ湪鍋滄锛屼换鍔℃湭缁х画",
                    },
                )
        elif action == "cancel":
            scheduler.cancel(batch_id)
        return success(serialize_batch(batch))

    @app.post(f"{prefix}/batches/{{batch_id}}/start")

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, SecretStr, field_validator

from app.validation import PID_PATTERN, PID_REQUIREMENT

BITBROWSER_PROFILE_ID_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$")
BITBROWSER_PROFILE_ID_REQUIREMENT = (
    "BitBrowser 閰嶇疆 ID 鍙兘鍖呭惈瀛楁瘝銆佹暟瀛椼€佷笅鍒掔嚎鍜岃繛瀛楃"
)


class StrictModel(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", str_strip_whitespace=True)


class PreviewTextRequest(StrictModel):
    text: str = Field(max_length=1_048_576)


class CreateBatchRequest(StrictModel):
    name: str = Field(default="鏈懡鍚嶆壒娆?, min_length=1, max_length=100)
    pids: list[str] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=10_000)
    category_mode: Literal["auto", "clothing", "non_clothing"] = "auto"
    worker_count: int = Field(default=3, ge=1, le=3)
    profile_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=3)

    @field_validator("pids")
    @classmethod
    def validate_pids(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        normalized = [value.strip() for value in values]
        invalid = [value for value in normalized if not PID_PATTERN.fullmatch(value)]
        if invalid:
            raise ValueError(PID_REQUIREMENT)
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))

    @field_validator("profile_ids")
    @classmethod
    def validate_profiles(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        normalized = [value.strip() for value in values]
        if any(
            not BITBROWSER_PROFILE_ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(value) for value in normalized
        ):
            raise ValueError(BITBROWSER_PROFILE_ID_REQUIREMENT)
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))


class SettingsUpdateRequest(StrictModel):
    data_root: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    master_summary_path: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    master_summary_mirror_path: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    provider: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    model: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=100)
    wire_api: Literal["responses"] | None = None
    auto_category_threshold: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=1)
    worker_count: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1, le=3)
    profile_ids: list[str] | None = Field(default=None, max_length=3)
    execution_mode: Literal["real", "mock"] | None = None

    @field_validator("profile_ids")
    @classmethod
    def validate_profile_ids(cls, values: list[str] | None) -> list[str] | None:
        if values is None:
            return None
        normalized = [value.strip() for value in values]
        if any(
            not BITBROWSER_PROFILE_ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(value) for value in normalized
        ):
            raise ValueError(BITBROWSER_PROFILE_ID_REQUIREMENT)
        return list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))

    @field_validator("data_root", "master_summary_path", "master_summary_mirror_path")
    @classmethod
    def validate_absolute_path(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is not None and not Path(value).expanduser().is_absolute():
            raise ValueError("蹇呴』浣跨敤缁濆璺緞")
        return value

    @field_validator("master_summary_path", "master_summary_mirror_path")
    @classmethod
    def validate_summary_workbook(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is not None and Path(value).suffix.casefold() != ".xlsx":
            raise ValueError("鍟嗗搧姹囨€荤洰鏍囧繀椤绘槸 .xlsx 鏂囦欢")
        return value

    @field_validator("provider")
    @classmethod
    def validate_provider(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is None:
            return value
        parsed = urlsplit(value)
        if parsed.scheme != "https" or not parsed.hostname or parsed.username or parsed.password:
            raise ValueError("妯″瀷鏈嶅姟鍦板潃蹇呴』鏄?HTTPS URL")
        return value.rstrip("/")


class SecretUpdateRequest(StrictModel):
    value: SecretStr = Field(min_length=1, max_length=8192)


class ConfirmationRequest(StrictModel):

            root = Path(temporary_directory)

                config=AppConfig(
                    data_root=root / "data",

                secret_store=InMemorySecretStore(),
                bitbrowser_discovery=StaticBitBrowserDiscovery(online=False, items=[]),
                workflow_scheduler=NoopWorkflowScheduler(),
            )

        lookup = app.state.product_pool_lookup
        membership_service = app.state.gallery_membership_service
        self.assertIsInstance(lookup, ProductPoolLookupClient)

        self.assertEqual(membership_service.batch_pause_seconds, 3.0)

            headers={"origin": "http://127.0.0.1"},
        )

        self.assertEqual(cross_port.status_code, 403)
        self.assertEqual(same_origin.status_code, 200)

    def test_preview_create_list_detail_controls_and_events(self) -> None:
        preview = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/imports/preview",
            json={"text": "1736250849091618684\n1736250849091618684\nbad"},
        )
        self.assertEqual(preview.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(preview.json()["data"], {
            "valid_pids": ["1736250849091618684"],
            "duplicates": ["1736250849091618684"],
            "invalid": ["bad"],
            "total": 3,
        })

        created = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/batches",
            json={
                "name": "鍏湀鎵规",
                "pids": ["1736250849091618684"],
                "category_mode": "auto",
                "worker_count": 3,
                "profile_ids": ["p1"],
            },
        )
        self.assertEqual(created.status_code, 201)
        batch_id = created.json()["data"]["id"]

        listed = self.client.get("/api/v1/batches").json()["data"]
        detail = self.client.get(f"/api/v1/batches/{batch_id}").json()["data"]
        started = self.client.post(f"/api/v1/batches/{batch_id}/start").json()["data"]
        paused = self.client.post(f"/api/v1/batches/{batch_id}/pause").json()["data"]
        resumed = self.client.post(f"/api/v1/batches/{batch_id}/resume").json()["data"]
        cancelled = self.client.post(f"/api/v1/batches/{batch_id}/cancel").json()["data"]
        events = self.client.get(f"/api/v1/batches/{batch_id}/events").json()["data"]

        self.assertEqual(listed["items"][0]["id"], batch_id)
        self.assertEqual(listed["items"][0]["category"], "auto")
        self.assertEqual(listed["items"][0]["completed"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(detail["batch"]["id"], batch_id)
        self.assertEqual(detail["stats"]["total"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(detail["items"][0]["progress"], 0)
        self.assertIsNone(detail["items"][0]["error"])
        self.assertEqual(len(detail["confirmations"]), 3)
        self.assertEqual(started["status"], "running")
        self.assertEqual(paused["status"], "paused")
        self.assertEqual(resumed["status"], "running")
        self.assertEqual(cancelled["status"], "cancelled")
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(events["items"]), 5)
        stream = self.client.get(
            f"/api/v1/batches/{batch_id}/events/stream", params={"follow": "false"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(stream.status_code, 200)
        self.assertIn("event: batch.created", stream.text)

    def test_settings_and_secrets_never_echo_secret(self) -> None:
        initial = self.client.get("/api/v1/settings").json()["data"]
        updated = self.client.put(
            "/api/v1/settings",
            json={
                "model": "gpt-5.5",
                "worker_count": 2,
                "auto_category_threshold": 0.9,
                "profile_ids": ["p1", "p2", "p3"],
            },
        )
        secret = self.client.put(
            "/api/v1/settings/secrets/FORWARDAPI_API_KEY",
            json={"value": "a-very-secret-key"},
        )
        current = self.client.get("/api/v1/settings")

        self.assertEqual(initial["provider"], "https://2999api.com/v1")
        self.assertEqual(initial["wire_api"], "responses")
        self.assertEqual(updated.json()["data"]["worker_count"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(current.json()["data"]["profile_ids"], ["p1", "p2", "p3"])
        self.assertEqual(secret.json()["data"], {"name": "FORWARDAPI_API_KEY", "configured": True})
        self.assertNotIn("a-very-secret-key", current.text)
        self.assertTrue(current.json()["data"]["secret_status"]["FORWARDAPI_API_KEY"])

        alias = self.client.put(
            "/api/v1/secrets/JFBYM_TOKEN", json={"value": "another-secret"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(alias.status_code, 200)
        self.assertNotIn("another-secret", alias.text)

        settings = self.client.get("/api/v1/settings").json()["data"]

    def test_real_batch_inherits_default_profiles_before_start(self) -> None:
        created = self.client.post(

        )
        self.assertEqual(created.status_code, 201)
        batch_id = created.json()["data"]["id"]
        self.assertEqual(created.json()["data"]["profile_ids"], [])

        self.assertEqual(
            started.json()["data"]["profile_ids"], list(DEFAULT_PROFILE_IDS)

    def test_settings_reject_non_xlsx_summary_target(self) -> None:

            "/api/v1/settings",

        )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 422)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["error"]["code"], "validation_error")

    def test_rejects_unsafe_bitbrowser_profile_ids(self) -> None:
        settings = self.client.put(
            "/api/v1/settings",
            json={"profile_ids": ["profile-a\nprofile-b"]},
        )
        batch = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/batches",
            json={
                "name": "invalid profile",
                "pids": ["1736250849091618684"],
                "profile_ids": ["profile/../../other"],
            },
        )

        self.assertEqual(settings.status_code, 422)
        self.assertEqual(batch.status_code, 422)

    def test_preflight_uses_data_root_from_current_settings(self) -> None:
        new_data_root = Path(self.temporary_directory.name) / "updated-data-root"
        updated = self.client.put(
            "/api/v1/settings", json={"data_root": str(new_data_root)}
        )
        self.assertEqual(updated.status_code, 200)
        new_data_root.rmdir()

        response = self.client.get("/api/v1/system/preflight")

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        data_root_check = next(
            check
            for check in response.json()["data"]["checks"]
            if check["id"] == "data_root"
        )
        self.assertEqual(data_root_check["detail"], str(new_data_root.resolve()))
        self.assertEqual(data_root_check["status"], "ok")
        self.assertTrue(new_data_root.is_dir())

    def test_xlsx_preview_upload_route(self) -> None:
        workbook = Workbook()
        workbook.active.append(["pid"])
        workbook.active.append(["1736250849091618684"])
        content = BytesIO()
        workbook.save(content)

        response = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/imports/preview-file",
            files={
                "file": (
                    "鍟嗗搧PID.xlsx",
                    content.getvalue(),
                    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
                )
            },
        )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["data"]["valid_pids"], ["1736250849091618684"])
        rejected = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/imports/preview-file",
            files={"file": ("鍟嗗搧PID.csv", b"pid", "text/csv")},
        )
        self.assertEqual(rejected.status_code, 400)

    def test_business_category_workbook_import_updates_existing_gallery_only(self) -> None:
        pid = "1736250849091618684"
        self.app.state.gallery_repository.upsert(pid=pid, category="cap")
        workbook = Workbook()
        workbook.active.append(["PID", "鍝佺被"])
        workbook.active.append([pid, "cap鏈嶈"])
        workbook.active.append(["1731846642408588819", "闈炴湇"])
        workbook.active.append([pid, "cap鏈嶈"])
        workbook.active.append(["1735555346702436306", ""])
        content = BytesIO()
        workbook.save(content)

        response = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/gallery/business-category/import",
            files={
                "file": (
                    "宸ヤ綔绨?.xlsx",
                    content.getvalue(),
                    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
                )
            },
        )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["data"]["updated"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["data"]["missing"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["data"]["duplicate_rows"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.app.state.gallery_repository.get_items([pid])[0]["business_category"],
            "clothing",
        )

    def test_business_category_can_be_updated_without_changing_pool_category(self) -> None:
        pid = "1736250849091618684"
        self.app.state.gallery_repository.upsert(pid=pid, category="cap")
        response = self.client.put(
            f"/api/v1/gallery/{pid}/business-category",
            json={"category": "non_clothing"},
        )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["data"]["business_category"], "non_clothing")
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["data"]["category"], "cap")
        self.assertTrue(
            response.json()["data"]["image_url"].startswith(
                f"/api/v1/gallery/{pid}/cover"
            )
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            response.json()["data"]["cover_path"],
            response.json()["data"]["artifact_path"],
        )

    def test_unknown_api_and_missing_frontend_use_stable_errors(self) -> None:
        unknown_api = self.client.get("/api/v1/does-not-exist")
        frontend = self.client.get("/some-client-route")

        self.assertEqual(unknown_api.status_code, 404)
        self.assertEqual(unknown_api.json()["error"]["code"], "not_found")
        if frontend.status_code == 200:
            self.assertIn("text/html", frontend.headers["content-type"])
        else:
            self.assertEqual(frontend.status_code, 404)
            self.assertEqual(frontend.json()["error"]["code"], "frontend_not_built")

    def test_legacy_gallery_import_remains_searchable_but_does_not_skip_new_batch(self) -> None:
        imported = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/gallery/import",
            json={"items": [{"pid": "1736250849091618684", "category": "cap", "source_path": "old/1.jpg"}]},
        )
        self.assertEqual(imported.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(imported.json()["data"]["imported"], 1)

        listed = self.client.get("/api/v1/gallery", params={"category": "cap"})
        self.assertEqual(listed.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(listed.json()["data"]["items"][0]["pid"], "1736250849091618684")
        self.assertEqual(
            listed.json()["data"]["items"][0]["artifact_path"],
            "/sata11/public/鏂板獟浣撻儴/鎷煎浘/1736250849091618684.jpg",
        )
        self.assertTrue(listed.json()["data"]["items"][0]["cap_matched"])
        self.assertEqual(listed.json()["data"]["items"][0]["cap_commission_rate"], 8.25)
        searched = self.client.get(
            "/api/v1/gallery",
            params={"query": "/sata11/public/鏂板獟浣撻儴/鎷煎浘/1736250849091618684.jpg"},
        )
        self.assertEqual(searched.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(searched.json()["data"]["total"], 1)
        checked = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/gallery/check-pids",
            json={"pids": ["1736250849091618684", "1735537002372433336"]},
        )
        self.assertEqual(checked.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(checked.json()["data"]["known"], [])
        self.assertEqual(
            checked.json()["data"]["missing"],
            ["1736250849091618684", "1735537002372433336"],
        )

\n```\n\n## Thread 01a05ba6-3704-74f0-a930-37208b437138\n- created_at_ms: 1788244101082\n- item_type: commandExecution\n\n```text\n"C:\\Windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe" -Command "Get-Content -Path C:\\Users\\EDY\\tk-image-workflow-web\\frontend\\src\\api.ts | Select-Object -First 320"\nGet-Content -Path C:\Users\EDY\tk-image-workflow-web\frontend\src\api.ts | Select-Object -First 320\nimport type {
  Batch,
  BatchAction,
  BatchDetail,
  BrowserProfile,
  ExportInfo,
  GalleryCheckResult,
  BusinessCategoryImportResult,
  GalleryMembershipStatus,
  GalleryPid,
  GalleryResponse,
  GallerySyncResult,
  ImportPreview,
  Preflight,
  ProfilesResponse,
  Settings,
  WorkflowEvent,
  WorkflowItem,
} from './types'

const API_BASE = '/api/v1'
const MEBIBYTE = 1024 * 1024
const IMPORT_XLSX_MAX_BYTES = 5 * MEBIBYTE
const GALLERY_TXT_MAX_BYTES = MEBIBYTE

const XLSX_MIME_TYPES = new Set([
  'application/octet-stream',
  'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
])
const TXT_MIME_TYPES = new Set(['application/octet-stream', 'text/plain'])

export class ApiError extends Error {
  status: number

  constructor(message: string, status: number) {
    super(message)
    this.name = 'ApiError'
    this.status = status
  }
}

function payloadErrorMessage(payload: unknown, fallback: string): string {
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') {
    return typeof payload === 'string' && payload.trim() ? payload : fallback
  }
  const record = payload as Record<string, unknown>
  const nestedError = record.error && typeof record.error === 'object'
    ? record.error as Record<string, unknown>
    : null
  const message = record.detail ?? record.message ?? nestedError?.message ?? record.error
  return typeof message === 'string' && message.trim() ? message : fallback
}

function unwrap<T>(payload: unknown): T {
  if (payload && typeof payload === 'object') {
    const record = payload as Record<string, unknown>
    if ('success' in record && 'data' in record) return record.data as T
    if (Object.keys(record).length === 1 && 'data' in record) return record.data as T
  }
  return payload as T
}

export function listFrom<T>(payload: unknown): T[] {
  const value = unwrap<unknown>(payload)
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value as T[]
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return []
  const record = value as Record<string, unknown>
  if (Array.isArray(record.items)) return record.items as T[]
  if (Array.isArray(record.data)) return record.data as T[]
  if (record.data && typeof record.data === 'object' && Array.isArray((record.data as Record<string, unknown>).items)) {
    return (record.data as { items: T[] }).items
  }
  return []
}

async function request<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const headers = new Headers(init?.headers)
  if (init?.body && !(init.body instanceof FormData)) headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json')
  headers.set('Accept', 'application/json')

  let response: Response
  try {
    response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, { ...init, headers })
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError('鏃犳硶杩炴帴鏈湴鏈嶅姟锛岃纭鏈嶅姟宸茬粡鍚姩銆?, 0)
  }

  const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || ''
  let payload: unknown
  try {
    payload = contentType.includes('json') ? await response.json() : await response.text()
  } catch {
    const message = response.ok ? '鏈湴鏈嶅姟杩斿洖浜嗘棤娉曡В鏋愮殑鏁版嵁銆? : `璇锋眰澶辫触 (${response.status})`
    throw new ApiError(message, response.status)
  }
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new ApiError(payloadErrorMessage(payload, `璇锋眰澶辫触 (${response.status})`), response.status)
  }
  if (payload && typeof payload === 'object' && (payload as Record<string, unknown>).success === false) {
    throw new ApiError(payloadErrorMessage(payload, '璇锋眰鏈垚鍔熷畬鎴愩€?), response.status)
  }
  return unwrap<T>(payload)
}

async function requestBlob(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<Blob> {
  const headers = new Headers(init?.headers)
  if (init?.body && !(init.body instanceof FormData)) headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json')
  headers.set('Accept', 'application/zip, application/octet-stream')
  let response: Response
  try {
    response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, { ...init, headers })
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError('鏃犳硶杩炴帴鏈湴鏈嶅姟锛岃纭鏈嶅姟宸茬粡鍚姩銆?, 0)
  }
  if (!response.ok) {
    const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || ''
    let payload: unknown
    try {
      payload = contentType.includes('json') ? await response.json() : await response.text()
    } catch {
      payload = undefined
    }
    throw new ApiError(payloadErrorMessage(payload, `璇锋眰澶辫触 (${response.status})`), response.status)
  }
  return response.blob()
}

function fileExtension(file: File): string {
  const separator = file.name.lastIndexOf('.')
  return separator >= 0 ? file.name.slice(separator).toLowerCase() : ''
}

function validateFileSize(file: File, maxBytes: number, message: string): void {
  if (file.size <= 0) throw new ApiError('鏂囦欢鍐呭涓虹┖锛岃閲嶆柊閫夋嫨銆?, 0)
  if (file.size > maxBytes) throw new ApiError(message, 0)
}

function validateMime(file: File, allowed: Set<string>, message: string): void {
  const mime = file.type.trim().toLowerCase()
  if (mime && !allowed.has(mime)) throw new ApiError(message, 0)
}

function validateImportFile(file: File): void {
  if (fileExtension(file) !== '.xlsx') throw new ApiError('鍙敮鎸?.xlsx 鏂囦欢銆?, 0)
  validateFileSize(file, IMPORT_XLSX_MAX_BYTES, 'Excel 鏂囦欢涓嶈兘瓒呰繃 5 MB銆?)
  validateMime(file, XLSX_MIME_TYPES, '鏂囦欢绫诲瀷涓?.xlsx 涓嶅尮閰嶃€?)
}

function validateGalleryCheckFile(file: File): void {
  const extension = fileExtension(file)
  if (extension !== '.xlsx' && extension !== '.txt') {
    throw new ApiError('鍙敮鎸?.xlsx 鎴?.txt 鏂囦欢銆?, 0)
  }
  if (extension === '.xlsx') {
    validateFileSize(file, IMPORT_XLSX_MAX_BYTES, 'Excel 鏂囦欢涓嶈兘瓒呰繃 5 MB銆?)
    validateMime(file, XLSX_MIME_TYPES, '鏂囦欢绫诲瀷涓?.xlsx 涓嶅尮閰嶃€?)
    return
  }
  validateFileSize(file, GALLERY_TXT_MAX_BYTES, 'TXT 鏂囦欢涓嶈兘瓒呰繃 1 MB銆?)
  validateMime(file, TXT_MIME_TYPES, '鏂囦欢绫诲瀷涓?.txt 涓嶅尮閰嶃€?)
}

function validateBusinessCategoryFile(file: File): void {
  validateImportFile(file)
}

export function safeArtifactDownloadUrl(value: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.startsWith(`${API_BASE}/artifacts?`)) return null
  try {
    const base = typeof window === 'undefined' ? 'http://localhost' : window.location.origin
    const url = new URL(value, base)
    if (url.origin !== base || url.pathname !== `${API_BASE}/artifacts` || url.hash) return null
    if (!url.searchParams.get('path')?.trim()) return null
    return value
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

function normalizeBatch(value: Batch | (Partial<Batch> & { id: string; name: string; status: string })): Batch {
  const record = value as Batch & { succeeded?: number }
  return {
    ...record,
    category: record.category ?? record.category_mode ?? 'auto',
    total: Number(record.total ?? 0),
    completed: Number(record.completed ?? record.succeeded ?? 0),
    failed: Number(record.failed ?? 0),
  }
}

function normalizeSettings(value: Settings): Settings {
  let storedProfiles: string[] = []
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('tk-workflow-profile-ids')
    storedProfiles = saved ? JSON.parse(saved) as string[] : []
  } catch {
    storedProfiles = []
  }
  return {
    ...value,
    provider_base_url: value.provider_base_url ?? value.provider,
    confidence_threshold: value.confidence_threshold ?? value.auto_category_threshold,
    product_summary_path: value.product_summary_path ?? value.summary_path ?? value.master_summary_path,
    profile_ids: value.profile_ids ?? storedProfiles,
  }
}

function normalizeItem(value: WorkflowItem): WorkflowItem {
  const artifactUrl = value.artifact_path
    ? `/api/v1/artifacts?path=${encodeURIComponent(value.artifact_path)}`
    : undefined
  return {
    ...value,
    error: value.error ?? value.error_message,
    original_url: value.original_url ?? value.image_url ?? value.thumbnail_url ?? artifactUrl,
    thumbnail_url: value.thumbnail_url ?? value.original_url ?? value.image_url ?? artifactUrl,
    collage_url: value.collage_url ?? artifactUrl,
  }
}

function normalizeDetail(payload: BatchDetail | Batch): BatchDetail {
  if ('batch' in payload) {
    const stats = payload.stats ?? {}
    return {
      ...payload,
      batch: normalizeBatch({
        ...payload.batch,
        total: payload.batch.total ?? stats.total ?? 0,
        completed: payload.batch.completed ?? stats.succeeded ?? stats.completed ?? 0,
        failed: payload.batch.failed ?? stats.failed ?? 0,
      }),
      items: (Array.isArray(payload.items) ? payload.items : listFrom<WorkflowItem>((payload as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).items)).map(normalizeItem),
      export: payload.export ? { ...payload.export, path: payload.export.path ?? payload.export.manifest_path, count: payload.export.count ?? payload.export.pid_count } : undefined,
    }
  }
  return { batch: normalizeBatch(payload), items: [] }
}

function normalizeGalleryItem(value: GalleryPid): GalleryPid {
  const record = value as GalleryPid & {
    count?: number
    path?: string
    collage_path?: string
  }
  const imageCount = Number(record.original_image_count ?? record.image_count ?? record.count ?? 0)
  const sourcePath = record.source_directory ?? record.source_path ?? record.path
  const coverPath = record.cover_path ?? record.artifact_path ?? record.collage_path
  return {
    ...record,
    pid: String(record.pid ?? ''),
    image_count: imageCount,
    original_image_count: Number(record.original_image_count ?? imageCount),
    original_total_bytes: Number(record.original_total_bytes ?? 0),
    source_path: sourcePath,
    source_directory: record.source_directory ?? sourcePath,
    artifact_path: coverPath,
    cover_path: record.cover_path ?? coverPath,
  }
}

export const api = {
  async preflight(): Promise<Preflight> {
    const value = await request<Preflight>('/system/preflight')
    return { ...value, checks: (value.checks ?? []).map((check) => ({ ...check, key: check.key ?? check.id ?? check.label })) }
  },

  async listBatches(): Promise<Batch[]> {
    return listFrom<Batch>(await request<unknown>('/batches')).map(normalizeBatch)
  },

  async listGallery(input: { query?: string; membership?: string; limit?: number; offset?: number } = {}): Promise<GalleryResponse> {
    const params = new URLSearchParams()
    if (input.query?.trim()) params.set('query', input.query.trim())
    if (input.membership && input.membership !== 'all') params.set('membership', input.membership)
    params.set('limit', String(input.limit ?? 100))
    params.set('offset', String(input.offset ?? 0))
    const suffix = params.toString()
    const value = await request<GalleryResponse | GalleryPid[] | { items?: GalleryPid[]; total?: number; limit?: number; offset?: number; stats?: GalleryResponse['stats'] }>(`/gallery${suffix ? `?${suffix}` : ''}`)
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return { items: value.map(normalizeGalleryItem), total: value.length, limit: input.limit ?? 100, offset: input.offset ?? 0 }
    return {
      ...value,
      items: Array.isArray(value.items) ? value.items.map(normalizeGalleryItem) : [],
      total: Number(value.total ?? value.items?.length ?? 0),
      limit: Number(value.limit ?? input.limit ?? 100),
      offset: Number(value.offset ?? input.offset ?? 0),
    }
  },

  syncGallery(): Promise<GallerySyncResult> {
    return request<GallerySyncResult>('/gallery/sync-jspace', { method: 'POST' })
  },

  getGalleryMembershipStatus(): Promise<GalleryMembershipStatus> {
    return request<GalleryMembershipStatus>('/gallery/membership/status')
  },

  backfillGalleryMembership(): Promise<GalleryMembershipStatus> {
    return request<GalleryMembershipStatus>('/gallery/membership/backfill', { method: 'POST' })
  },

  async checkGalleryFile(file: File): Promise<GalleryCheckResult> {
    validateGalleryCheckFile(file)
    const body = new FormData()
    body.append('file', file)
    return request<GalleryCheckResult>('/gallery/check-file', { method: 'POST', body })
  },

  downloadGalleryFolders(pids: string[]): Promise<Blob> {
    return requestBlob('/gallery/download-folder', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ pids }),
    })
  },

  async updateGalleryCategory(pid: string, category: string): Promise<GalleryPid> {
    return normalizeGalleryItem(await request<GalleryPid>(`/gallery/${encodeURIComponent(pid)}`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: JSON.stringify({ category }),
    }))
  },

}
